    <!-- ═══ Dock ═══ -->
    <div id="dock">
        <div class="dock-icon" data-app="finder" title="Finder">
            <span class="di-icon">😊</span>
            <span class="di-label">Finder</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dock-icon" data-app="notes" title="Notes">
            <span class="di-icon">📝</span>
            <span class="di-label">Notes</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dock-icon" data-app="about" title="About Mac">
            <span class="di-icon">🍎</span>
            <span class="di-label">About Mac</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dock-sep"></div>
        <div class="dock-icon" data-app="trash" title="Trash">
            <span class="di-icon" id="trash-icon-dock">🗑️</span>
            <span class="di-label">Trash</span>
            <span class="badge hidden" id="trash-badge">0</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ Modal Overlay ═══ -->
    <div id="modal-overlay">
        <div class="modal-box">
            <h2 id="modal-title">🖥️</h2>
            <p id="modal-text">Are you sure?</p>
            <button class="modal-btn" id="modal-btn">OK</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <!-- ═══ JAVASCRIPT ═══ -->
    <!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ── State ──
            let windowIdCounter = 0;
            let windows = {};
            let zIndexCounter = 100;
            let selectedDesktop = null;
            let trashCount = 0;
            let bootDone = false;
            let windowPositions = {};

            // ── DOM refs ──
            const desktop = document.getElementById('desktop');
            const desktopIcons = document.getElementById('desktop-icons');
            const dock = document.getElementById('dock');
            const menubar = document.getElementById('menubar');
            const clockEl = document.getElementById('menu-clock');
            const bootScreen = document.getElementById('boot-screen');
            const bootFill = document.getElementById('bootFill');
            const modalOverlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
            const modalTitle = document.getElementById('modal-title');
            const modalText = document.getElementById('modal-text');
            const modalBtn = document.getElementById('modal-btn');
            const trashIconDesktop = document.getElementById('trash-icon-desktop');
            const trashIconDock = document.getElementById('trash-icon-dock');
            const trashBadge = document.getElementById('trash-badge');

            // ── Boot Sequence ──
            function boot() {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    bootFill.style.width = '100%';
                }, 200);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    bootScreen.classList.add('hidden-boot');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        bootScreen.style.display = 'none';
                        bootDone = true;
                        // open a welcome finder window
                        openFinderWindow();
                        // open about box after a moment
                        setTimeout(() => openAboutWindow(), 600);
                    }, 600);
                }, 2400);
            }

            // ── Clock ──
            function updateClock() {
                const now = new Date();
                let h = now.getHours();
                const m = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
                const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
                h = h % 12 || 12;
                clockEl.textContent = `${h}:${m} ${ampm}`;
            }
            updateClock();
            setInterval(updateClock, 10000);

            // ── Menus ──
            let openMenu = null;

            function closeAllMenus() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.menu-dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                document.querySelector('.apple-logo.open')?.classList.remove('open');
                openMenu = null;
            }

            function toggleMenu(menuId, triggerEl) {
                if (openMenu === menuId) {
                    closeAllMenus();
                    return;
                }
                closeAllMenus();
                const el = document.getElementById(menuId);
                if (!el) return;
                el.classList.add('open');
                triggerEl?.classList.add('open');
                openMenu = menuId;
                // position the dropdown
                const rect = triggerEl?.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect) {
                    el.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
                    el.style.top = '22px';
                } else {
                    el.style.left = '0px';
                    el.style.top = '22px';
                }
            }

            // Menu triggers
            document.querySelectorAll('.apple-logo, .menu-item').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const menu = this.dataset.menu;
                    if (menu) toggleMenu('menu-' + menu, this);
                });
                el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                    if (openMenu) {
                        const menu = this.dataset.menu;
                        if (menu) {
                            closeAllMenus();
                            toggleMenu('menu-' + menu, this);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });

            // Menu items with actions
            document.querySelectorAll('.menu-dropdown .mi[data-action]').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const action = this.dataset.action;
                    closeAllMenus();
                    handleAction(action);
                });
            });

            // Close menus on click outside
            document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (!e.target.closest('.menu-dropdown') && !e.target.closest('.menu-item') && !e.target.closest(
                        '.apple-logo')) {
                    closeAllMenus();
                }
            });

            // ── Actions ──
            function handleAction(action) {
                switch (action) {
                    case 'about':
                        openAboutWindow();
                        break;
                    case 'shutdown':
                        showModal('🖥️', 'Are you sure you want to shut down your computer?', () => {
                            document.body.innerHTML =
                                `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;background:#1a1a1a;color:#888;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:18px;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;"><span style="font-size:60px;">🍎</span><span>Shut Down</span></div>`;
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'new-finder':
                        openFinderWindow();
                        break;
                    case 'finder-prefs':
                        showModal('⚙️', 'Finder Preferences — Not available in this classic demo.', null);
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            }

            // ── Modal ──
            function showModal(title, text, callback) {
                modalTitle.textContent = title;
                modalText.textContent = text;
                modalOverlay.classList.add('open');
                modalBtn.onclick = function() {
                    modalOverlay.classList.remove('open');
                    if (callback) callback();
                };
            }

            // ── Desktop Icons ──
            document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    // deselect others
                    document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon.selected').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
                    this.classList.add('selected');
                    selectedDesktop = this;
                });

                el.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const type = this.dataset.type;
                    switch (type) {
                        case 'finder':
                            openFinderWindow();
                            break;
                        case 'apps':
                            openFinderWindow('Applications');
                            break;
                        case 'docs':
                            openFinderWindow('Documents');
                            break;
                        case 'trash':
                            openTrashWindow();
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                });
            });

            // Click on desktop to deselect
            desktop.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this || e.target === desktopIcons) {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon.selected').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
                    selectedDesktop = null;
                }
            });

            // ── Window System ──
            function createWindow(title, contentHTML, options = {}) {
                const id = 'win-' + (++windowIdCounter);
                const win = document.createElement('div');
                win.className = 'window ' + (options.className || '');
                win.id = id;
                win.style.width = (options.width || 420) + 'px';
                win.style.height = (options.height || 300) + 'px';
                win.style.left = (options.left || 60 + (windowIdCounter * 18 % 120)) + 'px';
                win.style.top = (options.top || 40 + (windowIdCounter * 12 % 80)) + 'px';
                win.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;

                const canResize = options.resizable !== false;
                const canCollapse = options.collapsible !== false;

                win.innerHTML = `
              <div class="titlebar">
                <div class="win-btns">
                  <div class="win-btn close" data-action="close">✕</div>
                  <div class="win-btn collapse" data-action="collapse">─</div>
                  <div class="win-btn zoom" data-action="zoom">□</div>
                </div>
                <span class="win-title">${title}</span>
                <span style="width:52px;"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="content">${contentHTML}</div>
              ${canResize ? '<div class="resize-handle"></div>' : ''}
            `;

                desktop.appendChild(win);

                // ── Window Controls ──
                const titlebar = win.querySelector('.titlebar');
                const content = win.querySelector('.content');

                // Close
                win.querySelector('.close')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    closeWindow(id);
                });

                // Collapse (minimize)
                win.querySelector('.collapse')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    minimizeWindow(id);
                });

                // Zoom (maximize toggle)
                let zoomed = false;
                let zoomRect = null;
                win.querySelector('.zoom')?.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    if (!zoomed) {
                        zoomRect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                        win.style.left = '0px';
                        win.style.top = '22px';
                        win.style.width = (window.innerWidth - 4) + 'px';
                        win.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 90) + 'px';
                        zoomed = true;
                    } else {
                        win.style.left = (zoomRect?.left || 60) + 'px';
                        win.style.top = (zoomRect?.top || 40) + 'px';
                        win.style.width = (zoomRect?.width || 420) + 'px';
                        win.style.height = (zoomRect?.height || 300) + 'px';
                        zoomed = false;
                    }
                });

                // ── Drag ──
                let dragging = false;
                let dragOffset = { x: 0, y: 0 };

                titlebar.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                    if (e.target.closest('.win-btn')) return;
                    dragging = true;
                    const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                    dragOffset.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                    dragOffset.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
                    win.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;
                    e.preventDefault();
                });

                document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                    if (!dragging) return;
                    win.style.left = (e.clientX - dragOffset.x) + 'px';
                    win.style.top = (e.clientY - dragOffset.y) + 'px';
                });

                document.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                    dragging = false;
                });

                // ── Resize ──
                const handle = win.querySelector('.resize-handle');
                if (handle) {
                    let resizing = false;
                    let resizeStart = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 };

                    handle.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        resizing = true;
                        const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                        resizeStart.x = e.clientX;
                        resizeStart.y = e.clientY;
                        resizeStart.w = rect.width;
                        resizeStart.h = rect.height;
                        win.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;
                    });

                    document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                        if (!resizing) return;
                        const dw = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
                        const dh = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
                        const newW = Math.max(180, resizeStart.w + dw);
                        const newH = Math.max(80, resizeStart.h + dh);
                        win.style.width = newW + 'px';
                        win.style.height = newH + 'px';
                    });

                    document.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                        resizing = false;
                    });
                }

                // ── Bring to front ──
                win.addEventListener('mousedown', function() {
                    win.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;
                });

                // ── Store ──
                windows[id] = { el: win, title, content };
                return id;
            }

            function closeWindow(id) {
                const w = windows[id];
                if (!w) return;
                w.el.remove();
                delete windows[id];
            }

            function minimizeWindow(id) {
                const w = windows[id];
                if (!w) return;
                // Instead of full minimize, just hide and show a dock indicator
                if (w.el.classList.contains('minimized')) {
                    w.el.classList.remove('minimized');
                    w.el.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    w.el.classList.add('minimized');
                    w.el.style.display = 'none';
                    // Flash the dock icon
                    const dockIcon = dock.querySelector('.dock-icon[data-app="finder"]');
                    if (dockIcon) {
                        dockIcon.classList.add('bounce');
                        setTimeout(() => dockIcon.classList.remove('bounce'), 400);
                    }
                }
            }

            // ── Finder Window ──
            function openFinderWindow(subfolder) {
                const title = subfolder ? subfolder : 'Macintosh HD';
                const files = subfolder === 'Applications' ? [
                    { name: 'Calculator', icon: '🧮' },
                    { name: 'Chess', icon: '♟️' },
                    { name: 'Clock', icon: '🕐' },
                    { name: 'Notes', icon: '📝' },
                    { name: 'Preview', icon: '👁️' },
                    { name: 'Stickies', icon: '📌' },
                ] : subfolder === 'Documents' ? [
                    { name: 'Letter.txt', icon: '📄' },
                    { name: 'Budget.xls', icon: '📊' },
                    { name: 'Photo.jpg', icon: '🖼️' },
                    { name: 'ReadMe.txt', icon: '📄' },
                ] : [
                    { name: 'Applications', icon: '🧩' },
                    { name: 'Documents', icon: '📄' },
                    { name: 'System Folder', icon: '⚙️' },
                    { name: 'Trash', icon: '🗑️' },
                    { name: 'About Mac', icon: '🍎' },
                ];

                let fileGrid = files.map(f =>
                    `<div class="fg-item" onclick="if(this.parentElement)this.parentElement.style.outline='none'">
                <div class="fg-icon">${f.icon}</div>
                <div class="fg-label">${f.name}</div>
              </div>`
                ).join('');

                const html = `
              <div class="finder-toolbar">
                <button class="ft-btn" onclick="handleAction('new-finder')">↩</button>
                <button class="ft-btn" onclick="handleAction('new-finder')">↪</button>
                <span style="flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#555;">${title}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="finder-sidebar">
                <div class="fs-item active">${title}</div>
                <div class="fs-item">Applications</div>
                <div class="fs-item">Documents</div>
                <div class="fs-item">Trash</div>
              </div>
              <div class="finder-grid">${fileGrid}</div>
            `;

                const id = createWindow(title, html, {
                    width: 520,
                    height: 380,
                    className: 'finder-window',
                    left: 40 + (windowIdCounter * 12 % 100),
                    top: 30 + (windowIdCounter * 8 % 80)
                });
                return id;
            }

            // ── About Window ──
            function openAboutWindow() {
                const html = `
              <div class="about-icon-big">🍎</div>
              <div class="about-title">Mac OS 9</div>
              <div class="about-version">Version 9.2.2</div>
              <div class="about-bar"><div class="about-bar-fill"></div></div>
              <div class="about-mem">Built-in Memory: 256 MB</div>
              <div class="about-mem" style="margin-top:2px;">Virtual Memory: 512 MB</div>
              <br/>
              <button class="about-btn" onclick="this.closest('.window')?.querySelector('.close')?.click()">OK</button>
            `;
                const id = createWindow('About This Computer', html, {
                    width: 320,
                    height: 280,
                    className: 'about-box',
                    resizable: false,
                    collapsible: true,
                    left: 120,
                    top: 60
                });
                return id;
            }

            // ── Notes Window ──
            function openNotesWindow() {
                const html = `
              <textarea placeholder="Type something here…" style="width:100%;height:100%;min-height:120px;border:none;resize:none;font-family:'Chicago','Charcoal','Courier New',monospace;font-size:13px;padding:8px;background:#fffef0;outline:none;">📝 Classic Note

Welcome to Mac OS 9!
This is a nostalgic trip back to 2001.</textarea>
            `;
                const id = createWindow('Notes', html, {
                    width: 380,
                    height: 280,
                    className: 'note-window',
                    left: 160,
                    top: 80
                });
                return id;
            }

            // ── Trash Window ──
            function openTrashWindow() {
                const isEmpty = trashCount === 0;
                const html = `
              <div class="trash-icon-big ${isEmpty ? '' : 'trash-full'}">${isEmpty ? '🗑️' : '🗑️'}</div>
              ${isEmpty ? '<p class="empty-msg">Trash is empty</p>' : `<p>${trashCount} item${trashCount > 1 ? 's' : ''} in Trash</p>`}
              ${!isEmpty ? '<button class="about-btn" onclick="emptyTrash()" style="margin-top:8px;">Empty Trash…</button>' : ''}
            `;
                const id = createWindow('Trash', html, {
                    width: 280,
                    height: 200,
                    className: 'trash-window',
                    resizable: false,
                    left: 200,
                    top: 100
                });
                return id;
            }

            // ── Empty Trash ──
            window.emptyTrash = function() {
                trashCount = 0;
                updateTrashUI();
                // Close all trash windows
                Object.keys(windows).forEach(id => {
                    if (windows[id]?.el?.querySelector('.trash-icon-big')) {
                        closeWindow(id);
                    }
                });
                showModal('🗑️', 'Trash has been emptied.', null);
            };

            function updateTrashUI() {
                const icon = trashCount > 0 ? '🗑️' : '🗑️';
                trashIconDesktop.textContent = icon;
                trashIconDock.textContent = icon;
                if (trashCount > 0) {
                    trashBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
                    trashBadge.textContent = trashCount;
                } else {
                    trashBadge.classList.add('hidden');
                }
                // Update desktop icon label
                const trashDesktop = document.querySelector('.desktop-icon[data-type="trash"] .icon-img');
                if (trashDesktop) trashDesktop.textContent = icon;
            }

            // ── Add to Trash (from desktop) ──
            function addToTrash() {
                trashCount++;
                updateTrashUI();
                // animate dock
                const trashDock = dock.querySelector('.dock-icon[data-app="trash"]');
                if (trashDock) {
                    trashDock.classList.add('bounce');
                    setTimeout(() => trashDock.classList.remove('bounce'), 400);
                }
            }

            // ── Dock Apps ──
            document.querySelectorAll('.dock-icon').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    const app = this.dataset.app;
                    // bounce animation
                    this.classList.add('bounce');
                    setTimeout(() => this.classList.remove('bounce'), 350);

                    switch (app) {
                        case 'finder':
                            openFinderWindow();
                            break;
                        case 'notes':
                            openNotesWindow();
                            break;
                        case 'about':
                            openAboutWindow();
                            break;
                        case 'trash':
                            openTrashWindow();
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                });
            });

            // ── Drag files to trash (simplified: keyboard shortcut or click on desktop icon) ──
            // Double-click on desktop Trash icon to open; we can also "drag" by shift+click
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') {
                    if (selectedDesktop && selectedDesktop.dataset.type !== 'trash') {
                        const label = selectedDesktop.dataset.label || 'item';
                        addToTrash();
                        showModal('🗑️', `Moved "${label}" to Trash.`, null);
                        selectedDesktop.classList.remove('selected');
                        selectedDesktop = null;
                    }
                }
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeAllMenus();
                }
            });

            // ── Right-click context menu (simple) ──
            document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const icon = e.target.closest('.desktop-icon');
                if (icon) {
                    showModal('📋', 'Classic Mac OS context menu — New Folder, Get Info, etc.', null);
                } else {
                    showModal('📋', 'Desktop context menu — Change Desktop Background, etc.', null);
                }
            });

            // ── Expose helper for inline onclick ──
            window.handleAction = handleAction;

            // ── Start Boot ──
            boot();

            // ── Handle window resize for zoomed windows ──
            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                Object.values(windows).forEach(w => {
                    const el = w.el;
                    if (el.style.left === '0px' && el.style.top === '22px') {
                        el.style.width = (window.innerWidth - 4) + 'px';
                        el.style.height = (window.innerHeight - 90) + 'px';
                    }
                });
            });

            // ── Prevent default drag on images ──
            document.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.preventDefault());

            // ── Demo: auto-add a file to trash after 8 seconds for fun ──
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (bootDone) {
                    addToTrash();
                    // Show a little notification via modal
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        // Don't show modal, just update trash
                    }, 100);
                }
            }, 5000);

            console.log('🍎 Classic Mac OS 9 Desktop loaded!');
            console.log('💡 Double-click desktop icons to open.');
            console.log('💡 Click menus, drag windows, use Dock.');
            console.log('💡 Press Delete with a desktop icon selected to move to Trash.');

        })();
    </script>

</body>

    <script>
        (function() {
            // ==================== GLOBAL STATE ====================
            const desktop = document.getElementById('desktop');
            const bootScreen = document.getElementById('boot-screen');
            const bootProgressFill = document.getElementById('boot-progress-fill');
            const bootStatus = document.getElementById('boot-status');
            const menuClock = document.getElementById('menu-clock');
            const csClockBottom = document.getElementById('cs-clock-bottom');
            const alertOverlay = document.getElementById('alert-overlay');
            const alertIcon = document.getElementById('alert-icon');
            const alertMsg = document.getElementById('alert-msg');
            const alertOkBtn = document.getElementById('alert-ok-btn');

            let zIndexCounter = 100;
            let selectedDesktopIcon = null;
            let trashHasItems = false;
            let activeMenu = null;
            let clockFormat24 = false;
            let draggingWindow = null;
            let dragOffsetX = 0;
            let dragOffsetY = 0;
            let dragStartX = 0;
            let dragStartY = 0;
            let resizingWindow = null;
            let resizeStartW = 0;
            let resizeStartH = 0;
            let resizeStartX = 0;
            let resizeStartY = 0;
            let windowOriginalSizes = {};

            // ==================== BOOT SEQUENCE ====================
            function bootSequence() {
                let progress = 0;
                const steps = [
                    { pct: 20, msg: 'Loading System...', delay: 400 },
                    { pct: 45, msg: 'Initializing Finder...', delay: 500 },
                    { pct: 70, msg: 'Loading extensions...', delay: 600 },
                    { pct: 90, msg: 'Setting up desktop...', delay: 400 },
                    { pct: 100, msg: 'Welcome!', delay: 300 },
                ];
                let stepIndex = 0;

                function nextStep() {
                    if (stepIndex < steps.length) {
                        const step = steps[stepIndex];
                        bootProgressFill.style.width = step.pct + '%';
                        bootStatus.textContent = step.msg;
                        stepIndex++;
                        setTimeout(nextStep, step.delay);
                    } else {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            bootScreen.classList.add('hidden');
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                bootScreen.style.display = 'none';
                            }, 600);
                        }, 400);
                    }
                }
                nextStep();
            }

            // ==================== CLOCK ====================
            function updateClock() {
                const now = new Date();
                let hours = now.getHours();
                const minutes = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
                let displayTime;
                if (clockFormat24) {
                    displayTime = hours.toString().padStart(2, '0') + ':' + minutes;
                } else {
                    const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
                    hours = hours % 12 || 12;
                    displayTime = hours + ':' + minutes + ' ' + ampm;
                }
                menuClock.textContent = displayTime;
                if (csClockBottom) csClockBottom.textContent = displayTime;
            }
            setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
            updateClock();

            // ==================== MENU MANAGEMENT ====================
            const allDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu');
            const allMenuTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('#menu-bar .menu-item, #menu-bar .apple-logo');

            function closeAllMenus() {
                allDropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('show'));
                allMenuTriggers.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                activeMenu = null;
            }

            function toggleMenu(menuId, triggerEl) {
                const dropdown = document.getElementById(menuId);
                if (!dropdown) return;
                if (dropdown.classList.contains('show')) {
                    closeAllMenus();
                } else {
                    closeAllMenus();
                    dropdown.classList.add('show');
                    if (triggerEl) triggerEl.classList.add('active');
                    activeMenu = { dropdown, trigger: triggerEl };
                }
            }

            // Menu trigger clicks
            document.getElementById('menu-apple').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                toggleMenu('menu-apple-dropdown', this);
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('#menu-bar .menu-item').forEach(item => {
                item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const menuName = this.getAttribute('data-menu');
                    const dropdownId = 'menu-' + menuName + '-dropdown';
                    toggleMenu(dropdownId, this);
                });
            });

            // Dropdown item clicks
            document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu .dm-item').forEach(item => {
                item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const action = this.getAttribute('data-action');
                    handleMenuAction(action);
                    closeAllMenus();
                });
            });

            function handleMenuAction(action) {
                switch (action) {
                    case 'about':
                        openWindow('win-about');
                        break;
                    case 'open-controls':
                        openWindow('win-controls');
                        break;
                    case 'open-calculator':
                        openWindow('win-calculator');
                        break;
                    case 'open-notepad':
                        openWindow('win-notepad');
                        break;
                    case 'open-puzzle':
                        openWindow('win-puzzle');
                        break;
                    case 'open-finder':
                        openWindow('win-finder');
                        break;
                    case 'new-folder':
                        showAlert('📁', 'New folder created on desktop.');
                        break;
                    case 'move-to-trash':
                        moveToTrash();
                        break;
                    case 'empty-trash':
                        emptyTrash();
                        break;
                    case 'restart':
                        doRestart();
                        break;
                    case 'shutdown':
                        doShutdown();
                        break;
                    case 'mac-help':
                        showAlert('ℹ️', 'Mac Help: Click desktop icons to open windows. Drag title bars to move windows. Use the menus above for more options. Enjoy!');
                        break;
                    case 'about-help':
                        showAlert('🖥️',
                            'This is a nostalgic Mac OS Classic simulation built with HTML, CSS & JavaScript. All windows are draggable and interactive. Have fun exploring!');
                        break;
                    case 'clean-up':
                        showAlert('✨', 'Desktop icons have been arranged.');
                        break;
                    case 'view-icon':
                    case 'view-list':
                        showAlert('👁️', 'View changed.');
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            }

            // Close menus when clicking elsewhere
            document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (!e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu') && !e.target.closest('#menu-bar .menu-item') && !e
                    .target.closest('#menu-bar .apple-logo')) {
                    closeAllMenus();
                }
            });

            // ==================== DESKTOP ICON SELECTION ====================
            const desktopIcons = document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon');
            desktopIcons.forEach(icon => {
                icon.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    // Deselect previous
                    if (selectedDesktopIcon && selectedDesktopIcon !== this) {
                        selectedDesktopIcon.classList.remove('selected');
                    }
                    // Select this one
                    this.classList.add('selected');
                    selectedDesktopIcon = this;
                });
                icon.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const windowId = this.getAttribute('data-window');
                    if (windowId) {
                        openWindow(windowId);
                    }
                    this.classList.add('selected');
                    if (selectedDesktopIcon && selectedDesktopIcon !== this) {
                        selectedDesktopIcon.classList.remove('selected');
                    }
                    selectedDesktopIcon = this;
                });
            });

            // Click on desktop background deselects
            desktop.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === desktop || e.target.id === 'desktop') {
                    if (selectedDesktopIcon) {
                        selectedDesktopIcon.classList.remove('selected');
                        selectedDesktopIcon = null;
                    }
                    closeAllMenus();
                }
            });

            // ==================== WINDOW MANAGEMENT ====================
            function openWindow(windowId) {
                if (windowId === 'win-about') {
                    createAboutWindow();
                    return;
                }
                const win = document.getElementById(windowId);
                if (!win) return;
                // If minimized, un-minimize
                if (win.classList.contains('minimized')) {
                    win.classList.remove('minimized');
                }
                // If collapsed, uncollapse
                if (win.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    win.classList.remove('collapsed');
                }
                // Bring to front
                bringToFront(win);
                // Ensure visible
                ensureWindowVisible(win);
                // Initialize puzzle if needed
                if (windowId === 'win-puzzle' && !win.getAttribute('data-puzzle-init')) {
                    initPuzzle();
                    win.setAttribute('data-puzzle-init', 'true');
                }
                // Focus the window
                focusWindow(win);
            }

            function bringToFront(win) {
                zIndexCounter++;
                win.style.zIndex = zIndexCounter;
                // Remove focused from all windows
                document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('focused'));
                win.classList.add('focused');
            }

            function focusWindow(win) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('focused'));
                win.classList.add('focused');
                win.style.zIndex = Math.max(parseInt(win.style.zIndex) || 10, zIndexCounter);
                if (parseInt(win.style.zIndex) >= zIndexCounter) {
                    zIndexCounter = parseInt(win.style.zIndex) + 1;
                } else {
                    zIndexCounter++;
                    win.style.zIndex = zIndexCounter;
                }
            }

            function ensureWindowVisible(win) {
                const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                const vw = window.innerWidth;
                const vh = window.innerHeight;
                let left = parseInt(win.style.left) || 0;
                let top = parseInt(win.style.top) || 0;
                if (left < -rect.width + 40) left = -rect.width + 40;
                if (top < 26) top = 30;
                if (left > vw - 40) left = vw - 40;
                if (top > vh - 40) top = vh - 40;
                win.style.left = left + 'px';
                win.style.top = top + 'px';
            }

            function closeWindow(windowId) {
                const win = document.getElementById(windowId);
                if (!win) return;
                win.classList.add('minimized');
                win.classList.remove('focused');
            }

            function collapseWindow(windowId) {
                const win = document.getElementById(windowId);
                if (!win) return;
                if (win.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    win.classList.remove('collapsed');
                } else {
                    // Save current height
                    win.setAttribute('data-pre-collapse-height', win.style.height || '');
                    win.classList.add('collapsed');
                }
            }

            function zoomWindow(windowId) {
                const win = document.getElementById(windowId);
                if (!win) return;
                const key = windowId + '-zoomed';
                if (win.getAttribute('data-zoomed') === 'true') {
                    // Restore original size
                    const orig = windowOriginalSizes[windowId];
                    if (orig) {
                        win.style.width = orig.width;
                        win.style.height = orig.height;
                        win.style.top = orig.top;
                        win.style.left = orig.left;
                    }
                    win.setAttribute('data-zoomed', 'false');
                } else {
                    // Save original and zoom
                    windowOriginalSizes[windowId] = {
                        width: win.style.width || '',
                        height: win.style.height || '',
                        top: win.style.top || '',
                        left: win.style.left || '',
                    };
                    win.style.width = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 40, 600) + 'px';
                    win.style.height = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, 450) + 'px';
                    win.style.top = '40px';
                    win.style.left = '30px';
                    win.setAttribute('data-zoomed', 'true');
                }
                bringToFront(win);
            }

            // ==================== WINDOW DRAGGING ====================
            document.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                // Check if clicking a title bar
                const titleBar = e.target.closest('.title-bar');
                if (titleBar && !e.target.closest('.title-bar-btn')) {
                    const win = titleBar.closest('.window');
                    if (!win) return;
                    // Don't drag if clicking a button
                    if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('.title-bar-btn')) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    draggingWindow = win;
                    const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                    dragOffsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
                    dragOffsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;
                    dragStartX = e.clientX;
                    dragStartY = e.clientY;
                    bringToFront(win);
                    win.style.transition = 'none';
                }
                // Check if clicking resize handle
                const resizeHandle = e.target.closest('.resize-handle');
                if (resizeHandle && !draggingWindow) {
                    const win = resizeHandle.closest('.window');
                    if (!win) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    resizingWindow = win;
                    const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                    resizeStartW = rect.width;
                    resizeStartH = rect.height;
                    resizeStartX = e.clientX;
                    resizeStartY = e.clientY;
                    bringToFront(win);
                    win.style.transition = 'none';
                }
                // Click on any window brings it to front
                const clickedWindow = e.target.closest('.window');
                if (clickedWindow && !draggingWindow && !resizingWindow) {
                    if (!e.target.closest('.title-bar-btn') && !e.target.closest('button') && !e.target.closest(
                            'textarea') && !e.target.closest('input') && !e.target.closest('select') && !e.target
                        .closest('.resize-handle') && !e.target.closest('.calc-btn')) {
                        focusWindow(clickedWindow);
                    }
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                if (draggingWindow) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    let newLeft = e.clientX - dragOffsetX;
                    let newTop = e.clientY - dragOffsetY;
                    // Keep title bar accessible
                    if (newTop < -10) newTop = -10;
                    if (newLeft < -draggingWindow.offsetWidth + 30) newLeft = -draggingWindow.offsetWidth + 30;
                    if (newLeft > window.innerWidth - 30) newLeft = window.innerWidth - 30;
                    if (newTop > window.innerHeight - 10) newTop = window.innerHeight - 10;
                    draggingWindow.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
                    draggingWindow.style.top = newTop + 'px';
                }
                if (resizingWindow) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const dx = e.clientX - resizeStartX;
                    const dy = e.clientY - resizeStartY;
                    const newW = Math.max(160, resizeStartW + dx);
                    const newH = Math.max(80, resizeStartH + dy);
                    resizingWindow.style.width = newW + 'px';
                    resizingWindow.style.height = newH + 'px';
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('mouseup', function(e) {
                if (draggingWindow) {
                    draggingWindow.style.transition = '';
                    draggingWindow = null;
                }
                if (resizingWindow) {
                    resizingWindow.style.transition = '';
                    resizingWindow = null;
                }
            });

            // ==================== TITLE BAR BUTTONS ====================
            document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                const btn = e.target.closest('.title-bar-btn');
                if (!btn) return;
                e.stopPropagation();
                e.preventDefault();
                const action = btn.getAttribute('data-action');
                const windowId = btn.getAttribute('data-window-id');
                if (!windowId) return;
                switch (action) {
                    case 'close':
                        closeWindow(windowId);
                        break;
                    case 'collapse':
                        collapseWindow(windowId);
                        break;
                    case 'zoom':
                        zoomWindow(windowId);
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            });

            // ==================== ABOUT WINDOW ====================
            function createAboutWindow() {
                // Check if already exists
                let aboutWin = document.getElementById('win-about');
                if (aboutWin) {
                    openWindow('win-about');
                    return;
                }
                aboutWin = document.createElement('div');
                aboutWin.className = 'window';
                aboutWin.id = 'win-about';
                aboutWin.style.cssText = 'top:120px;left:150px;width:340px;height:260px;';
                aboutWin.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="title-bar" data-window-id="win-about">
                        <div class="title-bar-buttons">
                            <div class="title-bar-btn close-btn" data-action="close" data-window-id="win-about"></div>
                            <div class="title-bar-btn collapse-btn" data-action="collapse" data-window-id="win-about"></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="title-bar-title">About This Macintosh</div>
                        <div class="title-bar-buttons" style="padding-left:0;padding-right:6px;">
                            <div class="title-bar-btn zoom-btn" data-action="zoom" data-window-id="win-about"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="window-content">
                        <div class="about-content">
                            <div class="about-icon">🍎</div>
                            <h2>Mac OS Classic</h2>
                            <p>Version 8.6<br>System Software 8.6.1<br><br>© 1999 Apple Computer, Inc.<br>All Rights Reserved</p>
                            <p style="font-size:10px;color:#666;">Retro Simulation<br>Built with HTML, CSS & JavaScript</p>
                            <button class="about-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('win-about').classList.add('minimized')">OK</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="resize-handle" data-window-id="win-about"></div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(aboutWin);
                bringToFront(aboutWin);
                ensureWindowVisible(aboutWin);
            }

            // ==================== CALCULATOR ====================
            let calcExpression = '';
            const calcDisplay = document.getElementById('calc-display');

            window.calcInput = function(val) {
                if (calcExpression === '0' && val !== '.') calcExpression = '';
                calcExpression += val;
                calcDisplay.textContent = calcExpression;
            };
            window.calcClear = function() {
                calcExpression = '';
                calcDisplay.textContent = '0';
            };
            window.calcCompute = function() {
                try {
                    let expr = calcExpression.replace(/×/g, '*').replace(/÷/g, '/').replace(/−/g, '-');
                    const result = eval(expr);
                    if (result === undefined || result === null || isNaN(result)) {
                        calcDisplay.textContent = 'Error';
                    } else {
                        calcDisplay.textContent = parseFloat(result.toFixed(8));
                    }
                    calcExpression = calcDisplay.textContent;
                } catch (e) {
                    calcDisplay.textContent = 'Error';
                    calcExpression = '';
                }
            };

            // ==================== PUZZLE GAME ====================
            let puzzleTiles = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0]; // 0 = empty
            const puzzleGrid = document.getElementById('puzzle-grid');
            const puzzleWinMsg = document.getElementById('puzzle-win-msg');

            function initPuzzle() {
                shufflePuzzle();
            }

            function renderPuzzle() {
                if (!puzzleGrid) return;
                puzzleGrid.innerHTML = '';
                puzzleTiles.forEach((tile, index) => {
                    const cell = document.createElement('div');
                    cell.style.cssText = `
                        width:60px;height:60px;
                        display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
                        font-size:20px;font-weight:bold;
                        border-radius:4px;
                        cursor:${tile===0?'default':'pointer'};
                        background:${tile===0?'transparent':'#e8e8e8'};
                        border:${tile===0?'2px dashed #ccc':'2px solid #555'};
                        color:#000;
                        box-shadow:${tile===0?'none':'inset 0 0 0 1px #fff'};
                        transition: all 0.1s ease;
                    `;
                    cell.textContent = tile === 0 ? '' : tile;
                    cell.addEventListener('click', () => moveTile(index));
                    puzzleGrid.appendChild(cell);
                });
                // Check win
                if (puzzleTiles.join(',') === '1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,0') {
                    if (puzzleWinMsg) puzzleWinMsg.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    if (puzzleWinMsg) puzzleWinMsg.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            function moveTile(index) {
                const emptyIndex = puzzleTiles.indexOf(0);
                const validMoves = [
                    emptyIndex - 1, emptyIndex + 1, emptyIndex - 3, emptyIndex + 3
                ];
                // Check bounds
                const filtered = validMoves.filter(i => {
                    if (i < 0 || i > 8) return false;
                    // Prevent wrapping rows
                    if ((emptyIndex % 3 === 0 && i === emptyIndex - 1)) return false;
                    if ((emptyIndex % 3 === 2 && i === emptyIndex + 1)) return false;
                    return true;
                });
                if (filtered.includes(index)) {
                    [puzzleTiles[index], puzzleTiles[emptyIndex]] = [puzzleTiles[emptyIndex], puzzleTiles[index]];
                    renderPuzzle();
                }
            }

            function shufflePuzzle() {
                // Fisher-Yates shuffle, then ensure solvability
                do {
                    const arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0];
                    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
                    }
                    puzzleTiles = arr;
                } while (!isSolvable(puzzleTiles) || puzzleTiles.join(',') === '1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,0');
                renderPuzzle();
            }

            function isSolvable(tiles) {
                let inversions = 0;
                const arr = tiles.filter(t => t !== 0);
                for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                        if (arr[i] > arr[j]) inversions++;
                    }
                }
                return inversions % 2 === 0;
            }
            window.shufflePuzzle = shufflePuzzle;
            renderPuzzle();

            // ==================== TRASH ====================
            function moveToTrash() {
                trashHasItems = true;
                updateTrashAppearance();
                showAlert('🗑️', 'Item moved to Trash.');
            }

            function emptyTrash() {
                if (trashHasItems) {
                    trashHasItems = false;
                    updateTrashAppearance();
                    showAlert('✨', 'Trash has been emptied.');
                } else {
                    showAlert('🗑️', 'Trash is already empty.');
                }
            }
            window.emptyTrash = emptyTrash;

            function updateTrashAppearance() {
                const trashIcon = document.getElementById('trash-icon');
                const trashContentIcon = document.getElementById('trash-content-icon');
                const trashStatusText = document.getElementById('trash-status-text');
                const emptyTrashBtn = document.getElementById('empty-trash-btn');
                if (trashHasItems) {
                    if (trashIcon) trashIcon.textContent = '🗑️';
                    if (trashContentIcon) trashContentIcon.textContent = '📦';
                    if (trashStatusText) trashStatusText.textContent = 'Trash contains items';
                    if (emptyTrashBtn) emptyTrashBtn.disabled = false;
                } else {
                    if (trashIcon) trashIcon.textContent = '🗑️';
                    if (trashContentIcon) trashContentIcon.textContent = '🗑️';
                    if (trashStatusText) trashStatusText.textContent = 'Trash is empty';
                    if (emptyTrashBtn) emptyTrashBtn.disabled = true;
                }
            }
            updateTrashAppearance();

            // ==================== RESTART / SHUTDOWN ====================
            function doRestart() {
                showAlertCustom('🔄', 'Are you sure you want to restart?', function() {
                    // Simulate restart
                    document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => {
                        w.classList.add('minimized');
                        w.classList.remove('focused', 'collapsed');
                    });
                    trashHasItems = false;
                    updateTrashAppearance();
                    calcExpression = '';
                    if (calcDisplay) calcDisplay.textContent = '0';
                    bootScreen.style.display = 'flex';
                    bootScreen.classList.remove('hidden');
                    bootProgressFill.style.width = '0%';
                    bootStatus.textContent = 'Restarting...';
                    zIndexCounter = 100;
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        bootSequence();
                    }, 300);
                });
            }

            function doShutdown() {
                showAlertCustom('👋', 'Are you sure you want to shut down?', function() {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => {
                        w.classList.add('minimized');
                        w.classList.remove('focused', 'collapsed');
                    });
                    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
                    overlay.style.cssText = `
                        position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;
                        background:#000;z-index:99999;display:flex;
                        align-items:center;justify-content:center;
                        transition:opacity 0.5s;
                    `;
                    overlay.innerHTML =
                        '<p style="color:#fff;font-size:18px;font-family:monospace;">It is now safe to close this page.</p>';
                    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        overlay.style.opacity = '0';
                        setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 500);
                    }, 2500);
                });
            }

            // ==================== ALERT SYSTEM ====================
            function showAlert(icon, msg) {
                alertIcon.textContent = icon;
                alertMsg.textContent = msg;
                alertOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
                alertOkBtn.focus();
            }

            function showAlertCustom(icon, msg, callback) {
                alertIcon.textContent = icon;
                alertMsg.textContent = msg;
                alertOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
                alertOkBtn.onclick = function() {
                    alertOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                    if (callback) callback();
                };
                alertOkBtn.focus();
            }

            alertOkBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                alertOverlay.style.display = 'none';
            });
            alertOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === alertOverlay) {
                    alertOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });

            // ==================== CLOCK FORMAT CHANGE ====================
            const clockFormatSelect = document.getElementById('clock-format-select');
            if (clockFormatSelect) {
                clockFormatSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
                    clockFormat24 = this.value === '24';
                    updateClock();
                });
            }

            // ==================== KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS ====================
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    closeAllMenus();
                    if (alertOverlay.style.display === 'flex') {
                        alertOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
                // Cmd+W or Ctrl+W to close focused window
                if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'w') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const focused = document.querySelector('.window.focused');
                    if (focused && focused.id) {
                        closeWindow(focused.id);
                    }
                }
            });

            // ==================== INITIAL SETUP ====================
            function initializeDesktop() {
                // Hide all windows initially except Finder
                const allWindows = document.querySelectorAll('.window');
                allWindows.forEach(w => {
                    if (w.id !== 'win-finder') {
                        w.classList.add('minimized');
                    }
                });
                // Show Finder
                const finder = document.getElementById('win-finder');
                if (finder) {
                    finder.classList.remove('minimized');
                    bringToFront(finder);
                }
                // Initialize puzzle
                renderPuzzle();
                updateTrashAppearance();
            }

            // ==================== STARTUP ====================
            function start() {
                initializeDesktop();
                bootSequence();
                updateClock();
            }

            // Handle window resize to keep windows in bounds
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.window:not(.minimized)').forEach(win => {
                    ensureWindowVisible(win);
                });
            });

            // Start the experience
            start();

            console.log('🍎 Mac OS Classic - Retro Desktop Ready!');
            console.log('  Double-click desktop icons to open windows.');
            console.log('  Drag title bars to move windows.');
            console.log('  Resize from bottom-right corner.');
            console.log('  Use the menu bar for more options.');
            console.log('  Try the Puzzle Game & Calculator!');
            console.log('  Press Escape to dismiss alerts/menus.');
            console.log('  Enjoy the nostalgia! ✨');
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
