}

function openTrash() {
  showAlert('Trash', 'The Trash is empty! 🗑️');
}

function restartMac() {
  closeAllMenus();
  closeAllWindows();
  playBonkSound();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s';
    document.body.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.body.style.opacity = '1';
      bootStep = 0;
      document.getElementById('boot-progress-bar').style.width = '0%';
      document.getElementById('boot-text').textContent = '';
      const screen = document.getElementById('boot-screen');
      screen.style.display = 'flex';
      screen.classList.remove('fade-out');
      bootSequence();
    }, 500);
  }, 300);
}

function shutdownMac() {
  closeAllMenus();
  closeAllWindows();
  playBonkSound();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.style.transition = 'opacity 1s';
    document.body.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;background:#000;color:#8fbc8f;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;">
          <div style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:20px;">🍎</div>
          <div style="font-size:14px;">It is now safe to close your browser tab.</div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;opacity:0.5;">Goodbye! 👋</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }, 1000);
  }, 300);
}

function doUndo() { closeAllMenus(); showAlert('Edit', 'Undo — Nothing to undo!'); }
function doCut() {
  closeAllMenus();
  const sel = window.getSelection().toString();
  if (sel) { clipboard.unshift(sel); }
}
function doCopy() {
  closeAllMenus();
  const sel = window.getSelection().toString();
  if (sel) { clipboard.unshift(sel); showAlert('Edit', 'Copied to clipboard! 📋'); }
}
function doPaste() { closeAllMenus(); showAlert('Edit', 'Paste — Clipboard is empty!'); }
function doSelectAll() { closeAllMenus(); document.execCommand('selectAll'); }

// ===== Easter Eggs =====
function easterEggSnow() {
  closeAllMenus();
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const flake = document.createElement('div');
      flake.className = 'snowflake';
      flake.textContent = '❄';
      flake.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
      flake.style.top = '-20px';
      flake.style.fontSize = (10 + Math.random() * 14) + 'px';
      flake.style.animationDuration = (3 + Math.random() * 4) + 's';
      flake.style.opacity = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      document.body.appendChild(flake);
      setTimeout(() => flake.remove(), 7000);
    }, i * 100);
  }
}

function easterEggConfetti() {
  const colors = ['#f44', '#4f4', '#44f', '#ff4', '#f4f', '#4ff', '#fa0', '#0af'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const conf = document.createElement('div');
      conf.className = 'confetti';
      conf.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
      conf.style.top = '-10px';
      conf.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
      conf.style.width = (4 + Math.random() * 8) + 'px';
      conf.style.height = (4 + Math.random() * 8) + 'px';
      conf.style.borderRadius = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '50%' : '0';
      conf.style.animationDuration = (2 + Math.random() * 3) + 's';
      document.body.appendChild(conf);
      setTimeout(() => conf.remove(), 5000);
    }, i * 30);
  }
}

// Konami code
let konamiSequence = [];
const konamiCode = [38,38,40,40,37,39,37,39,66,65];
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  konamiSequence.push(e.keyCode);
  if (konamiSequence.length > 10) konamiSequence.shift();
  if (konamiSequence.join(',') === konamiCode.join(',')) {
    document.body.classList.toggle('rainbow-mode');
    easterEggConfetti();
    showAlert('🌈 Konami Code!', 'Rainbow mode activated! 🎉');
    konamiSequence = [];
  }
});

// ===== Keyboard Shortcuts =====
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) {
    switch(e.key.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'o': e.preventDefault(); openFinder(); break;
      case 'c':
        if (e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); openCalculator(); }
        break;
      case 't': e.preventDefault(); openTextEdit(); break;
      case 'k': e.preventDefault(); openClock(); break;
      case 'm': e.preventDefault(); openMinesweeper(); break;
    }
  }
});

// ===== Start Boot =====
window.addEventListener('load', bootSequence);

// Prevent context menu on desktop
document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
  if (e.target.closest('#desktop') && !e.target.closest('.window')) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

    align-items: center;
    width: 80px;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: default;
    text-align: center;

  .file-item:hover {

  .file-item.selected {

  .file-item .file-icon {

    padding: 8px 12px;
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    line-height: 1.5;

  .terminal-line {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-all;

  .terminal-prompt {
    color: #33ff33;
  }

  .terminal-input-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .terminal-input {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: #33ff33;
    font-family: 'Menlo', 'Monaco', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
    flex: 1;
    caret-color: #33ff33;

    height: 15px;

    vertical-align: text-bottom;

  /* Calculator */
  .calc-display {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 36px;
    text-align: right;

    overflow: hidden;

  .calc-buttons {

    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: #333;
  }

  .calc-btn {
    padding: 16px;
    font-size: 18px;
    border: none;
    cursor: default;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: all 0.1s;
  }

  .calc-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }

  .calc-btn.num {
    background: #505050;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .calc-btn.num:hover {
    background: #606060;
  }

  .calc-btn.op {
    background: #ff9500;
    color: #fff;

  }

  .calc-btn.op:hover {

  }

  .calc-btn.op.active {
    background: #fff;
    color: #ff9500;

  .calc-btn.func {
    background: #a5a5a5;
    color: #000;
  }

  .calc-btn.func:hover {
    background: #b5b5b5;
  }

  .calc-btn.zero {
    grid-column: span 2;

    padding-left: 28px;

  /* TextEdit */
  .textedit-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

  .textedit-area {

    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 13px;
    cursor: default;
    color: #333;
  }

  /* System Preferences */
  .syspref-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 30px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #f0f0f0, #e0e0e0);
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .syspref-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 12px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .syspref-item:hover {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  .syspref-item .sp-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 24px;
  }

  .syspref-item .sp-name {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #333;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* Dock */
  #dock {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 4px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    border-radius: 16px;
    z-index: 9999;
  }

  .dock-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: default;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    position: relative;
  }

  .dock-item .dock-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 32px;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  }

  .dock-item:hover .dock-icon {
    transform: scale(1.3) translateY(-8px);
  }

  .dock-item:hover .dock-tooltip {
    display: block;
  }

  .dock-tooltip {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: -32px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .dock-item .dock-dot {
    width: 4px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    margin-top: 2px;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }

  .dock-item.active .dock-dot {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .dock-separator {
    width: 1px;
    height: 36px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    margin: 0 4px;
    align-self: center;
  }

  /* Context Menu */
  #context-menu {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    min-width: 200px;
    background: rgba(40,40,40,0.97);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    padding: 4px 0;
    z-index: 20000;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  }

  #context-menu.show {
    display: block;
  }

  .ctx-item {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 4px 20px;
    cursor: default;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .ctx-item:hover {
    background: #2563eb;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin: 0 4px;
    padding: 4px 16px;
  }

  .ctx-separator {
    height: 1px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    margin: 4px 12px;
  }

  /* Spotlight */
  #spotlight-overlay {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    z-index: 15000;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-top: 200px;
  }

  #spotlight-overlay.show {
    display: flex;
  }

  #spotlight {
    width: 560px;
    background: rgba(40,40,40,0.95);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  #spotlight-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    font-size: 20px;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }

  #spotlight-input::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }

  #spotlight-results {
    max-height: 300px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .spotlight-result {
    padding: 8px 20px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
    cursor: default;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .spotlight-result:hover, .spotlight-result.selected {
    background: #2563eb;
  }

  .spotlight-result .sr-icon {
    font-size: 20px;
  }

  /* Notification */
  .notification {
    position: fixed;
    top: 36px;
    right: 12px;
    width: 320px;
    background: rgba(50,50,50,0.95);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    z-index: 11000;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    animation: notifSlide 0.4s ease-out;
    color: #fff;
  }

  @keyframes notifSlide {
    from { transform: translateX(400px); opacity: 0; }
    to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
  }

  .notification .notif-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .notification .notif-app {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  }

  .notification .notif-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .notification .notif-body {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* Scrollbar */
  ::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  /* Paint App */
  .paint-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #f5f5f5, #e8e8e8);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .paint-toolbar label {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #555;
  }

  .paint-toolbar input[type="color"] {
    width: 30px;
    height: 24px;
    border: 1px solid #aaa;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .paint-toolbar input[type="range"] {
    width: 80px;
  }

  .paint-canvas {
    cursor: crosshair;
    display: block;
  }

  /* Safari-like browser */
  .safari-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #f5f5f5, #e8e8e8);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .safari-toolbar button {
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fff, #e8e8e8);
    border: 1px solid #aaa;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .safari-url {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #ccc;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 13px;
    text-align: center;
    background: #fff;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }

  .safari-content {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 30px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: #fff;
  }

  .safari-content h1 {
    font-size: 28px;
    color: #333;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  .safari-content p {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  /* Login screen */
  #login-screen {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 25%, #0f3460 50%, #533483 75%, #e94560 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 50000;
    transition: opacity 0.5s, transform 0.5s;

  #login-screen.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.1);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .login-avatar {
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 40px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  .login-name {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .login-password {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 14px;
    width: 220px;
    text-align: center;
    outline: none;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .login-password::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  .login-hint {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    font-size: 11px;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  /* Image Viewer */
  .image-viewer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100%;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .image-viewer .iv-image {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  /* Music Player */
  .music-player {
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #2a2a2a, #1a1a1a);
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .music-album {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 64px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);

  }

  .music-album.playing {
    animation-play-state: running;
  }

  @keyframes albumSpin {
    from { transform: rotate(0deg); }

  }

  .music-info {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .music-info .song-title {

    font-weight: 600;

  .music-info .song-artist {

  .music-progress {

    height: 4px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-radius: 2px;

  .music-progress-bar {
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 2px;

  }

  .music-time {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 80%;

    font-size: 11px;

  .music-controls {

  .music-controls button {

    color: #fff;

    cursor: default;
    opacity: 0.8;

  }

  .music-controls button:hover {

  }

  .music-controls .play-btn {
    font-size: 32px;
    opacity: 1;
  }
</style>

<script>
// ===== GLOBAL STATE =====
let windowZIndex = 100;
let activeWindowId = null;
let openWindows = {};
let currentWallpaper = 0;
const wallpapers = [
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 25%, #0f3460 50%, #533483 75%, #e94560 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #0c0c1d 0%, #1a1a3e 25%, #2d1b69 50%, #11998e 75%, #38ef7d 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #0f0c29, #302b63, #24243e)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 50%, #4facfe 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #fa709a 0%, #fee140 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #a18cd1 0%, #fbc2eb 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #ffecd2 0%, #fcb69f 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #2c3e50 0%, #3498db 100%)',
  'linear-gradient(135deg, #000428 0%, #004e92 100%)',
];

// ===== CLOCK =====
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  const days = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
  const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const h = now.getHours();
  const m = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h % 12 || 12;
  document.getElementById('menu-clock').textContent = `${days[now.getDay()]} ${months[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}  ${h12}:${m} ${ampm}`;
}
setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
updateClock();

// ===== LOGIN SCREEN =====
document.getElementById('login-password').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => {
      showNotification('System', 'Welcome Back', 'Your macOS desktop is ready.');
    }, 500);
  }
});

function lockScreen() {
  const ls = document.getElementById('login-screen');
  ls.classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('login-password').value = '';
  document.getElementById('login-password').focus();
}

// ===== MENU BAR =====
function toggleMenu(id) {
  const menu = document.getElementById(id);
  const isOpen = menu.classList.contains('show');
  closeMenus();
  if (!isOpen) {
    menu.classList.add('show');
  }
}

function closeMenus() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('show'));
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (!e.target.closest('.menu-item') && !e.target.closest('.dropdown')) {
    closeMenus();
  }
  if (!e.target.closest('#context-menu')) {
    document.getElementById('context-menu').classList.remove('show');
  }
});

// ===== CONTEXT MENU =====
document.getElementById('desktop').addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) {
  if (e.target.closest('.window') || e.target.closest('#dock')) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const ctx = document.getElementById('context-menu');
  ctx.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
  ctx.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  ctx.classList.add('show');
});

// ===== WALLPAPER =====
function changeWallpaper() {
  currentWallpaper = (currentWallpaper + 1) % wallpapers.length;
  document.getElementById('desktop').style.background = wallpapers[currentWallpaper];
  closeMenus();
  showNotification('System', 'Wallpaper Changed', 'Your desktop wallpaper has been updated.');
}

// ===== SPOTLIGHT =====
function toggleSpotlight() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('spotlight-overlay');
  overlay.classList.toggle('show');
  if (overlay.classList.contains('show')) {
    document.getElementById('spotlight-input').value = '';
    document.getElementById('spotlight-input').focus();
    document.getElementById('spotlight-results').innerHTML = '';
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === ' ' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleSpotlight();
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('spotlight-overlay');
    if (overlay.classList.contains('show')) {
      toggleSpotlight();
    }
  }
});

const spotlightApps = [
  { name: 'Finder', icon: '📁', app: 'finder' },
  { name: 'Safari', icon: '🧭', app: 'safari' },
  { name: 'Terminal', icon: '⬛', app: 'terminal' },
  { name: 'Calculator', icon: '🔢', app: 'calculator' },
  { name: 'TextEdit', icon: '📝', app: 'textedit' },
  { name: 'Paint', icon: '🎨', app: 'paint' },
  { name: 'Music', icon: '🎵', app: 'music' },
  { name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', app: 'photos' },
  { name: 'System Preferences', icon: '⚙️', app: 'syspref' },
  { name: 'About This Mac', icon: '💻', app: 'about' },
];

function spotlightSearch(query) {
  const results = document.getElementById('spotlight-results');
  if (!query) {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const filtered = spotlightApps.filter(a => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));
  results.innerHTML = filtered.map((a, i) =>
    `<div class="spotlight-result ${i === 0 ? 'selected' : ''}" onclick="openApp('${a.app}'); toggleSpotlight();">
      <span class="sr-icon">${a.icon}</span> ${a.name}
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

// ===== NOTIFICATIONS =====
function showNotification(app, title, body) {
  const notif = document.createElement('div');
  notif.className = 'notification';
  notif.innerHTML = `
    <div class="notif-header">
      <span>${app === 'System' ? '⚙️' : '📱'}</span>
      <span class="notif-app">${app}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="notif-title">${title}</div>
    <div class="notif-body">${body}</div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(notif);
  setTimeout(() => {
    notif.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s';
    notif.style.opacity = '0';
    notif.style.transform = 'translateX(400px)';
    setTimeout(() => notif.remove(), 300);
  }, 4000);
}

// ===== WINDOW MANAGEMENT =====
function createWindow(id, title, width, height, content, options = {}) {
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    focusWindow(id);
    const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
    if (win && win.style.display === 'none') {
      win.style.display = 'flex';
      win.classList.add('opening');
      setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove('opening'), 300);
    }
    return;
  }

  const win = document.createElement('div');
  win.className = 'window opening';
  win.id = 'win-' + id;
  win.style.width = width + 'px';
  win.style.height = height + 'px';
  win.style.left = (window.innerWidth / 2 - width / 2 + Math.random() * 60 - 30) + 'px';
  win.style.top = (window.innerHeight / 2 - height / 2 + Math.random() * 60 - 30) + 'px';
  win.style.zIndex = ++windowZIndex;

  win.innerHTML = `
    <div class="window-titlebar" onmousedown="startDrag(event, '${id}')">
      <div class="window-controls">
        <button class="win-btn close" onclick="closeWindow('${id}')" title="Close">✕</button>
        <button class="win-btn minimize" onclick="minimizeWindow('${id}')" title="Minimize">−</button>
        <button class="win-btn maximize" onclick="maximizeWindow('${id}')" title="Zoom">+</button>
      </div>
      <div class="window-title">${title}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="window-body">${content}</div>
    <div class="resize-handle" onmousedown="startResize(event, '${id}')"></div>
  `;

  win.addEventListener('mousedown', () => focusWindow(id));
  document.getElementById('windows-container').appendChild(win);
  openWindows[id] = { element: win, minimized: false, maximized: false, prevBounds: null };
  focusWindow(id);
  updateDockDots();

  setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove('opening'), 300);

  if (options.onInit) options.onInit(win);
}

function focusWindow(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('focused'));
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  if (win) {
    win.style.zIndex = ++windowZIndex;
    win.classList.add('focused');
    activeWindowId = id;
  }
}

function closeWindow(id) {
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  if (win) {
    win.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s';
    win.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
    win.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => {
      win.remove();
      delete openWindows[id];
      updateDockDots();
    }, 200);
  }
}

function minimizeWindow(id) {
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  if (win) {
    win.classList.add('minimizing');
    setTimeout(() => {
      win.style.display = 'none';
      win.classList.remove('minimizing');
      openWindows[id].minimized = true;
    }, 400);
  }
}

function maximizeWindow(id) {
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  if (!win) return;
  const state = openWindows[id];

  if (state.maximized) {
    win.style.left = state.prevBounds.left;
    win.style.top = state.prevBounds.top;
    win.style.width = state.prevBounds.width;
    win.style.height = state.prevBounds.height;
    win.style.borderRadius = '10px';
    state.maximized = false;
  } else {
    state.prevBounds = {
      left: win.style.left,
      top: win.style.top,
      width: win.style.width,
      height: win.style.height
    };
    win.style.left = '0px';
    win.style.top = '28px';
    win.style.width = '100vw';
    win.style.height = 'calc(100vh - 28px)';
    win.style.borderRadius = '0';
    state.maximized = true;
  }
}

function updateDockDots() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dock-item').forEach(item => {
    item.classList.remove('active');
  });
  Object.keys(openWindows).forEach(id => {
    const dockItems = document.querySelectorAll('.dock-item');
    dockItems.forEach(item => {
      const tooltip = item.querySelector('.dock-tooltip');
      if (tooltip && appNames[id] && tooltip.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(appNames[id].toLowerCase())) {
        item.classList.add('active');
      }
    });
  });
}

const appNames = {
  finder: 'Finder', safari: 'Safari', terminal: 'Terminal', calculator: 'Calculator',
  textedit: 'TextEdit', paint: 'Paint', music: 'Music', photos: 'Photos',
  syspref: 'System Preferences', about: 'About This Mac', notes: 'TextEdit'
};

// ===== DRAGGING =====
let dragState = null;

function startDrag(e, id) {
  if (e.target.closest('.win-btn')) return;
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  if (openWindows[id] && openWindows[id].maximized) return;

  dragState = {
    id,
    startX: e.clientX,
    startY: e.clientY,
    startLeft: parseInt(win.style.left),
    startTop: parseInt(win.style.top)
  };
  focusWindow(id);
  e.preventDefault();
}

document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  if (dragState) {
    const win = document.getElementById('win-' + dragState.id);
    if (win) {
      win.style.left = (dragState.startLeft + e.clientX - dragState.startX) + 'px';
      win.style.top = (dragState.startTop + e.clientY - dragState.startY) + 'px';
    }
  }
  if (resizeState) {
    const win = document.getElementById('win-' + resizeState.id);
    if (win) {
      const newW = Math.max(300, resizeState.startW + e.clientX - resizeState.startX);
      const newH = Math.max(200, resizeState.startH + e.clientY - resizeState.startY);
      win.style.width = newW + 'px';
      win.style.height = newH + 'px';
    }
  }
});

document.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
  dragState = null;
  resizeState = null;
});

// ===== RESIZING =====
let resizeState = null;

function startResize(e, id) {
  const win = document.getElementById('win-' + id);
  resizeState = {
    id,
    startX: e.clientX,
    startY: e.clientY,
    startW: win.offsetWidth,
    startH: win.offsetHeight
  };
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
}

// ===== APP DEFINITIONS =====
function openApp(appId) {
  closeMenus();
  if (openWindows[appId] && !openWindows[appId].minimized) {
    focusWindow(appId);
    return;
  }
  if (openWindows[appId] && openWindows[appId].minimized) {
    const win = document.getElementById('win-' + appId);
    win.style.display = 'flex';
    win.classList.add('opening');
    setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove('opening'), 300);
    openWindows[appId].minimized = false;
    focusWindow(appId);
    return;
  }

  switch(appId) {
    case 'finder': openFinder(); break;
    case 'safari': openSafari(); break;
    case 'terminal': openTerminal(); break;
    case 'calculator': openCalculator(); break;
    case 'textedit': openTextEdit(); break;
    case 'paint': openPaint(); break;
    case 'music': openMusic(); break;
    case 'photos': openPhotos(); break;
    case 'syspref': openSysPrefs(); break;
    case 'about': openAbout(); break;
    case 'notes': openTextEdit(); break;
    case 'trash': openFinder(); break;
  }
}

// ===== FINDER =====

// ===== SAFARI =====
function openSafari() {

    <div class="safari-toolbar">

// ===== TERMINAL =====
function openTerminal() {
  const content = `
    <div class="terminal-body" id="terminal-body-${Date.now()}" onclick="this.querySelector('.terminal-input')?.focus()">
      <div class="terminal-line" style="color:#aaa;">Last login: ${new Date().toString()}</div>
      <div class="terminal-input-line" style="margin-top:4px;">
        <span class="terminal-prompt">user@MacBook ~ % </span>
        <input class="terminal-input" type="text" autofocus onkeydown="handleTerminal(event, this)">
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  createWindow('terminal', 'Terminal — zsh', 650, 400, content, {
    onInit: (win) => {

function handleTerminal(e, input) {

    case 'neofetch':
      output = `                    'c.          user@MacBook

     .;loddo:' loolloddol;.     Kernel: Darwin 22.0.0

 XMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMX.     CPU: Apple M1

:MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM:

      break;
    case 'help':
      output = 'Available commands: ls, pwd, whoami, date, echo, clear, uname, neofetch, cal, cowsay, fortune, matrix, whoami';
      break;
    case 'cal':
      const now = new Date();
      output = `     ${['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'][now.getMonth()]} ${now.getFullYear()}\nSu Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa\n`;
      const firstDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).getDay();
      const daysInMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
      let line = '   '.repeat(firstDay);
      for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
        line += (d < 10 ? ' ' : '') + d + ' ';
        if ((firstDay + d) % 7 === 0) line += '\n';
      }
      output += line;
      break;
    case 'cowsay':
      const msg = cmd.substring(7) || 'Moo!';
      const border = '-'.repeat(msg.length + 2);
      output = ` ${border}\n< ${msg} >\n ${border}\n        \\   ^__^\n         \\  (oo)\\_______\n            (__)\\       )\\/\\\n                ||----w |\n                ||     ||`;
      break;
    case 'fortune':
      const fortunes = [

      output = `${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()} up ${Math.floor(Math.random()*30)} days, ${Math.floor(Math.random()*24)}:${String(Math.floor(Math.random()*60)).padStart(2,'0')}, 1 user`;

  addTerminalPrompt(body);

function calcNum(n) {
  const display = document.getElementById('calc-display');
  if (!display) return;
  if (calcReset) {
    calcDisplay = n === '.' ? '0.' : n;
    calcReset = false;
  } else {
    if (n === '.' && calcDisplay.includes('.')) return;
    calcDisplay = calcDisplay === '0' && n !== '.' ? n : calcDisplay + n;
  }
  display.textContent = calcDisplay;
}

function calcSetOp(op) {
  const display = document.getElementById('calc-display');
  if (!display) return;
  if (calcPrev !== null && !calcReset) {
    calcEquals();
  }
  calcPrev = parseFloat(calcDisplay);
  calcOp = op;
  calcReset = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn.op').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  event.target.classList.add('active');
}

function calcEquals() {
  const display = document.getElementById('calc-display');
  if (!display || calcPrev === null || !calcOp) return;
  const curr = parseFloat(calcDisplay);
  let result;
  switch(calcOp) {
    case '+': result = calcPrev + curr; break;
    case '-': result = calcPrev - curr; break;
    case '*': result = calcPrev * curr; break;
    case '/': result = curr === 0 ? 'Error' : calcPrev / curr; break;
  }
  calcDisplay = typeof result === 'number' ? String(parseFloat(result.toFixed(10))) : result;
  calcPrev = null;
  calcOp = null;
  calcReset = true;
  display.textContent = calcDisplay;
  document.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn.op').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
}

function calcFunc(fn) {
  const display = document.getElementById('calc-display');
  if (!display) return;
  switch(fn) {
    case 'AC':
      calcDisplay = '0';
      calcPrev = null;
      calcOp = null;
      calcReset = false;
      document.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn.op').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      break;
    case '±':
      calcDisplay = String(-parseFloat(calcDisplay));
      break;
    case '%':
      calcDisplay = String(parseFloat(calcDisplay) / 100);
      break;
  }
  display.textContent = calcDisplay;
}

        let drawing = false;
        let lastX, lastY;

        const colorInput = document.getElementById(id + '-color');
        const sizeInput = document.getElementById(id + '-size');
        const sizeVal = document.getElementById(id + '-size-val');

        sizeInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
          sizeVal.textContent = sizeInput.value + 'px';

        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
          drawing = true;
          const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          lastX = e.clientX - rect.left;
          lastY = e.clientY - rect.top;
        });

        canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          if (!drawing) return;
          const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
          const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
          const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(lastX, lastY);
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = colorInput.value;
          ctx.lineWidth = sizeInput.value;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
          ctx.stroke();

          lastX = x;
          lastY = y;
        });

        canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => drawing = false);
        canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => drawing = false);
      }, 100);
    }
  });
}

  /* ===== DESKTOP ===== */
  #desktop {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a6fa5 0%, #6b8fc5 25%, #4a6fa5 50%, #5a7fb5 75%, #4a6fa5 100%);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Desktop pattern */
  #desktop::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: 
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ===== MENU BAR ===== */
  #menu-bar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 24px;
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mac-gray-dark);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 10000;
    padding: 0 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  .menu-apple {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0 2px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .menu-apple:hover {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  .menu-apple svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }

  .menu-item {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    font-weight: normal;
  }

  .menu-item:hover, .menu-item.active {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  .menu-item.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .menu-right {
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding-right: 8px;
    color: var(--mac-black);
  }

  .menu-clock {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    cursor: default;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  /* ===== DROPDOWN MENUS ===== */
  .dropdown-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: 24px;
    left: 0;
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 2px solid var(--mac-black);
    min-width: 200px;
    padding: 4px 0;
    z-index: 10001;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display: none;
  }

  .dropdown-menu.show {
    display: block;
  }

  .dropdown-item {
    padding: 3px 20px 3px 30px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    position: relative;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .dropdown-item:hover {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  .dropdown-item.disabled {
    color: var(--mac-gray-dark);
    cursor: default;
  }

  .dropdown-item.disabled:hover {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--mac-gray-dark);
  }

  .dropdown-separator {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--mac-gray-dark);
    margin: 4px 20px;
  }

  .dropdown-item .shortcut {
    position: absolute;
    right: 8px;
    color: var(--mac-gray-dark);
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .dropdown-item:hover .shortcut {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  }

  .dropdown-item .check {
    position: absolute;
    left: 8px;
  }

  .menu-item-left {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 100%;
  }

  .menu-item-center {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    top: 100%;
  }

  /* ===== DESKTOP ICONS ===== */
  #desktop-icons {
    position: absolute;
    top: 30px;
    right: 15px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .desktop-icon {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 75px;
    padding: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .desktop-icon:hover {
    background: rgba(0,0,100,0.2);
  }

  .desktop-icon.selected {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    border: 1px dotted rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  .desktop-icon .icon-img {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 36px;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
  }

  .desktop-icon .icon-label {
    color: white;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
    word-wrap: break-word;
    max-width: 70px;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .desktop-icon.selected .icon-label {
    color: white;
  }

  /* ===== WINDOWS ===== */
  .mac-window {
    position: absolute;
    min-width: 200px;
    min-height: 100px;
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    z-index: 100;
  }

  .mac-window.inactive {
    filter: brightness(0.95);
  }

  .mac-window.active {
    z-index: 1000;
  }

  /* Title bar */
  .title-bar {
    height: 22px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000080 0%, #000060 100%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 2px;
    cursor: default;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .mac-window.inactive .title-bar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #999 0%, #777 100%);
  }

  .title-close {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-left: 2px;
    margin-right: 1px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .title-close:active {
    background: var(--mac-black);
    color: white;
  }

  .title-icon {
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-right: 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .title-text {
    color: white;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 0 4px;
  }

  /* Menu bar inside window */
  .window-menubar {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 1px 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mac-gray-dark);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .window-menu-item {
    padding: 1px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 12px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .window-menu-item:hover {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  /* Window content */
  .window-content {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: auto;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* Resize handle */
  .resize-handle {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    cursor: nwse-resize;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, var(--mac-gray-dark) 50%);
  }

  /* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
  .mac-button {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    padding: 2px 16px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .mac-button:active {
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black);
  }

  .mac-button.default {
    outline: 2px dotted var(--mac-black);
    outline-offset: -4px;
  }

  /* ===== INPUT FIELDS ===== */
  .mac-input {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }

  .mac-input:focus {
    outline: 1px dotted var(--mac-black);
    outline-offset: -2px;
  }

  /* ===== TEXTAREA ===== */
  .mac-textarea {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    padding: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    resize: none;
    outline: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .mac-textarea:focus {
    outline: 1px dotted var(--mac-black);
  }

  /* ===== SCROLLBAR ===== */
  .mac-window .window-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
  }

  .mac-window .window-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--mac-gray-light) 0% 25%, var(--mac-white) 0% 50%) 50% / 2px 2px;
  }

  .mac-window .window-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
  }

  .mac-window .window-content::-webkit-scrollbar-button {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    height: 16px;
  }

  /* ===== ABOUT THIS MAC ===== */
  .about-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
    background: var(--mac-gray);
  }

  .about-mac-icon {
    font-size: 80px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .about-name {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .about-version {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--mac-gray-dark);
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  .about-details {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    padding: 10px 15px;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-width: 300px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* ===== TERMINAL ===== */
  .terminal-content {
    background: #000;
    color: #0f0;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 8px;
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .terminal-line {
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  .terminal-prompt {
    color: #0f0;
  }

  .terminal-input-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .terminal-input {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: #0f0;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
    flex: 1;
    caret-color: #0f0;
  }

  /* ===== CALCULATOR ===== */
  .calc-content {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .calc-display {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    padding: 4px 8px;
    text-align: right;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    min-height: 30px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .calc-buttons {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .calc-btn {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    padding: 6px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .calc-btn:active {
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black);
  }

  .calc-btn.operator {
    background: var(--mac-white);
  }

  .calc-btn.equals {
    background: var(--mac-white);
  }

  /* ===== TEXT EDITOR ===== */
  .textedit-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .textedit-toolbar {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 3px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mac-gray-dark);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .textedit-area {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 8px;
  }

  .textedit-area textarea {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    resize: none;
    outline: none;
    padding: 4px;
    background: var(--mac-white);
  }

  /* ===== FINDER ===== */
  .finder-content {
    display: flex;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .finder-sidebar {
    width: 120px;
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border-right: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-gray-dark) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-white) var(--mac-gray-dark);
    padding: 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .finder-sidebar-item {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .finder-sidebar-item:hover {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  .finder-sidebar-item.active {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    color: white;
  }

  .finder-main {
    flex: 1;
    background: var(--mac-white);
    padding: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    align-content: flex-start;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .finder-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 65px;
    padding: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }

  .finder-item:hover {
    background: rgba(0,0,100,0.1);
  }

  .finder-item.selected {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
  }

  .finder-item .fi-icon {
    font-size: 32px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .finder-item .fi-name {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    word-break: break-all;
    max-width: 60px;
  }

  .finder-item.selected .fi-name {
    color: white;
  }

  .finder-statusbar {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--mac-gray-dark);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ===== PAINT ===== */
  .paint-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .paint-toolbar {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 4px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    align-items: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .paint-color {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .paint-color.active {
    outline: 2px dotted var(--mac-black);
    outline-offset: -3px;
  }

  .paint-tool {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .paint-canvas-container {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: auto;
    background: #808080;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 4px;
  }

  .paint-canvas {
    background: white;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }

  /* ===== TRASH ===== */
  .trash-content {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    padding: 8px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    min-height: 200px;
    align-content: flex-start;
  }

  .trash-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 65px;
    padding: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .trash-item .ti-icon {
    font-size: 32px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .trash-item .ti-name {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  /* ===== DIALOG ===== */
  .dialog-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: transparent;
    z-index: 20000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .dialog-box {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    padding: 0;
    min-width: 250px;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .dialog-titlebar {
    height: 22px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000080 0%, #000060 100%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 4px;
  }

  .dialog-titlebar .title-text {
    color: white;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .dialog-body {
    padding: 15px 20px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .dialog-icon {
    font-size: 36px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .dialog-message {
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .dialog-buttons {
    padding: 10px 20px 15px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  /* ===== CONTEXT MENU ===== */
  .context-menu {
    position: fixed;
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 2px solid var(--mac-black);
    min-width: 160px;
    padding: 4px 0;
    z-index: 30000;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display: none;
  }

  .context-menu.show {
    display: block;
  }

  /* ===== MINIMIZED STATE ===== */
  .mac-window.minimized {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ===== DOCK (classic bottom bar) ===== */
  #dock {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 4px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    padding: 3px 6px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    z-index: 9999;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }

  .dock-item {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .dock-item:hover {
    background: var(--mac-blue);
  }

  .dock-item.active::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -4px;
    width: 4px;
    height: 4px;
    background: var(--mac-blue);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  /* ===== SELECTION BOX ===== */
  #selection-box {
    position: absolute;
    border: 1px dotted var(--mac-blue);
    background: rgba(0,0,100,0.15);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 5;
    display: none;
  }

  /* ===== SPINNER ===== */
  .busy-cursor {
    cursor: wait !important;
  }

  /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
  @keyframes windowOpen {
    from {
      transform: scale(0.8);
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      transform: scale(1);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  .mac-window.opening {
    animation: windowOpen 0.15s ease-out;
  }

  /* ===== SHELL APP ===== */
  .shell-content {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .shell-output {
    background: var(--mac-white);
    border: 1px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-black) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-gray-light) var(--mac-black);
    padding: 8px;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    min-height: 100px;
    max-height: 200px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  /* ===== NOTIFICATION ===== */
  .notification {
    position: fixed;
    top: 30px;
    right: 10px;
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    border: 2px solid;
    border-color: var(--mac-white) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-black) var(--mac-white);
    padding: 10px 15px;
    z-index: 50000;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    font-size: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out;
    max-width: 250px;
  }

  @keyframes slideIn {
    from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
    to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
  }

  @keyframes slideOut {
    from { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
    to { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
  }

  /* ===== SYSTEM PREFERENCES ===== */
  .prefs-content {
    background: var(--mac-gray);
    padding: 15px;
  }

  .prefs-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .pref-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }

  .pref-item:hover {

<script>
// ===== GLOBAL STATE =====
let windowIdCounter = 0;
let activeWindowId = null;
let zIndexCounter = 100;
let openWindows = {};
let trashItems = [];
let isShutDown = false;

// ===== BOOT SEQUENCE =====
(function bootSequence() {
  const progress = document.getElementById('boot-progress');
  const text = document.getElementById('boot-text');
  const bootScreen = document.getElementById('boot-screen');
  
  const messages = [
    'Welcome to Mac OS 9...',
    'Loading System Extensions...',
    'Starting Control Panels...',
    'Loading Finder...',
    'Starting up...',
    ''
  ];
  
  let i = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    if (i < messages.length) {
      text.textContent = messages[i];
      progress.style.width = ((i + 1) / messages.length * 100) + '%';
      i++;
    } else {
      clearInterval(interval);
      setTimeout(() => {
        bootScreen.classList.add('fade-out');
        setTimeout(() => {
          bootScreen.style.display = 'none';
        }, 1000);
      }, 500);
    }
  }, 600);
})();

// ===== CLOCK =====
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  let hours = now.getHours();
  const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  hours = hours % 12 || 12;
  const mins = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
  document.getElementById('menu-clock').textContent = `${hours}:${mins} ${ampm}`;
}
setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
updateClock();

// ===== DROPDOWN MENUS =====
function toggleDropdown(menuId) {
  const dropdown = document.getElementById(menuId + '-dropdown');
  const isOpen = dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains('show');
  closeAllMenus();
  if (!isOpen && dropdown) {
    dropdown.classList.add('show');
    const menuItem = document.getElementById(menuId);
    menuItem.classList.add('active');
  }
}

function closeAllMenus() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('show'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('active'));
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.menu-item') && !e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu')) {
    closeAllMenus();
  }
  if (!e.target.closest('.context-menu')) {
    closeContextMenu();
  }
});

// ===== CONTEXT MENU =====
document.getElementById('desktop').addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.target.closest('.mac-window') || e.target.closest('#dock') || e.target.closest('#menu-bar')) return;
  
  const ctx = document.getElementById('context-menu');
  ctx.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
  ctx.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  ctx.classList.add('show');
});

function closeContextMenu() {
  document.getElementById('context-menu').classList.remove('show');
}

// ===== DESKTOP ICON SELECTION =====
document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(icon => {
  icon.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('selected'));
    icon.classList.add('selected');
    e.stopPropagation();
  });
});

document.getElementById('desktop').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.desktop-icon') && !e.target.closest('.mac-window') && !e.target.closest('#dock') && !e.target.closest('#menu-bar')) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('selected'));
  }
});

// ===== WINDOW MANAGEMENT =====
function createWindow(options) {
  const id = 'win-' + (++windowIdCounter);
  const w = options.width || 500;
  const h = options.height || 350;
  const x = options.x ?? (100 + Math.random() * 200);
  const y = options.y ?? (60 + Math.random() * 100);
  
  const win = document.createElement('div');
  win.className = 'mac-window opening';
  win.id = id;
  win.style.width = w + 'px';
  win.style.height = h + 'px';
  win.style.left = x + 'px';
  win.style.top = y + 'px';
  win.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;
  
  const title = options.title || 'Window';
  const icon = options.icon || '📄';
  const hasMenubar = options.hasMenubar !== false;
  
  let menubarHTML = '';
  if (hasMenubar && options.menuItems) {
    menubarHTML = '<div class="window-menubar">' + 
      options.menuItems.map(m => `<div class="window-menu-item">${m}</div>`).join('') + 
      '</div>';
  }
  
  win.innerHTML = `
    <div class="title-bar" data-winid="${id}">
      <div class="title-close" onclick="closeWindow('${id}')" title="Close">✕</div>
      <div class="title-icon">${icon}</div>
      <div class="title-text">${title}</div>
    </div>
    ${menubarHTML}
    <div class="window-content" id="${id}-content">${options.content || ''}</div>
    <div class="resize-handle"></div>
  `;
  
  document.getElementById('windows-container').appendChild(win);
  
  openWindows[id] = { element: win, options, minimized: false };
  focusWindow(id);
  
  // Remove opening animation class
  setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove('opening'), 200);
  
  // Initialize app-specific code
  if (options.onInit) {
    options.onInit(win, id);
  }
  
  return id;
}

function focusWindow(id) {
  // Deactivate all
  Object.values(openWindows).forEach(w => {
    w.element.classList.remove('active');
    w.element.classList.add('inactive');
  });
  
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    openWindows[id].element.classList.remove('inactive');
    openWindows[id].element.classList.add('active');
    openWindows[id].element.style.zIndex = ++zIndexCounter;
    activeWindowId = id;
  }
}

function closeWindow(id) {
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    openWindows[id].element.style.display = 'none';
    delete openWindows[id];
    if (activeWindowId === id) {
      activeWindowId = null;
    }
  }
}

function minimizeWindow(id) {
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    openWindows[id].minimized = true;
    openWindows[id].element.classList.add('minimized');
  }
}

function restoreWindow(id) {
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    openWindows[id].minimized = false;
    openWindows[id].element.classList.remove('minimized');
    focusWindow(id);
  }
}

// ===== DRAG WINDOWS =====
document.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  const titleBar = e.target.closest('.title-bar');
  if (titleBar) {
    const winId = titleBar.dataset.winid;
    const win = openWindows[winId];
    if (!win) return;
    
    focusWindow(winId);
    
    const rect = win.element.getBoundingClientRect();
    const offsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const offsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    function onMove(e) {
      let newX = e.clientX - offsetX;
      let newY = e.clientY - offsetY;
      newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 50, newX));
      newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 50, newY));
      win.element.style.left = newX + 'px';
      win.element.style.top = newY + 'px';
    }
    
    function onUp() {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  
  // Click to focus
  const winEl = e.target.closest('.mac-window');
  if (winEl) {
    focusWindow(winEl.id);
  }
});

// ===== RESIZE WINDOWS =====
document.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  const resizeHandle = e.target.closest('.resize-handle');
  if (resizeHandle) {
    const win = resizeHandle.closest('.mac-window');
    const winId = win.id;
    const startX = e.clientX;
    const startY = e.clientY;
    const startW = win.offsetWidth;
    const startH = win.offsetHeight;
    
    function onMove(e) {
      const newW = Math.max(200, startW + e.clientX - startX);
      const newH = Math.max(100, startH + e.clientY - startY);
      win.style.width = newW + 'px';
      win.style.height = newH + 'px';
    }
    
    function onUp() {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  }
});

// ===== APP DEFINITIONS =====
function openApp(appName) {
  if (isShutDown) {
    showNotification('The computer is off. Click the power button to start.');
    return;
  }
  
  switch(appName) {
    case 'about': openAbout(); break;
    case 'finder': openFinder(); break;
    case 'textedit': openTextEdit(); break;
    case 'terminal': openTerminal(); break;
    case 'calculator': openCalculator(); break;
    case 'clock': openClock(); break;
    case 'paint': openPaint(); break;
    case 'music': openMusic(); break;
    case 'prefs': openPrefs(); break;
    default: 
      const id = createWindow({
        title: appName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + appName.slice(1),
        icon: '📄',
        width: 400,
        height: 300,
        content: '<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;padding-top:50px;"><p>This is a demo application.</p><p style="color:#888;margin-top:10px;">Mac OS 9 Classic Edition</p></div>'
      });
  }
}

// ===== ABOUT THIS MAC =====
function openAbout() {
  const content = `
    <div class="about-content">
      <div class="about-mac-icon">🖥️</div>
      <div class="about-name">Mac OS 9</div>
      <div class="about-version">Version 9.2.2</div>

    menuItems: ['Shell', 'Edit', 'View', 'Help'],
    content: content,
    onInit: (win) => {
      const input = win.querySelector('.terminal-input');
      const terminal = win.querySelector('.terminal-content');
      
      const commands = {
        help: () => 'Available commands: help, date, whoami, ls, pwd, echo, clear, uname, uptime, cowsay, fortune, calc, matrix, rev, reverse, say, beep, neofetch, history',
        date: () => new Date().toString(),

        ls: () => 'Documents  Pictures  Music  Downloads  ReadMe.txt  Notes.txt  Photo.jpg  Song.mp3  Program  Game',
        pwd: () => '/Users/user',
        uname: () => 'MacOS 9.2.2 PowerPC',
        uptime: () => {
          const mins = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1440);
          return `up ${Math.floor(mins/60)}:${(mins%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')} — 1 user`;
        },
        echo: (args) => args.join(' '),
        clear: () => '__CLEAR__',
        calc: (args) => {
          try { return 'Result: ' + eval(args.join(' ')); }
          catch(e) { return 'Error: invalid expression'; }
        },
        neofetch: () => `
       .:'          user@macintosh
      .__;;         -------------
     .________.    OS: Mac OS 9.2.2
    .____________. Host: iMac G3
    '._@._____.@_' Kernel: PowerPC
      \_.     _/    Uptime: ${Math.floor(Math.random()*24)} hours
       |  :  |     Memory: 128MB / 128MB
       |  :  |     Shell: bash 2.0
       |  :  |     Resolution: ${window.innerWidth}x${window.innerHeight}
       |  :  |     CPU: PowerPC G3 400MHz
       |  :  |     Disk: 4.2 GB / 6.4 GB
       |  :  |     Theme: Classic Mac OS
       |_____|     Window Manager: Window Manager FX
                    `,
        cowsay: (args) => {
          const msg = args.join(' ') || 'Moo!';
          const line = '─'.repeat(msg.length + 2);
          return ` ┌${line}┐\n │ ${msg} │\n └${line}┘\n        \\   ^__^\n         \\  (oo)\\_______\n            (__)\\       )\\/\\\n                ||----w |\n                ||     ||`;
        },
        fortune: () => {
          const fortunes = [
            'You will have a great day!',
            'A pleasant surprise is waiting for you.',
            'Your code will compile on the first try.',
            'The Mac OS 9 experience is timeless.',
            'Nostalgia is a powerful thing.',
            'Have you tried turning it off and on again?',
            'There is no place like 127.0.0.1',
            'To be or not to be, that is the question.',
          ];
          return fortunes[Math.floor(Math.random() * fortunes.length)];
        },
        matrix: () => {
          let s = '';
          for(let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            for(let j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
              s += String.fromCharCode(0x30A0 + Math.random() * 96);
            }
            s += '\n';
          }
          return s;
        },
        rev: (args) => args.join(' ').split('').reverse().join(''),
        reverse: (args) => args.join(' ').split('').reverse().join(''),
        beep: () => { try { const ctx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); const o=ctx.createOscillator(); o.connect(ctx.destination); o.frequency.value=800; o.start(); o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.2); } catch(e){} return '🔊 Beep!'; },
        say: (args) => `Saying: "${args.join(' ')}"`,
        history: () => history.slice(1).map((h, i) => `  ${i+1}  ${h}`).join('\n') || 'No history',
      };
      
      const history = [];
      
      input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          const cmd = input.value.trim();
          if (!cmd) {
            addTerminalLine(terminal, `user@macintosh:~$ `);
            return;
          }
          
          history.push(cmd);
          addTerminalLine(terminal, `user@macintosh:~$ ${cmd}`);
          
          const parts = cmd.split(/\s+/);
          const cmdName = parts[0].toLowerCase();
          const args = parts.slice(1);
          
          if (commands[cmdName]) {
            const result = commands[cmdName](args);
            if (result === '__CLEAR__') {
              terminal.innerHTML = '';
            } else {
              addTerminalLine(terminal, result);
            }
          } else {
            addTerminalLine(terminal, `bash: ${cmdName}: command not found`);
          }
          
          addTerminalLine(terminal, '');
          input.value = '';
          terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
        }
      });
      
      function addTerminalLine(term, text) {
        const line = document.createElement('div');
        line.className = 'terminal-line';
        line.textContent = text;
        term.insertBefore(line, term.querySelector('.terminal-input-line'));
      }
    }
  });
}

let calcState = {};

function calcInput(key, displayId) {
  if (!calcState[displayId]) {
    calcState[displayId] = { current: '0', operator: '', previous: '', waitingForOperand: false };
  }
  
  const state = calcState[displayId];
  const display = document.getElementById(displayId);
  if (!display) return;
  
  if (key === 'C') {
    state.current = '0';
    state.operator = '';
    state.previous = '';
    state.waitingForOperand = false;
  } else if (key === '±') {
    state.current = (parseFloat(state.current) * -1).toString();
  } else if (key === '%') {
    state.current = (parseFloat(state.current) / 100).toString();
  } else if (['+', '-', '×', '÷'].includes(key)) {
    if (state.operator && !state.waitingForOperand) {
      calculate(displayId);
    }
    state.previous = state.current;
    state.operator = key;
    state.waitingForOperand = true;
  } else if (key === '=') {
    if (state.operator) {
      calculate(displayId);
      state.operator = '';
      state.waitingForOperand = true;
    }
  } else if (key === '.') {
    if (!state.current.includes('.')) {
      state.current += '.';
    }
  } else {
    if (state.waitingForOperand) {
      state.current = key;
      state.waitingForOperand = false;
    } else {
      state.current = state.current === '0' ? key : state.current + key;
    }
  }
  
  display.textContent = state.current;
}

function calculate(displayId) {
  const state = calcState[displayId];
  const prev = parseFloat(state.previous);
  const curr = parseFloat(state.current);
  let result;
  
  switch(state.operator) {
    case '+': result = prev + curr; break;
    case '-': result = prev - curr; break;
    case '×': result = prev * curr; break;
    case '÷': result = curr !== 0 ? prev / curr : 'Error'; break;
  }
  
  state.current = result.toString();
  state.waitingForOperand = true;
}

        const minEl = win.querySelector(`#${contentId}-minute`);
        const secEl = win.querySelector(`#${contentId}-second`);

        if (minEl) minEl.style.transform = `rotate(${minDeg}deg)`;
        if (secEl) secEl.style.transform = `rotate(${secDeg}deg)`;

    content: content,
    onInit: (win) => {
      const canvasId = `paint-canvas-${windowIdCounter + 1}`;
      const canvas = win.querySelector(`#${canvasId}`);
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      
      window.paintState = {
        drawing: false,
        color: '#000000',
        tool: 'brush',
        size: 4,
        startX: 0,
        startY: 0,
        snapshot: null
      };
      
      canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        window.paintState.drawing = true;
        window.paintState.startX = x;
        window.paintState.startY = y;
        window.paintState.snapshot = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        
        if (window.paintState.tool === 'brush' || window.paintState.tool === 'eraser') {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = window.paintState.tool === 'eraser' ? '#ffffff' : window.paintState.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = window.paintState.size;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      });
      
      canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!window.paintState.drawing) return;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        
        if (window.paintState.tool === 'brush' || window.paintState.tool === 'eraser') {
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = window.paintState.tool === 'eraser' ? '#ffffff' : window.paintState.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = window.paintState.size;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
          ctx.stroke();
        } else if (window.paintState.snapshot) {
          ctx.putImageData(window.paintState.snapshot, 0, 0);
          ctx.strokeStyle = window.paintState.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = window.paintState.size;
          
          if (window.paintState.tool === 'line') {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(window.paintState.startX, window.paintState.startY);
            ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            ctx.stroke();
          } else if (window.paintState.tool === 'rect') {
            ctx.strokeRect(window.paintState.startX, window.paintState.startY, x - window.paintState.startX, y - window.paintState.startY);
          } else if (window.paintState.tool === 'circle') {
            const rx = Math.abs(x - window.paintState.startX) / 2;
            const ry = Math.abs(y - window.paintState.startY) / 2;
            const cx = window.paintState.startX + (x - window.paintState.startX) / 2;
            const cy = window.paintState.startY + (y - window.paintState.startY) / 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      });
      
      canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        window.paintState.drawing = false;
        window.paintState.snapshot = null;
      });
      
      canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        window.paintState.drawing = false;
      });
    }
  });
}
