    <script>
        (function() {
            // ===== AUDIO SYSTEM =====
            const AudioSystem = {
                ctx: null,
                init() {
                    try {
                        this.ctx = new(window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
                    } catch (e) {
                        this.ctx = null;
                    }
                },
                playTone(freq, duration, type = 'sine', volume = 0.3) {
                    if (!this.ctx) return;
                    try {
                        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
                        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
                        osc.type = type;
                        osc.frequency.value = freq;
                        gain.gain.value = volume;
                        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, this.ctx.currentTime + duration);
                        osc.connect(gain);
                        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
                        osc.start(this.ctx.currentTime);
                        osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + duration);
                    } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
                },
                click() {
                    this.playTone(1200, 0.06, 'square', 0.15);
                },
                open() {
                    this.playTone(600, 0.08, 'sine', 0.2);
                    setTimeout(() => this.playTone(800, 0.06, 'sine', 0.15), 60);
                },
                close() {
                    this.playTone(500, 0.07, 'sine', 0.15);
                    setTimeout(() => this.playTone(350, 0.08, 'sine', 0.12), 50);
                },
                error() {
                    this.playTone(200, 0.15, 'sawtooth', 0.2);
                },
                startup() {
                    if (!this.ctx) return;
                    const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
                    notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
                        setTimeout(() => this.playTone(freq, 0.5, 'sine', 0.15), i * 120);
                    });
                },
                shutdown() {
                    const notes = [1046.5, 783.99, 659.25, 523.25];
                    notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
                        setTimeout(() => this.playTone(freq, 0.4, 'sine', 0.12), i * 100);
                    });
                },
                trash() {
                    this.playTone(300, 0.1, 'sawtooth', 0.2);
                    setTimeout(() => this.playTone(200, 0.12, 'sawtooth', 0.15), 80);
                }
            };

            // ===== STATE =====
            const state = {
                booted: false,
                zIndexCounter: 100,
                selectedIcon: null,
                openMenus: new Set(),
                windows: new Map(), // id -> window element
                singleInstanceApps: new Set(['calculator', 'clock', 'puzzle', 'about', 'controlpanels']),
                trashItems: [],
                folderCount: 0,
                dialogCallback: null,
                isShuttingDown: false,
            };

            // ===== DOM REFS =====
            const bootScreen = document.getElementById('boot-screen');
            const bootBar = document.getElementById('boot-bar');
            const bootText = document.getElementById('boot-text');
            const desktop = document.getElementById('desktop');
            const menuBar = document.getElementById('menu-bar');
            const menuClock = document.getElementById('menu-clock');
            const desktopIcons = document.getElementById('desktop-icons');
            const dialogOverlay = document.getElementById('dialog-overlay');
            const dialogTitle = document.getElementById('dialog-title');
            const dialogMessage = document.getElementById('dialog-message');
            const dialogBtns = document.getElementById('dialog-buttons');
            const dialogOk = document.getElementById('dialog-ok');
            const dialogCancel = document.getElementById('dialog-cancel');
            const shutdownScreen = document.getElementById('shutdown-screen');
            const shutdownText = document.getElementById('shutdown-text');
            const controlStrip = document.getElementById('control-strip');

            // Dropdown menus
            const dropdowns = {
                apple: document.getElementById('dropdown-apple'),
                file: document.getElementById('dropdown-file'),
                edit: document.getElementById('dropdown-edit'),
                view: document.getElementById('dropdown-view'),
                special: document.getElementById('dropdown-special'),
                help: document.getElementById('dropdown-help'),
            };

            // ===== MENU DEFINITIONS =====
            const menuDefinitions = {
                apple: [
                    { label: 'About This Mac', action: () => openApp('about') },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Calculator', action: () => openApp('calculator') },
                    { label: 'Notepad', action: () => openApp('notepad') },
                    { label: 'Clock', action: () => openApp('clock') },
                    { label: 'Puzzle Game', action: () => openApp('puzzle') },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Control Panels', action: () => openApp('controlpanels') },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Restart...', action: () => showRestartDialog() },
                    { label: 'Shut Down...', action: () => showShutdownDialog() },
                ],
                file: [
                    { label: 'New Folder', shortcut: '⌘N', action: () => createNewFolder() },
                    { label: 'Open', shortcut: '⌘O', action: () => openSelectedIcon() },
                    { label: 'Close Window', shortcut: '⌘W', action: () => closeFocusedWindow() },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Empty Trash...', action: () => showEmptyTrashDialog() },
                ],
                edit: [
                    { label: 'Undo', shortcut: '⌘Z', disabled: true },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Cut', shortcut: '⌘X', disabled: true },
                    { label: 'Copy', shortcut: '⌘C', disabled: true },
                    { label: 'Paste', shortcut: '⌘V', disabled: true },
                    { label: 'Select All', shortcut: '⌘A', disabled: true },
                ],
                view: [
                    { label: 'by Icon', checkmark: true },
                    { label: 'by Name', checkmark: false },
                    { label: 'by Date', checkmark: false },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Clean Up', action: () => cleanUpIcons() },
                ],
                special: [
                    { label: 'Restart...', action: () => showRestartDialog() },
                    { label: 'Shut Down...', action: () => showShutdownDialog() },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'Empty Trash...', action: () => showEmptyTrashDialog() },
                ],
                help: [
                    { label: 'Mac Help', action: () => showHelpDialog() },
                    { separator: true },
                    { label: 'About This Retro Desktop', action: () => openApp('about') },
                ],
            };

            // ===== WINDOW MANAGER =====
            function focusWindow(winEl) {
                if (!winEl) return;
                state.zIndexCounter++;
                winEl.style.zIndex = state.zIndexCounter;
                winEl.classList.add('focused');
                document.querySelectorAll('.mac-window').forEach(w => {
                    if (w !== winEl) w.classList.remove('focused');
                });
            }

            function createWindow(id, title, contentHTML, options = {}) {
                const existing = state.windows.get(id);
                if (existing && state.singleInstanceApps.has(id)) {
                    focusWindow(existing);
                    AudioSystem.open();
                    return existing;
                }

                const win = document.createElement('div');
                win.className = 'mac-window';
                win.dataset.windowId = id;
                win.style.left = (options.x || 80 + Math.random() * 160) + 'px';
                win.style.top = (options.y || 60 + Math.random() * 120) + 'px';
                win.style.width = (options.width || 280) + 'px';
                win.style.height = (options.height || 220) + 'px';

                win.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="title-bar">
                        <div class="window-buttons">
                            <div class="window-btn close-btn" title="Close">✕</div>
                            <div class="window-btn min-btn" title="Minimize">−</div>
                            <div class="window-btn zoom-btn" title="Zoom">+</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="window-title">${title}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="window-content">${contentHTML}</div>
                `;

                desktop.appendChild(win);
                state.windows.set(id, win);
                focusWindow(win);
                AudioSystem.open();

                // Close button
                win.querySelector('.close-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    closeWindow(id);
                });
                // Minimize button
                win.querySelector('.min-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    win.style.display = 'none';
                    AudioSystem.click();
                });
                // Zoom button
                win.querySelector('.zoom-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const isMaximized = win.style.width === '100%';
                    if (isMaximized) {
                        win.style.width = (options.width || 280) + 'px';
                        win.style.height = (options.height || 220) + 'px';
                        win.style.left = (options.x || 80) + 'px';
                        win.style.top = (options.y || 60) + 'px';
                    } else {
                        win.style.left = '0px';
                        win.style.top = '28px';
                        win.style.width = '100%';
                        win.style.height = 'calc(100% - 28px)';
                    }
                    AudioSystem.click();
                });

                // Focus on click
                win.addEventListener('mousedown', () => focusWindow(win));

                // Drag
                const titleBar = win.querySelector('.title-bar');
                titleBar.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                    if (e.target.closest('.window-btn')) return;
                    e.preventDefault();
                    focusWindow(win);
                    const rect = win.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const offsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
                    const offsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;
                    const onMove = (ev) => {
                        win.style.left = (ev.clientX - offsetX) + 'px';
                        win.style.top = (ev.clientY - offsetY) + 'px';
                    };
                    const onUp = () => {
                        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                    };
                    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                });

                return win;
            }

            function closeWindow(id) {
                const win = state.windows.get(id);
                if (win) {
                    win.style.transition = 'opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s';
                    win.style.opacity = '0';
                    win.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        win.remove();
                        state.windows.delete(id);
                    }, 150);
                    AudioSystem.close();
                }
            }

            function closeFocusedWindow() {
                let focusedId = null;
                let highestZ = -1;
                state.windows.forEach((win, id) => {
                    const z = parseInt(win.style.zIndex) || 0;
                    if (z > highestZ && win.style.display !== 'none') {
                        highestZ = z;
                        focusedId = id;
                    }
                });
                if (focusedId) closeWindow(focusedId);
            }

            function restoreWindow(id) {
                const win = state.windows.get(id);
                if (win && win.style.display === 'none') {
                    win.style.display = 'flex';
                    focusWindow(win);
                    AudioSystem.open();
                }
            }

            // ===== APP IMPLEMENTATIONS =====
            function openApp(appName) {
                switch (appName) {
                    case 'calculator':
                        createCalculator();
                        break;
                    case 'notepad':
                        createNotepad();
                        break;
                    case 'clock':
                        createClock();
                        break;
                    case 'puzzle':
                        createPuzzle();
                        break;
                    case 'about':
                        createAbout();
                        break;
                    case 'controlpanels':
                        createControlPanels();
                        break;
                    case 'hd':
                        createFileBrowser('Macintosh HD', [
                            { icon: '📁', name: 'Applications' },
                            { icon: '📂', name: 'Documents' },
                            { icon: '📁', name: 'System Folder' },
                            { icon: '📄', name: 'Read Me' },
                            { icon: '📄', name: 'Setup' },
                        ]);
                        break;
                    case 'trash':
                        createTrashWindow();
                        break;
                    case 'readme':
                        createReadme();
                        break;
                    case 'apps_folder':
                        createFileBrowser('Applications', [
                            { icon: '🧮', name: 'Calculator', app: 'calculator' },
                            { icon: '📝', name: 'Notepad', app: 'notepad' },
                            { icon: '🕐', name: 'Clock', app: 'clock' },
                            { icon: '🧩', name: 'Puzzle Game', app: 'puzzle' },
                            { icon: '⚙️', name: 'Control Panels', app: 'controlpanels' },
                        ]);
                        break;
                    case 'docs_folder':
                        createFileBrowser('Documents', [
                            { icon: '📄', name: 'My Document' },
                            { icon: '📄', name: 'Notes' },
                            { icon: '📄', name: 'Resume' },
                        ]);
                        break;
                    default:
                        AudioSystem.error();
                }
            }

            function createCalculator() {
                const content = `
                    <div class="calculator-body">
                        <div class="calculator-display" id="calc-display">0</div>
                        <div class="calculator-buttons">
                            <button class="calc-btn clear" data-val="C">C</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="±">±</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="%">%</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn operator" data-val="÷">÷</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="7">7</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="8">8</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="9">9</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn operator" data-val="×">×</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="4">4</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="5">5</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="6">6</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn operator" data-val="−">−</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="1">1</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="2">2</button>

                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val="0" style="grid-column:span 2;">0</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn" data-val=".">.</button>
                            <button class="calc-btn equals" data-val="=">=</button>
                        </div>

            function initCalculator(win) {
                const display = win.querySelector('#calc-display');
                let current = '0';
                let previous = null;
                let operator = null;
                let shouldReset = false;

                function updateDisplay() {
                    display.textContent = current;
                }

                function calculate(a, op, b) {
                    a = parseFloat(a);
                    b = parseFloat(b);
                    switch (op) {
                        case '+':
                            return a + b;
                        case '−':
                            return a - b;
                        case '×':
                            return a * b;
                        case '÷':
                            return b !== 0 ? a / b : 'Error';
                        default:
                            return b;
                    }
                }

                win.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        AudioSystem.click();
                        const val = btn.dataset.val;
                        if (val === 'C') {
                            current = '0';
                            previous = null;
                            operator = null;
                            shouldReset = false;
                        } else if (val === '±') {
                            current = (parseFloat(current) * -1).toString();
                        } else if (val === '%') {
                            current = (parseFloat(current) / 100).toString();
                        } else if (['+', '−', '×', '÷'].includes(val)) {
                            if (operator && previous !== null && !shouldReset) {
                                const result = calculate(previous, operator, current);
                                previous = result;
                                current = result.toString();
                            } else {
                                previous = current;
                            }
                            operator = val;
                            shouldReset = true;
                        } else if (val === '=') {
                            if (operator && previous !== null) {
                                const result = calculate(previous, operator, current);
                                current = result.toString();
                                previous = null;
                                operator = null;
                                shouldReset = true;
                            }
                        } else if (val === '.') {
                            if (shouldReset) {
                                current = '0.';
                                shouldReset = false;
                            } else if (!current.includes('.')) {
                                current += '.';
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (shouldReset) {
                                current = val;
                                shouldReset = false;
                            } else {
                                current = current === '0' ? val : current + val;
                            }
                        }
                        updateDisplay();
                    });
                });
                updateDisplay();
            }

            function createClock() {
                const content = `
                    <div class="clock-content">
                        <canvas id="clock-canvas" width="180" height="180"></canvas>
                    </div>
                `;
                const win = createWindow('clock', 'Clock', content, { width: 210, height: 230, x: 400, y: 80 });
                const canvas = win.querySelector('#clock-canvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

                function drawClock() {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const radius = canvas.width / 2 - 10;
                    const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
                    const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

                    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

                    // Face
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.stroke();

                    // Numbers
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
                        const angle = (i - 3) * (Math.PI / 6);
                        const nx = centerX + Math.cos(angle) * (radius - 18);
                        const ny = centerY + Math.sin(angle) * (radius - 18);
                        ctx.fillText(i.toString(), nx, ny);
                    }

                    // Hour hand
                    const hours = now.getHours() % 12;
                    const minutes = now.getMinutes();
                    const hourAngle = ((hours + minutes / 60) - 3) * (Math.PI / 6);
                    drawHand(ctx, centerX, centerY, hourAngle, radius * 0.5, 4, '#000');

                    // Minute hand
                    const minuteAngle = (minutes - 15) * (Math.PI / 30);
                    drawHand(ctx, centerX, centerY, minuteAngle, radius * 0.7, 3, '#000');

                    // Second hand
                    const seconds = now.getSeconds();
                    const secondAngle = (seconds - 15) * (Math.PI / 30);
                    drawHand(ctx, centerX, centerY, secondAngle, radius * 0.75, 1, '#cc0000');

                    // Center dot
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                    ctx.fill();
                }

                function drawHand(ctx, cx, cy, angle, length, width, color) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
                    ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(angle) * length, cy + Math.sin(angle) * length);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                    ctx.lineWidth = width;
                    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                    ctx.stroke();
                }

                drawClock();
                const interval = setInterval(() => {
                    if (!document.body.contains(win)) {
                        clearInterval(interval);
                        return;
                    }
                    drawClock();
                }, 1000);
            }

            function createPuzzle() {
                const content = `
                    <div class="puzzle-content">
                        <div class="puzzle-grid" id="puzzle-grid"></div>
                        <div class="puzzle-status" id="puzzle-status">Arrange tiles in order</div>
                        <button class="puzzle-reset-btn" id="puzzle-reset">Shuffle</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                const win = createWindow('puzzle', 'Puzzle Game', content, { width: 220, height: 280, x: 420, y: 120 });

            }

            function initPuzzle(win) {
                const grid = win.querySelector('#puzzle-grid');
                const status = win.querySelector('#puzzle-status');
                const resetBtn = win.querySelector('#puzzle-reset');
                let tiles = [];
                let emptyIndex = 8;

                function shuffle() {
                    tiles = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => i);
                    // Fisher-Yates with solvability check
                    do {
                        for (let i = tiles.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                            [tiles[i], tiles[j]] = [tiles[j], tiles[i]];
                        }
                    } while (!isSolvable(tiles));
                    emptyIndex = tiles.indexOf(0);
                    render();
                    status.textContent = 'Arrange tiles in order';
                }

                function isSolvable(arr) {
                    let inversions = 0;
                    const flat = arr.filter(v => v !== 0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < flat.length; i++) {
                        for (let j = i + 1; j < flat.length; j++) {
                            if (flat[i] > flat[j]) inversions++;
                        }
                    }
                    return inversions % 2 === 0;
                }

                function render() {
                    grid.innerHTML = '';
                    tiles.forEach((tile, idx) => {
                        const div = document.createElement('div');
                        div.className = 'puzzle-tile' + (tile === 0 ? ' empty' : '');
                        div.textContent = tile === 0 ? '' : tile;
                        div.dataset.index = idx;
                        if (tile !== 0) {
                            div.addEventListener('click', () => {
                                AudioSystem.click();
                                const emptyPos = tiles.indexOf(0);
                                const tilePos = idx;
                                const emptyRow = Math.floor(emptyPos / 3);
                                const emptyCol = emptyPos % 3;
                                const tileRow = Math.floor(tilePos / 3);
                                const tileCol = tilePos % 3;
                                const isAdjacent = (Math.abs(emptyRow - tileRow) + Math.abs(emptyCol -
                                    tileCol)) === 1;
                                if (isAdjacent) {
                                    [tiles[emptyPos], tiles[tilePos]] = [tiles[tilePos], tiles[emptyPos]];
                                    render();
                                    if (isSolved()) {
                                        status.textContent = '🎉 Solved! Great job!';
                                        AudioSystem.open();
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        grid.appendChild(div);
                    });
                }

                function isSolved() {
                    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        if (tiles[i] !== i + 1) return false;
                    }
                    return tiles[8] === 0;
                }

                resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    AudioSystem.click();
                    shuffle();
                });

                shuffle();
            }

            function doBoot() {

                defs.forEach(def => {
                    if (def.separator) {
                        const sep = document.createElement('div');

                        check.className = 'checkmark' + (def.checkmark ? ' visible' : '');
                        check.textContent = '✓';
                        const label = document.createElement('span');
                        label.textContent = def.label;
                        opt.appendChild(check);
                        opt.appendChild(label);
                        if (def.shortcut) {
                            const sc = document.createElement('span');
                            sc.className = 'shortcut';
                            sc.textContent = def.shortcut;
                            opt.appendChild(sc);
                        }
                        if (!def.disabled) {
                            opt.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                closeAllMenus();
                                if (def.action) def.action();
                            });
                        }
                        dropdown.appendChild(opt);

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                closeAllMenus();
            });

            // Start
            init();

            // Expose some functions for debugging
            window.retroMac = {
                openApp,
                closeWindow,
                showDialog,
                state,
            };

        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: retro-macos-ui
prompt: Recreate a classic, retro, macOS Desktop UI — make it interactive and nostalgic, make it as interactive as you can, you can be creative.. Feel free to showcase your skills. The entire application must be a single-page self-contained HTML file.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Macintosh HD</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --aqua: #3b82c4;
    --sel: #316ac5;
    --menubar-h: 22px;
    --dock-h: 68px;
    --title-h: 22px;
    --graphite: 0;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html, body {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Lucida Grande", "Lucida Sans Unicode", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif;
    background: #000; user-select: none; cursor: default;
  }

  /* ===== BOOT ===== */
  #boot {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100000;
    background: #b4b4b4;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    transition: opacity .8s ease;
  }
  #boot.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  #boot .apple {
    width: 72px; height: 88px; fill: #1a1a1a;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35));
    animation: bootPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bootPulse { 50% { opacity: .55; } }
  #boot .bar-wrap {
    width: 168px; height: 10px; margin-top: 36px;
    border: 1px solid #555; background: #d8d8d8;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  #boot .bar {
    height: 100%; width: 0%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7ec8ff, #1a6dce 45%, #0b4ea8 55%, #3a8fe0);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    transition: width .25s linear;
  }
  #boot .caption {
    margin-top: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: #333; letter-spacing: .02em;
  }

  /* ===== SLEEP / SHUTDOWN ===== */
  #overlay-fx {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99999; pointer-events: none;
    background: #000; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 1.2s ease;
  }
  #overlay-fx.sleep { opacity: .92; pointer-events: auto; cursor: none; }
  #overlay-fx.shutdown {
    opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto;
    animation: crtOff .7s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes crtOff {
    0% { opacity: 0; }
    40% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1); }
    70% { transform: scaleY(.02); background: #fff; }
    100% { transform: scaleY(.001); background: #000; opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* ===== DESKTOP ===== */
  #world { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: none; }
  #world.on { display: block; }

  #wallpaper {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 18% 88%, rgba(90,190,230,.55), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 88% 12%, rgba(40,110,200,.5), transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 60% 60%, rgba(160,220,255,.25), transparent 50%),
      linear-gradient(168deg, #0c2d62 0%, #164e9a 28%, #2a78c4 52%, #5eb0d8 78%, #9ecde0 100%);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #wallpaper.graphite {
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 18% 88%, rgba(90,90,100,.4), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(168deg, #1c1c20 0%, #3a3a42 45%, #5a5a64 100%);
  }
  #wallpaper::before, #wallpaper::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(40px); pointer-events: none;
  }
  #wallpaper::before {
    width: 55vw; height: 40vh; left: -8%; top: 8%;
    background: rgba(120, 200, 255, .22);
    animation: drift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  #wallpaper::after {
    width: 45vw; height: 50vh; right: -10%; bottom: -10%;
    background: rgba(30, 80, 180, .28);
    animation: drift 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse;
  }
  @keyframes drift {
    from { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); }
    to { transform: translate(4%, -3%) scale(1.08); }
  }

  /* ===== MENU BAR ===== */
  #menubar {
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: var(--menubar-h);
    z-index: 50000;
    display: flex; align-items: stretch;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f6f6f6 0%, #e4e4e4 50%, #d4d4d4 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 #fff;
    font-size: 13px; color: #111;
  }
  #menubar.graphite {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6a6a6e 0%, #4a4a4e 55%, #3a3a3e 100%);
    color: #f2f2f2;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #111, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  }
  .mb-left, .mb-right { display: flex; align-items: stretch; }
  .mb-right { margin-left: auto; }
  .mb-item {
    padding: 0 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .mb-item:hover, .mb-item.open {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5ba3e6, #1a62c2);
    color: #fff;
  }
  #menubar.graphite .mb-item:hover, #menubar.graphite .mb-item.open {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7a7a80, #404046);
  }
  .mb-item.apple { font-size: 16px; padding: 0 12px; font-weight: 500; }
  .mb-item.apple svg { width: 14px; height: 16px; display: block; }
  .mb-item.bold { font-weight: 700; }
  .menu-dd {
    display: none; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; min-width: 228px;
    background: rgba(246,246,246,.96);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    box-shadow: 2px 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
    padding: 4px 0; color: #111; z-index: 1;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .mb-item.open .menu-dd { display: block; }
  .menu-dd.rightish { left: auto; right: 0; }
  .mi {
    padding: 3px 18px 3px 22px; font-size: 13px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px;
  }
  .mi:hover { background: #1a62c2; color: #fff; }
  .mi.dis { color: #9a9a9a; pointer-events: none; }
  .mi.dis:hover { background: transparent; color: #9a9a9a; }
  .mi kbd { font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; }
  .mi-sep { height: 1px; background: #c8c8c8; margin: 4px 1px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff; }

  .mb-clock { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .01em; }
  .mb-ico { opacity: .85; font-size: 12px; }

  /* ===== DESKTOP ICONS ===== */
  #desk {
    position: absolute; top: var(--menubar-h); left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  }
  .dicon {
    position: absolute; width: 88px; text-align: center;
    color: #fff; font-size: 11px; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
    cursor: default;
  }
  .dicon .glyph {
    width: 52px; height: 52px; margin: 0 auto 4px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 36px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35));
  }
  .dicon .lab {
    display: inline-block; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; max-width: 86px;
    overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .dicon.sel .lab { background: var(--sel); }
  .dicon.sel .glyph { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.0); filter: brightness(1.08) drop-shadow(0 0 0 #3b82c4); }

  /* ===== WINDOWS ===== */
  .win {
    position: absolute; min-width: 240px; min-height: 120px;
    background: #ececec;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.45);
    border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 100;
  }
  .win.inactive { box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22); }
  .win.inactive .titlebar { filter: grayscale(.35) brightness(1.05); }
  .win.inactive .tl { opacity: .45; }
  .titlebar {
    height: var(--title-h); flex: 0 0 var(--title-h);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0f0f0 0%, #d6d6d6 48%, #c8c8c8 52%, #dcdcdc 100%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #8a8a8a;
    display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px;
    cursor: default;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff;
  }
  .win.maxd { border-radius: 0; }
  .tls { display: flex; gap: 6px; width: 54px; }
  .tl {
    width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);
    position: relative;
  }
  .tl.close { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ff9a90, #e24640); }
  .tl.min { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ffe08a, #e1a325); }
  .tl.zoom { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #9aef7a, #3ea83c); }
  .titlebar:hover .tl.close::after { content: "×"; position: absolute; inset: -2px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; line-height: 12px; color: #4a0000; font-weight: 700; }
  .titlebar:hover .tl.min::after { content: "–"; position: absolute; inset: -3px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; line-height: 12px; color: #5a3a00; font-weight: 700; }
  .titlebar:hover .tl.zoom::after { content: "+"; position: absolute; inset: -2px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; line-height: 12px; color: #0a3a00; font-weight: 700; }
  .wtitle {
    flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    color: #222; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .wbody { flex: 1; background: #fff; overflow: auto; position: relative; color: #111; }
  .wbody.metal {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d0d0d4, #b8b8be);
  }
  .resize {
    position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: nwse-resize;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, #888 50%, #888 55%, transparent 55%, transparent 65%, #888 65%, #888 70%, transparent 70%);
  }
  .win.minning { transition: transform .45s ease, opacity .45s ease; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ===== DOCK ===== */
  #dock-wrap {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 2px;
    display: flex; justify-content: center; z-index: 40000;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #dock {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0;
    padding: 4px 10px 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(220,220,230,.38), rgba(40,40,50,.28));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
    height: 62px;
  }
  .dock-item {
    width: 48px; height: 48px; margin: 0 3px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    transform-origin: bottom center;
    transition: transform .12s ease, width .12s ease, margin .12s ease;
    position: relative;
  }
  .dock-item .di {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), rgba(0,0,0,.08));
  }
  .dock-item .tip {
    position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: rgba(40,40,40,.88); color: #fff; font-size: 11px;
    padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap;
    display: none; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .dock-item:hover .tip { display: block; }
  .dock-item .dot {
    position: absolute; bottom: -3px; left: 50%; width: 4px; height: 4px;
    margin-left: -2px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(40,40,40,.65);
    display: none;
  }
  .dock-item.open .dot { display: block; }
  .dock-sep {
    width: 1px; height: 42px; margin: 0 8px 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.35), transparent);
  }
  .dock-item.bounce { animation: bounce .7s ease; }
  @keyframes bounce {
    0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    30% { transform: translateY(-28px); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    70% { transform: translateY(-16px); }
  }

  /* ===== DIALOGS / SHEETS ===== */
  .sheet {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translateX(-50%);
    min-width: 280px; background: #ececec;
    border: 1px solid #666; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    padding: 16px 18px 14px; z-index: 20;
    animation: sheetIn .25s ease;
  }
  @keyframes sheetIn { from { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } }

  /* ===== FINDER ===== */
  .finder { display: flex; height: 100%; font-size: 12px; }
  .fside {
    width: 148px; background: #dfe6ef; border-right: 1px solid #9aa;
    padding: 8px 0; color: #333;
  }
  .fside h5 {
    font-size: 11px; color: #678; padding: 6px 12px 3px; letter-spacing: .04em;
  }
  .fside .row { padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
  .fside .row:hover { background: rgba(49,106,197,.15); }
  .fside .row.on { background: var(--sel); color: #fff; }
  .fmain { flex: 1; background: #fff; overflow: auto; padding: 10px; }
  .ftoolbar {
    height: 36px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#efefef,#d4d4d4);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #999; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .fbtn {
    height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#ddd); font-size: 11px;
  }
  .fbtn:active { background: #ccc; }
  .grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
  .ficon { width: 80px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; }
  .ficon .g { font-size: 32px; line-height: 40px; }
  .ficon.sel .n { background: var(--sel); color: #fff; border-radius: 2px; }
  .ficon .n { display: inline-block; padding: 0 3px; }

  /* ===== TEXT EDIT ===== */
  .te { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
  .te-bar {
    height: 28px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#efefef,#d6d6d6);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #999; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .te textarea {
    flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; padding: 10px 14px;
    font: 13px/1.45 "Lucida Grande", Geneva, sans-serif; color: #111;
    user-select: text; cursor: text;
  }

  /* ===== CALC ===== */
  .calc {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#c8c8ce,#9a9aa2);
    padding: 10px; height: 100%;
  }
  .calc-disp {
    background: #d4ddd0; border: 1px solid #555; height: 42px;
    text-align: right; padding: 8px 10px; font: 22px/1.1 "Lucida Grande", monospace;
    margin-bottom: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
    overflow: hidden; user-select: text;
  }
  .calc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 5px; }
  .cb {
    height: 32px; border: 1px solid #555; border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f4f4f4,#c8c8c8);
    font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff inset;
  }
  .cb:active { background: #bbb; }
  .cb.op { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#d0d8e8,#8aa0c0); }
  .cb.eq { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#8ab4e8,#2a6ec0); color: #fff; }

  /* ===== TERMINAL ===== */
  .term {
    background: #111; color: #39ff6a; font: 12px/1.45 Menlo, Monaco, "Courier New", monospace;
    height: 100%; padding: 8px; overflow: auto; user-select: text; cursor: text;
  }
  .term .cmd { color: #9f9; }
  .term input.tin {
    background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #39ff6a;
    font: inherit; width: calc(100% - 1.5em); caret-color: #39ff6a;
  }
  .term .line { white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

  /* ===== SAFARI ===== */
  .saf { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; background: #d0d0d4; }
  .saf-bar {
    padding: 6px 8px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#e8e8ec,#c4c4ca);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #888;
  }
  .saf-bar input {
    flex: 1; height: 22px; border: 1px solid #777; border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0 10px; font-size: 12px; background: #fff; user-select: text; cursor: text;
  }
  .saf-bm {
    height: 22px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f3f3f3,#ddd);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #aaa; display: flex; align-items: center;
    font-size: 11px; padding: 0 8px; gap: 14px; color: #124;
  }
  .saf-bm span { cursor: default; }
  .saf-bm span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .saf-view { flex: 1; background: #fff; overflow: auto; user-select: text; }
  .page { padding: 28px 36px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: #222; cursor: auto; }
  .page h1 { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 400; color: #1a3a7a; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .page h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0 6px; color: #333; }
  .apple-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#6aa4e0,#1e4f9a);
    color: #fff; padding: 28px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .apple-hero h1 { color: #fff; }

  /* ===== STICKIES ===== */
  .sticky-body {
    height: 100%; background: #fff7a0;
    padding: 8px; font: 13px/1.4 "Marker Felt", "Comic Sans MS", cursive;
    overflow: auto; outline: none; user-select: text; cursor: text;
  }
  .win.sticky-win { box-shadow: 2px 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
  .win.sticky-win .titlebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe96a,#f0d030);
    border-bottom-color: #d4b020;
  }
  .win.sticky-win .wbody { background: #fff7a0; }

  /* ===== ITUNES ===== */
  .itunes { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #c9c9d0; }
  .it-top {
    padding: 8px 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ddd,#b0b0b8);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #888; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center;
  }
  .it-lcd {
    flex: 1; height: 48px; background: #8aa090;
    border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    color: #1a2a18; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px;
  }
  .viz { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; height: 18px; margin-top: 3px; }
  .viz i {
    display: block; width: 4px; background: #2a4a28; height: 20%;
    animation: eq 0.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .viz.off i { animation: none; height: 12%; }
  @keyframes eq { to { height: 100%; } }
  .it-list { flex: 1; overflow: auto; background: #fff; font-size: 12px; }
  .it-list table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
  .it-list th { text-align: left; background: #e8e8e8; padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #bbb; font-weight: 600; }
  .it-list td { padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
  .it-list tr.on { background: var(--sel); color: #fff; }
  .it-list tr:hover:not(.on) { background: #eef4ff; }

  /* ===== SYS PREFS ===== */
  .prefs { padding: 16px; background: #ececec; height: 100%; }
  .prefs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
  .pref {
    text-align: center; font-size: 11px;
  }
  .pref .ic {
    width: 52px; height: 52px; margin: 0 auto 4px; border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 28px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#c8c8c8);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  }
  .pref.sel .ic { outline: 2px solid var(--sel); }
  .pref-pane { margin-top: 16px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #aaa; padding: 12px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 4px; }

  /* ===== ABOUT ===== */
  .about {
    padding: 20px; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f6f6,#ddd);
    height: 100%;
  }
  .about h2 { font-weight: 400; font-size: 22px; margin: 8px 0 2px; }
  .about p { font-size: 11px; color: #444; margin: 3px 0; }

  /* ===== SPOTLIGHT ===== */
  #spot {
    display: none; position: absolute; top: 80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 420px; z-index: 60000;
    background: rgba(250,250,252,.92);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #spot.on { display: block; }
  #spot input {
    width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; font-size: 18px; padding: 10px 14px;
    background: transparent; user-select: text; cursor: text;
  }
  #spot-res { border-top: 1px solid #ddd; max-height: 240px; overflow: auto; }
  #spot-res div { padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 13px; display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  #spot-res div:hover, #spot-res div.hi { background: var(--sel); color: #fff; }

  /* ===== CONTEXT ===== */
  #ctx {
    display: none; position: absolute; z-index: 70000; min-width: 180px;
    background: rgba(246,246,246,.96); border: 1px solid #666;
    box-shadow: 2px 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3); padding: 4px 0; font-size: 13px;
  }
  #ctx.on { display: block; }
  #ctx .mi { padding: 3px 16px; }
  #ctx .mi:hover { background: #1a62c2; color: #fff; }

  /* ===== LOGIN (optional skip) ===== */
  #login {
    display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 90000;
    background: #4a6a8a url('') center/cover;

  /* ===== PHOTO / PREVIEW ===== */

    background: repeating-conic-gradient(#ddd 0% 25%, #eee 0% 50%) 50% / 16px 16px; }

<script>
(() => {
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     Classic Mac OS X (Aqua / Tiger-era) desktop
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const $ = (s, r=document) => r.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, r=document) => [...r.querySelectorAll(s)];

  const FS = {
    "Macintosh HD": {
      type: "disk",
      kids: {
        Applications: { type: "folder", kids: {
          "Safari.app": { type: "app", app: "safari" },
          "TextEdit.app": { type: "app", app: "textedit" },
          "Calculator.app": { type: "app", app: "calc" },
          "Terminal.app": { type: "app", app: "term" },
          "iTunes.app": { type: "app", app: "itunes" },
          "Stickies.app": { type: "app", app: "stickies" },
          "System Preferences.app": { type: "app", app: "prefs" },
          "iCal.app": { type: "app", app: "ical" },
          "Chess.app": { type: "app", app: "chess" },
          "Preview.app": { type: "app", app: "preview" }
        }},
        Users: { type: "folder", kids: {
          guest: { type: "folder", kids: {
            Desktop: { type: "folder", kids: {} },
            Documents: { type: "folder", kids: {
              "Read Me.rtf": { type: "doc" },
              "To Do.txt": { type: "doc" }
            }},
            Music: { type: "folder", kids: { iTunes: { type: "folder", kids: {} } } },
            Pictures: { type: "folder", kids: { "Family.png": { type: "pic" } } }
          }}
        }},
        System: { type: "folder", kids: { Library: { type: "folder", kids: {} } } },
        Library: { type: "folder", kids: {} },
        Applications: null
      }
    }
  };
  FS["Macintosh HD"].kids.Applications = FS["Macintosh HD"].kids.Applications;

  const APPS = {
    finder: { name: "Finder", icon: "😊", glyph: "💾" },
    safari: { name: "Safari", icon: "🧭", glyph: "🧭" },
    textedit: { name: "TextEdit", icon: "📄", glyph: "📄" },
    calc: { name: "Calculator", icon: "🔢", glyph: "🔢" },
    term: { name: "Terminal", icon: "⬛", glyph: "⬛" },
    itunes: { name: "iTunes", icon: "🎵", glyph: "🎵" },
    stickies: { name: "Stickies", icon: "📝", glyph: "📝" },
    prefs: { name: "System Preferences", icon: "⚙️", glyph: "⚙️" },
    ical: { name: "iCal", icon: "📅", glyph: "📅" },
    chess: { name: "Chess", icon: "♟️", glyph: "♟️" },
    preview: { name: "Preview", icon: "🖼️", glyph: "🖼️" },
    about: { name: "About This Mac", icon: "", glyph: "" },
    help: { name: "Mac Help", icon: "❓", glyph: "❓" },
    trash: { name: "Trash", icon: "🗑️", glyph: "🗑️" }
  };

  const dockApps = ["finder","safari","textedit","itunes","ical","calc","stickies","term","prefs","chess"];

  let zTop = 200;
  let windows = [];
  let active = null;
  let selectedIcons = new Set();
  let graphite = false;
  let trashItems = [];
  let wallpaperIdx = 0;
  let audioCtx = null;
  let volume = 0.7;
  let clockTimer = null;

  const walls = [
    null, // default css
    "linear-gradient(165deg,#1a0a2e,#4a1a6a 40%,#2a6aaa)",
    "linear-gradient(180deg,#87b4d8,#cfe4f4 55%,#8aaa68 56%,#6a8a48)",
    "linear-gradient(180deg,#1c1c20,#4a4a52)",
    "radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%,#fff6c8,#e08a2a 40%,#8a2a10)"
  ];

  /* ---------- sound ---------- */
  function ctx() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    return audioCtx;
  }
  function beep(freq=440, dur=0.08, type="sine", gain=0.08) {
    try {
      const c = ctx();
      const o = c.createOscillator();
      const g = c.createGain();
      o.type = type; o.frequency.value = freq;
      g.gain.value = gain * volume;
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, c.currentTime + dur);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination);
      o.start(); o.stop(c.currentTime + dur);
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  function chord() {
    [523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,i) => setTimeout(() => beep(f, 0.55, "triangle", 0.05), i*90));
  }

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  const phrases = [
    "Starting Mac OS X…",
    "Loading extensions…",
    "Mounting Macintosh HD…",
    "Starting Aqua…",
    "Welcome to Macintosh"
  ];
  function boot() {
    let p = 0, i = 0;
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      p += 4 + Math.random()*10;
      if (p > 100) p = 100;
      $("#bootbar").style.width = p + "%";
      if (p > i*20 && i < phrases.length) { $("#bootcap").textContent = phrases[i++]; }
      if (p >= 100) {
        clearInterval(t);
        setTimeout(() => {
          $("#boot").classList.add("hidden");
          $("#login").classList.add("show");
          setTimeout(() => $("#loginpw").focus(), 200);
        }, 400);
      }
    }, 120);
  }

  function enterDesktop() {
    $("#login").classList.remove("show");
    $("#world").classList.add("on");
    chord();
    layoutDesktop();
    buildDock();
    tick();
    clockTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    openApp("finder", { x: 80, y: 70, w: 620, h: 400 });
  }

  $("#loginpw").addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") enterDesktop();
  });

  /* ---------- clock / battery ---------- */
  function tick() {
    const d = new Date();
    const days = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"];
    let h = d.getHours(), m = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,"0");
    const ap = h>=12 ? "PM" : "AM";
    h = h%12 || 12;
    $("#clock").textContent = `${days[d.getDay()]} ${h}:${m} ${ap}`;
    const bat = 78 + Math.round(Math.sin(d.getMinutes()/10)*10);
    $("#batt").title = `Battery: ${bat}%`;
    $("#battxt").textContent = `Battery: ${bat}%`;
  }

  /* ---------- desktop icons ---------- */
  const deskItems = [
    { id: "hd", name: "Macintosh HD", glyph: "💾", x: null, y: 20, app: "finder", path: "Macintosh HD" },
    { id: "apps", name: "Applications", glyph: "📦", x: null, y: 110, app: "finder", path: "Applications" },
    { id: "docs", name: "Documents", glyph: "📁", x: null, y: 200, app: "finder", path: "Documents" },
    { id: "readme", name: "Read Me", glyph: "📝", x: null, y: 290, app: "textedit", file: "readme" },
    { id: "safari", name: "Safari", glyph: "🧭", x: null, y: 380, app: "safari" }
  ];

  function layoutDesktop() {
    const desk = $("#desk");
    $$(".dicon", desk).forEach(el => el.remove());
    const right = desk.clientWidth - 96;
    deskItems.forEach((it, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement("div");
      el.className = "dicon";
      el.dataset.id = it.id;
      el.style.left = (it.x ?? right) + "px";
      el.style.top = (it.y ?? (20 + i*90)) + "px";
      el.innerHTML = `<div class="glyph">${it.glyph}</div><div class="lab">${it.name}</div>`;
      desk.appendChild(el);
      bindDeskIcon(el, it);
    });
  }

  function bindDeskIcon(el, it) {
    let sx, sy, ox, oy, dragged=false;
    el.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      closeMenus();
      if (!e.shiftKey) {
        $$(".dicon").forEach(d => d.classList.remove("sel"));
        selectedIcons.clear();
      }
      el.classList.add("sel");
      selectedIcons.add(it.id);
      dragged = false;
      sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY;
      ox = parseInt(el.style.left); oy = parseInt(el.style.top);
      const mv = ev => {
        const dx = ev.clientX-sx, dy = ev.clientY-sy;
        if (Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>3) dragged = true;
        el.style.left = (ox+dx) + "px";
        el.style.top = (oy+dy) + "px";
        it.x = ox+dx; it.y = oy+dy;
      };
      const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", mv); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", mv);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
    });
    el.addEventListener("dblclick", () => launch(it));
  }

  function launch(it) {
    if (it.app === "finder") openApp("finder", { path: it.path });
    else if (it.app === "textedit" && it.file === "readme") {
      openApp("textedit", { text: readmeText(), title: "Read Me" });
    } else openApp(it.app);
  }

  function readmeText() {
    return `Welcome to Macintosh.

Mac OS X 10.4 “Tiger”  —  Aqua Desktop Recreation
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
This is a self-contained homage to the classic Mac OS X
desktop. A few things to try:

  • Double-click icons on the Desktop or in the Dock
  • Drag windows by their title bars; traffic lights work
  • The Dock magnifies as you mouse across it
  • ⌘Space opens Spotlight
  • Right-click the desktop for a contextual menu
  • Apple menu → Sleep, Restart, Shut Down
  • Open Terminal and type  help
  • System Preferences → Appearance (Aqua / Graphite)
  • Safari has a few “sites” bookmarked
  • TextEdit documents can live on the Desktop
  • Empty the Trash from its Dock icon (right-click)

This machine is not connected to the Internet.
There is no truth, only Tasteful Pinstripes.

— The Macintosh Team, 2005
`;
  }

  /* ---------- dock ---------- */
  function buildDock() {
    const dock = $("#dock");
    dock.innerHTML = "";
    dockApps.forEach(id => {
      dock.appendChild(makeDockItem(id, APPS[id]));
    });
    const sep = document.createElement("div");
    sep.className = "dock-sep";
    dock.appendChild(sep);
    dock.appendChild(makeDockItem("trash", APPS.trash));
    enableMagnify(dock);
  }

  function makeDockItem(id, app) {
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "dock-item";
    el.dataset.app = id;
    const pal = {
      finder: "#6ec6ff", safari: "#4a90d9", textedit: "#f4f4f4", itunes: "#6b5",
      ical: "#e66", calc: "#888", stickies: "#ffe66a", term: "#222",
      prefs: "#9ab", chess: "#c4a574", trash: "#889"
    };
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="tip">${app.name}</div>
      <div class="di" style="background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.5),${pal[id]||"#ccc"})">${app.icon}</div>
      <div class="dot"></div>`;
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      bounce(el);
      if (id === "trash") openTrash();
      else openApp(id);
    });
    el.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      if (id === "trash") {
        showCtx(e.clientX, e.clientY, [
          { label: "Open", fn: openTrash },
          { label: "Empty Trash…", fn: emptyTrash }
        ]);
      } else {
        showCtx(e.clientX, e.clientY, [
          { label: "Open", fn: () => openApp(id) },
          { label: "Show in Finder", fn: () => openApp("finder", { path: "Applications" }) }
        ]);
      }
    });
    return el;
  }

  function bounce(el) {
    el.classList.remove("bounce");
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add("bounce");
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("bounce"), 750);
  }

  function markDockOpen() {
    $$(".dock-item").forEach(el => {
      const id = el.dataset.app;
      const open = windows.some(w => w.app === id && !w.gone);
      el.classList.toggle("open", open);
    });
  }

  function enableMagnify(dock) {
    dock.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
      const items = $$(".dock-item", dock);
      items.forEach(it => {
        const r = it.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = r.left + r.width/2;
        const dist = Math.abs(e.clientX - cx);
        const scale = Math.max(1, 1.75 - dist/90);
        it.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;
        it.style.margin = `0 ${4+(scale-1)*10}px`;
      });
    });
    dock.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      $$(".dock-item", dock).forEach(it => {
        it.style.transform = "";
        it.style.margin = "";
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- window manager ---------- */
  function openApp(app, opts={}) {
    beep(880, 0.04, "square", 0.03);
    const existing = windows.find(w => w.app === app && !w.gone && w.singleton);
    if (existing && ["prefs","calc","itunes","about"].includes(app)) {
      focusWin(existing);
      if (existing.el.classList.contains("minning")) restoreWin(existing);
      return existing;
    }
    const spec = builders[app] ? builders[app](opts) : builders.finder(opts);
    const w = createWindow({ ...spec, app, ...opts });
    const dm = $(`.dock-item[data-app="${app}"]`);
    if (dm) bounce(dm);
    setAppMenu(APPS[app]?.name || spec.title);
    return w;
  }

  function createWindow({ title, w=480, h=320, x, y, body, app, chrome, sticky, noResize, singleton }) {
    const desk = $("#desk");
    const id = "w" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8);
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "win" + (sticky ? " sticky-win" : "");
    const vw = innerWidth, vh = innerHeight;
    x = x ?? 60 + (windows.length*26)%220;
    y = y ?? 50 + (windows.length*22)%160;
    el.style.width = w + "px";
    el.style.height = h + "px";
    el.style.left = x + "px";
    el.style.top = y + "px";
    el.style.zIndex = ++zTop;
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="titlebar">
        <div class="tls">
          <div class="tl close" title="Close"></div>
          <div class="tl min" title="Minimize"></div>
          <div class="tl zoom" title="Zoom"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="wtitle">${esc(title)}</div>
        <div style="width:54px"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="wbody ${chrome||""}"></div>
      ${noResize ? "" : '<div class="resize"></div>'}`;
    el.querySelector(".wbody").appendChild(body);
    desk.appendChild(el);

    const rec = { id, el, app, title, x, y, w, h, gone:false, maximized:false, singleton };
    windows.push(rec);
    bindWindow(rec);
    focusWin(rec);
    markDockOpen();
    refreshWinMenu();
    return rec;
  }

  function bindWindow(rec) {
    const el = rec.el;
    const bar = el.querySelector(".titlebar");
    el.addEventListener("mousedown", () => focusWin(rec));
    el.querySelector(".close").addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeWin(rec); });
    el.querySelector(".min").addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); minimizeWin(rec); });
    el.querySelector(".zoom").addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); zoomWin(rec); });

    bar.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
      if (e.target.closest(".tl")) return;
      if (rec.maximized) return;
      const sx = e.clientX, sy = e.clientY;
      const ox = el.offsetLeft, oy = el.offsetTop;
      const mv = ev => {
        el.style.left = (ox + ev.clientX - sx) + "px";
        el.style.top = Math.max(0, oy + ev.clientY - sy) + "px";
      };
      const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", mv); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", mv);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
    });

    const rz = el.querySelector(".resize");
    if (rz) rz.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const sx = e.clientX, sy = e.clientY;
      const ow = el.offsetWidth, oh = el.offsetHeight;
      const mv = ev => {
        el.style.width = Math.max(240, ow + ev.clientX - sx) + "px";
        el.style.height = Math.max(120, oh + ev.clientY - sy) + "px";
      };
      const up = () => { window.removeEventListener("mousemove", mv); window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up); };
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", mv);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
    });
  }

  function focusWin(rec) {
    if (!rec || rec.gone) return;
    windows.forEach(w => w.el.classList.add("inactive"));
    rec.el.classList.remove("inactive");
    rec.el.style.zIndex = ++zTop;
    active = rec;
    setAppMenu(APPS[rec.app]?.name || rec.title);
    refreshWinMenu();
  }

  function closeWin(rec) {
    rec.gone = true;
    rec.el.remove();
    windows = windows.filter(w => w !== rec);
    const next = [...windows].sort((a,b)=>b.el.style.zIndex - a.el.style.zIndex)[0];
    active = next || null;
    if (next) focusWin(next);
    else setAppMenu("Finder");
    markDockOpen();
    refreshWinMenu();
  }

  function minimizeWin(rec) {
    const dock = $(`.dock-item[data-app="${rec.app}"]`) || $(".dock-item[data-app='trash']");
    const r = dock.getBoundingClientRect();
    const wr = rec.el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dx = r.left - wr.left, dy = r.bottom - wr.top;
    rec.el.classList.add("minning");
    rec.el.style.transform = `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(.08)`;
    rec.minimized = true;
  }

  function restoreWin(rec) {
    rec.el.classList.remove("minning");
    rec.el.style.transform = "";
    rec.minimized = false;
    focusWin(rec);
  }

  function zoomWin(rec) {
    if (rec.maximized) {
      rec.el.style.left = rec.ox + "px";
      rec.el.style.top = rec.oy + "px";
      rec.el.style.width = rec.ow + "px";
      rec.el.style.height = rec.oh + "px";
      rec.el.classList.remove("maxd");
      rec.maximized = false;
    } else {
      rec.ox = rec.el.offsetLeft; rec.oy = rec.el.offsetTop;
      rec.ow = rec.el.offsetWidth; rec.oh = rec.el.offsetHeight;
      rec.el.style.left = "0px";
      rec.el.style.top = "0px";
      rec.el.style.width = innerWidth + "px";
      rec.el.style.height = (innerHeight - 70) + "px";
      rec.el.classList.add("maxd");
      rec.maximized = true;
    }
  }

  function setAppMenu(name) {
    const label = $("#appmenu").childNodes[0];
    $("#appmenu").childNodes[0].textContent = name + " ";

  }

    const dd = $("#winmenu");

  }

          ${["C","±","%","÷","7","8","9","×","4","5","6","−","1","2","3","+","0",".","=","="].slice(0,19).map((k,i)=>

          ).join("")}
        </div>`;
      // rebuild grid cleanly
      wrap.querySelector(".calc-grid").innerHTML = ["C","±","%","÷","7","8","9","×","4","5","6","−","1","2","3","+","0",".","="].map(k =>
        `<button class="cb ${"÷×−+".includes(k)?"op":k==="="?"eq":""}">${k}</button>`
      ).join("");
      const disp = wrap.querySelector(".calc-disp");
      let cur = "0", acc = null, op = null, fresh = false;
      const show = () => { disp.textContent = cur; };
      const apply = () => {
        const a = parseFloat(acc), b = parseFloat(cur);
        if (op === "+") cur = String(a+b);
        if (op === "−") cur = String(a-b);
        if (op === "×") cur = String(a*b);
        if (op === "÷") cur = b===0 ? "Error" : String(a/b);
        if (cur !== "Error" && cur.length > 12) cur = String(Number(cur).toPrecision(10));
      };
      wrap.querySelectorAll(".cb").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
        const k = b.textContent;
        beep(620, 0.03, "square", 0.025);

  /* ---------- terminal commands ---------- */
  function runTerm(cmd, wrap, prompt) {
    const out = (t) => {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.className = "line";
      d.textContent = t;
      wrap.appendChild(d);
    };
    const html = (t) => {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.className = "line";
      d.innerHTML = t;
      wrap.appendChild(d);
    };
    const [c, ...rest] = cmd.trim().split(/\s+/);
    const arg = rest.join(" ");
    const cmds = {
      help: () => out("Commands: help, ls, cd, pwd, whoami, date, uname, echo, clear, open, fortune, history, neofetch, say, calc, apple, exit"),
      ls: () => out("Applications  Documents  Library  Music  Pictures  Public  Sites  Desktop"),
      pwd: () => out("/Users/guest"),
      whoami: () => out("guest"),
      date: () => out(new Date().toString()),
      uname: () => out("Darwin Macintosh.local 8.11.0 Power Macintosh"),
      echo: () => out(arg),
      clear: () => { wrap.innerHTML = ""; },
      history: () => out("(use Up/Down arrows)"),
      cd: () => out(arg ? `cd: ${arg}: no such file or directory (this $HOME is eternal)` : ""),
      open: () => {
        const map = { finder:1, safari:1, textedit:1, calculator:"calc", terminal:"term", itunes:1, stickies:1, chess:1, preview:1, ical:1 };
        let k = arg.toLowerCase().replace(/\.app$/,"");
        if (k==="calculator") k="calc";
        if (k==="terminal") k="term";
        if (APPS[k] || k==="calc" || k==="term") { openApp(k); out(`Opening ${arg}…`); }
        else out(`The file ${arg} does not exist.`);
      },
      fortune: () => {
        const f = [
          "Stay hungry. Stay foolish.",
          "Real artists ship.",
          "It just works.",
          "Think different.",
          "The best way to predict the future is to invent it.",
          "Your desktop, now with 20% more pinstripe."
        ];
        out(f[Math.floor(Math.random()*f.length)]);
      },
      neofetch: () => html(`<pre style="color:#6cf">
                    'c.          guest@Macintosh
                 ,xNMM.          --------------
               .OMMMMo           OS: Mac OS X 10.4.11 Tiger
               OMMM0,            Host: Power Mac G5
     .;loddo:' loolloddol;.      Kernel: Darwin 8.11.0
   cKMMMMMMMMMMNWMMMMMMMMMM0:    Uptime: since you arrived
 .KMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMWd.    Packages: 128 (fink)
 XMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMX.      Shell: bash 2.05b
;MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM:       DE: Aqua
:MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM:       WM: Quartz Compositor
.MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMX.      Theme: Graphite=${graphite}
 kMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMWd.    Terminal: Terminal.app
 .XMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMk   CPU: PowerPC G5 2.3 GHz
  .XMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMK.   Memory: 412MB / 2048MB
    kMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMd
     ;KMMMMMMMWXXWMMMMMMMk.
       .cooc,.    .,coo:.
</pre>`),
      say: () => { out(`☺ “${arg || "Hello"}”`); beep(300,.2,"sine",.06); },
      calc: () => { try { out(String(Function(`"use strict";return (${arg})`)())); } catch { out("NaN"); } },
      apple: () => html("  <i>byte me</i>"),
      exit: () => { const w = windows.find(x => x.el.contains(wrap)); if (w) closeWin(w); }
    };
    if (!c) { prompt(); return; }
    if (cmds[c]) cmds[c]();
    else out(`-bash: ${c}: command not found`);
    prompt();
    wrap.scrollTop = wrap.scrollHeight;
  }

  function doAct(act, el) {
    const map = {
      about: () => openApp("about"),
      "about-app": () => alertish(`${active ? (APPS[active.app]?.name || active.title) : "Finder"}\nVersion 10.4.11`),
      prefs: () => openApp("prefs"),
      spot: () => toggleSpot(),
      sleep: () => sleep(),
      restart: () => { if (confirmish("Are you sure you want to restart your computer?")) restart(); },
      shutdown: () => { if (confirmish("Are you sure you want to shut down your computer now?")) shutdown(); },
      logout: () => { if (confirmish("Are you sure you want to quit all applications and log out now?")) logout(); },
      forcequit: () => forceQuit(),
      close: () => { if (active) closeWin(active); },
      min: () => { if (active) minimizeWin(active); },
      hide: () => { if (active) minimizeWin(active); },
      "new-finder": () => openApp("finder"),
      "new-folder": () => {
        deskItems.push({ id:"fld"+Date.now(), name:"untitled folder", glyph:"📁", x:80, y:80, app:"finder", path:"Desktop" });
        layoutDesktop();
      },
      "new-sticky": () => openApp("stickies"),
      open: () => { const it = deskItems.find(d => selectedIcons.has(d.id)); if (it) launch(it); },
      getinfo: () => {
        const it = deskItems.find(d => selectedIcons.has(d.id));
        alertish(it ? `${it.name}\nKind: ${it.app||"folder"}\nWhere: Desktop\nCreated: Today` : "Macintosh HD\nKind: Volume\nCapacity: 160 GB\nAvailable: 92 GB");
      },
      clean: () => { deskItems.forEach((d,i) => { d.x = null; d.y = 20+i*90; }); layoutDesktop(); },
      wallpaper: () => openApp("prefs"),
      graphite: () => setGraphite(!graphite),
      "go-comp": () => openApp("finder", { path: "Macintosh HD" }),
      "go-home": () => openApp("finder", { path: "Home" }),
      "go-apps": () => openApp("finder", { path: "Applications" }),
      "go-docs": () => openApp("finder", { path: "Documents" }),
      cycle: () => {
        const live = windows.filter(w => !w.gone);
        if (!live.length) return;
        const i = live.indexOf(active);
        const n = live[(i+1)%live.length];
        if (n.minimized) restoreWin(n); else focusWin(n);
      },
      help: () => openApp("help"),
      undo: () => document.execCommand("undo"),
      cut: () => document.execCommand("cut"),
      copy: () => document.execCommand("copy"),
      paste: () => document.execCommand("paste"),
      selectall: () => document.execCommand("selectAll"),
      focus: () => {
        const w = windows.find(x => x.id === el.dataset.id);
        if (w) { if (w.minimized) restoreWin(w); else focusWin(w); }
      }
    };
    (map[act] || (()=>{}))();
  }
