  $("#spotin").addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const items = $$("#spot-res div");
    let hi = items.findIndex(i => i.classList.contains("hi"));
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { hi = Math.min(items.length-1, hi+1); items.forEach((x,i)=>x.classList.toggle("hi", i===hi)); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { hi = Math.max(0, hi-1); items.forEach((x,i)=>x.classList.toggle("hi", i===hi)); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      const t = items[hi>=0?hi:0];
      if (t) { openApp(t.dataset.app); closeMenus(); }
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeMenus();
  });
  function renderSpot(q) {
    q = q.toLowerCase();
    const hits = Object.entries(APPS).filter(([,a]) => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    $("#spot-res").innerHTML = hits.map(([k,a],i) =>
      `<div data-app="${k}" class="${i===0?"hi":""}"><span>${a.icon}</span> ${esc(a.name)}</div>`
    ).join("") || `<div class="dis">No results</div>`;
    $$("#spot-res div[data-app]").forEach(d => d.onclick = () => { openApp(d.dataset.app); closeMenus(); });
  }

  /* ---------- context menu ---------- */
  function showCtx(x,y, items) {
    const c = $("#ctx");
    c.innerHTML = items.map(it => it.sep ? `<div class="mi-sep"></div>` : `<div class="mi">${esc(it.label)}</div>`).join("");
    c.classList.add("on");
    c.style.left = Math.min(x, innerWidth-200) + "px";
    c.style.top = Math.min(y, innerHeight-200) + "px";
    $$("#ctx .mi").forEach((el,i) => {
      const it = items.filter(z=>!z.sep)[i] || items[i];
      el.onclick = () => { c.classList.remove("on"); it.fn && it.fn(); };
    });
  }
  $("#desk").addEventListener("contextmenu", e => {
    if (e.target.closest(".win") || e.target.closest(".dicon")) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    showCtx(e.clientX, e.clientY, [
      { label: "New Folder", fn: () => doAct("new-folder") },
      { label: "Get Info", fn: () => doAct("getinfo") },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Change Desktop Background…", fn: () => openApp("prefs") },
      { label: "Clean Up", fn: () => doAct("clean") }
    ]);
  });

  /* ---------- dialogs ---------- */
  function alertish(msg) {
    makeDialog("Alert", msg, [{label:"OK", blue:true}]);
  }
  function confirmish(msg) {
    // synchronous-ish via blocking? we'll use window.confirm for restart flows to keep simple
    return window.confirm(msg);
  }
  function makeDialog(title, msg, buttons) {
    const body = document.createElement("div");
    body.style.cssText = "padding:18px 20px;font-size:12px;min-width:260px";
    body.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start">
      <div style="font-size:36px">💻</div>
      <div><b>${esc(title)}</b><p style="margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(msg)}</p>
      <div style="margin-top:14px;text-align:right" class="dbtns"></div></div></div>`;
    const w = createWindow({ title, w: 380, h: 160, body, noResize:true, app:"finder" });
    buttons.forEach(b => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "btn" + (b.blue?" blue":"");
      btn.textContent = b.label;
      btn.onclick = () => { closeWin(w); b.fn && b.fn(); };
      body.querySelector(".dbtns").appendChild(btn);
    });
    return w;
  }
  function forceQuit() {
    const body = document.createElement("div");
    body.style.cssText = "padding:16px;font-size:12px";
    const live = windows.filter(w => !w.gone);
    body.innerHTML = `<p style="margin-bottom:8px">Force Quit Applications</p>
      <div style="border:1px solid #888;height:140px;overflow:auto;background:#fff">
        ${live.map(w=>`<div class="fq" data-id="${w.id}" style="padding:4px 8px">${esc(APPS[w.app]?.name||w.title)}</div>`).join("") || "<div style='padding:8px;color:#888'>No applications</div>"}
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button class="btn" id="fqc">Cancel</button> <button class="btn blue" id="fqf">Force Quit</button></div>`;
    const w = createWindow({ title:"Force Quit Applications", w:360, h:250, body, noResize:true, app:"finder" });
    let pick=null;
    $$(".fq", body).forEach(el => el.onclick = () => { $$(".fq",body).forEach(x=>x.style.background=""); el.style.background="#316ac5"; el.style.color="#fff"; pick=el.dataset.id; });
    body.querySelector("#fqc").onclick = () => closeWin(w);
    body.querySelector("#fqf").onclick = () => {
      const t = windows.find(x => x.id===pick);
      if (t) closeWin(t);
      closeWin(w);
    };
  }

  /* ---------- look / wallpaper ---------- */
  function setGraphite(on) {
    graphite = on;
    $("#menubar").classList.toggle("graphite", on);
    $("#wallpaper").classList.toggle("graphite", on && wallpaperIdx===0);
  }
  function setWall(i) {
    wallpaperIdx = i;
    const wp = $("#wallpaper");
    if (i===0) { wp.style.background = ""; }
    else wp.style.background = walls[i];
  }

  /* ---------- power ---------- */
  function sleep() {
    const o = $("#overlay-fx");
    o.className = "sleep";
    o.onclick = () => { o.className=""; o.onclick=null; beep(660,.08,"sine",.05); };
  }
  function restart() {
    windows.slice().forEach(w => { if (!w.gone) closeWin(w); });
    $("#world").classList.remove("on");
    $("#boot").classList.remove("hidden");
    $("#bootbar").style.width = "0%";
    $("#bootcap").textContent = "Starting Mac OS X…";
    boot();
  }
  function shutdown() {
    const o = $("#overlay-fx");
    o.className = "shutdown";
    $("#world").style.display = "none";
    setTimeout(() => {
      o.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#444;font-size:12px;position:fixed;bottom:20px;width:100%;text-align:center">It is now safe to close this tab.<br><span style="opacity:.5">Click to start up</span></div>`;
      o.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
      o.onclick = () => location.reload();
    }, 800);
  }
  function logout() {
    windows.slice().forEach(w => { if (!w.gone) closeWin(w); });
    $("#world").classList.remove("on");
    $("#login").classList.add("show");
    $("#loginpw").value = "";
    $("#loginpw").focus();
  }

  /* ---------- keyboard ---------- */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const meta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (meta && e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); toggleSpot(); }
    if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === "w") { e.preventDefault(); if (active) closeWin(active); }
    if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === "m") { e.preventDefault(); if (active) minimizeWin(active); }
    if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === "n") { e.preventDefault(); openApp("finder"); }
    if (meta && e.key === ",") { e.preventDefault(); openApp("prefs"); }
    if (meta && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "q") { e.preventDefault(); doAct("logout"); }
    if (e.key === "F11") {
      e.preventDefault();
      windows.forEach(w => { if (!w.gone && !w.minimized) minimizeWin(w); });
    }
    if (e.key === "F9") {
      e.preventDefault();
      // humble exposé: tile windows
      const live = windows.filter(w => !w.gone && !w.minimized);
      live.forEach((w,i) => {
        const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(live.length));
        const ww = Math.floor((innerWidth-40)/cols);
        const hh = Math.floor((innerHeight-100)/Math.ceil(live.length/cols));
        w.el.style.left = (10 + (i%cols)*ww) + "px";
        w.el.style.top = (10 + Math.floor(i/cols)*hh) + "px";
        w.el.style.width = (ww-10) + "px";
        w.el.style.height = (hh-10) + "px";
        w.maximized = false;
      });
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeMenus();
  });

  /* ---------- volume slider ---------- */
  $("#vol").addEventListener("input", e => { volume = e.target.value/100; beep(440,0.05,"sine",0.06); });

  /* ---------- restore minimized from dock click if already open ---------- */
  // handled in openApp / existing window

  // Click dock of already-open minimized window
  const _openApp = openApp;
  // wrap after define: clicking dock restores
  document.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const di = e.target.closest(".dock-item");
    if (!di) return;
    const recs = windows.filter(w => w.app === di.dataset.app && !w.gone && w.minimized);
    recs.forEach(restoreWin);
  }, true);

  /* ---------- resize desktop icons on window resize ---------- */
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    deskItems.forEach(d => { if (d.x==null) {} });
    layoutDesktop();
  });

  /* go */
  boot();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#91aaa9">
<title>Macintosh • Somewhere in 1999</title>
<style>
:root {
  --platinum:#d9d9d9; --light:#fff; --shadow:#888; --ink:#202020;
  --accent:#4658a4; --desktop:#7c9d9b; --menu-height:29px;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body { width:100%; height:100%; margin:0; overflow:hidden; }
body { font:12px Geneva,Tahoma,Verdana,sans-serif; color:var(--ink); background:#111; }
button,input,textarea,select { font:inherit; }
button { color:inherit; }
button, .desktop-icon, .file-icon { -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
button { cursor:pointer; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline:2px dotted var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }
button:disabled { cursor:default; color:#888; }
::selection { background:#344899; color:white; }
.hidden { display:none!important; }
svg.icon { width:40px; height:40px; overflow:visible; image-rendering:pixelated; flex-shrink:0; }
.icon.small { width:23px; height:23px; }
#desktop {
  position:fixed; inset:0; overflow:hidden; user-select:none;
  background:var(--desktop);
}
.wallpaper { position:absolute; inset:var(--menu-height) 0 0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; }
#landscape { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }
#desktop[data-theme="teal"] .wallpaper {
  background-color:#71928c;
  background-image:repeating-conic-gradient(#799b9500 0 25%,#526e6738 0 50%);
  background-size:4px 4px;
}
#desktop[data-theme="teal"] #landscape,
#desktop[data-theme="space"] #landscape { display:none; }
#desktop[data-theme="space"] .wallpaper {
  background-color:#182136;
  background-image:radial-gradient(1px 1px at 20px 30px,#fff 99%,transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 80px,#c0d0ed 99%,transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 135px 20px,#ffffff88 99%,transparent),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 100%,#514562,transparent 70%);
  background-size:160px 120px,200px 180px,220px 170px,100% 100%;
}
.wallpaper::after {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.045;
  background-image:repeating-conic-gradient(#000 0 25%,transparent 0 50%);
  background-size:3px 3px;
}
#desktop::after {
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:99999;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #0005;
}
#menubar {
  position:absolute; inset:0 0 auto; height:var(--menu-height); z-index:10000;
  display:flex; align-items:stretch; padding:0 9px;
  background:linear-gradient(#fff 0%,#f1f1f1 47%,#d6d6d6 100%);
  border-bottom:1px solid #222; box-shadow:0 1px #ffffff66;
}
.menu-button {
  border:0; background:none; padding:0 12px; min-width:35px; font-size:12px;
}
.menu-button.bold { font-weight:bold; }
.menu-button:hover, .menu-button.open { background:#303f8a; color:white; }
.menu-button.apple { padding:0 10px; display:grid; place-items:center; }
.rainbow-apple { width:17px; height:20px; }
.menu-spacer { flex:1; }
#clock { min-width:81px; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:11px; white-space:nowrap; }
#sound-toggle { padding:0 8px; border:0; background:none; font-size:15px; }
#menu-app { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-left:10px; padding-left:10px; border-left:1px solid #aaa; font-size:11px; }
#menu-app svg { width:17px; height:17px; }
.dropdown {
  position:fixed; z-index:12000; min-width:208px;
  padding:4px 0; border:1px solid #222; background:#eee;
  box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #0008,inset 1px 1px white;
  user-select:none;
}
.dropdown button {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; width:100%; text-align:left;
  border:0; padding:6px 18px; background:none; font-size:12px;
}
.dropdown button:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#34458c; color:white; }
.dropdown .shortcut { margin-left:auto; color:#666; font-size:10px; }
.dropdown button:hover .shortcut { color:inherit; }
.dropdown hr { border:0; border-top:1px solid #aaa; border-bottom:1px solid white; margin:4px 1px; }
.desktop-icon {
  position:absolute; width:90px; min-height:76px; display:flex; align-items:center;
  flex-direction:column; gap:5px; padding:5px 2px; cursor:default; touch-action:none;
  border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px;
}
.desktop-icon .label {
  background:#e7e4df; box-shadow:1px 1px #0003; padding:2px 4px;
  text-align:center; font-size:11px; line-height:14px; max-width:100%;
}
.desktop-icon.selected { background:#ffffff15; border:1px dotted #fff9; }
.desktop-icon.selected .label { background:#35488f; color:white; }
.desktop-icon.selected .icon { filter:brightness(.8) sepia(.1) saturate(1.5); }
.desktop-icon.dragging { z-index:9000; opacity:.8; }
#desktop-caption {
  position:absolute; bottom:70px; left:28px; color:#fff9;
  font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; pointer-events:none;
  text-shadow:0 1px #0002;
}
#control-strip {
  position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:13px; transform:translateX(-50%);
  min-height:45px; z-index:8000; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px;
  padding:4px 8px 4px 5px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(#eee,#d0d0d0);
  box-shadow:inset 1px 1px white,inset -1px -1px #999,2px 3px 0 #0003;
}
.strip-grip { width:6px; height:28px; margin:0 4px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#999 0 1px,#eee 1px 3px); }
.launcher {
  position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; height:35px;
  border:1px solid transparent; background:none;
}
.launcher svg { width:29px; height:29px; transition:transform .12s; }
.launcher:hover { background:#eee; border-color:#aaa; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px white; }
.launcher:hover svg { transform:translateY(-2px); }
.launcher.running::after { content:""; position:absolute; bottom:0; width:3px; height:3px; background:#222; }
.launcher::before {
  content:attr(data-tip); position:absolute; bottom:45px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
  white-space:nowrap; background:#ffffdf; border:1px solid #555; padding:4px 6px;
  box-shadow:1px 1px #0003; display:none; font-size:10px;
}
.launcher:hover::before { display:block; }
.strip-divider { height:27px; width:1px; background:#aaa; box-shadow:1px 0 white; margin:0 4px; }
#tasks { display:flex; gap:4px; }
.task { max-width:110px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; height:29px; }
.window {
  position:absolute; display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:240px; min-height:170px;
  padding:3px; border:1px solid #262626; background:var(--platinum);
  box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #fff,inset -1px -1px #999,2px 3px 0 #0004;
  user-select:none;
}
.window.active { box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #fff,inset -1px -1px #888,3px 4px 0 #0005; }
.titlebar { height:24px; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 4px; cursor:grab; touch-action:none; }
.titlebar:active { cursor:grabbing; }
.title-stripes { height:15px; flex:1; background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#969696 0 1px,#f5f5f5 1px 2px,#c4c4c4 2px 3px); opacity:.35; }
.active .title-stripes { opacity:1; }
.window-title { font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; color:#777; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; padding:0 3px; }
.active .window-title { color:#151515; }
.window-control {
  padding:0; width:13px; height:13px; flex-shrink:0; border:1px solid #777;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#b9b9b9); box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #eee,inset -1px -1px #999;
  display:grid; place-items:center;
}
.window-control:hover { background:#fff; border-color:#222; }
.window-control:active { background:#999; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #555; }
.window-control.close:hover::after { content:"×"; font-size:13px; line-height:10px; }
.window-control.zoom::after { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; border:1px solid #666; border-top-width:2px; }
.window-control.minimize::after { content:""; width:7px; height:2px; background:#666; }
.window-content { flex:1; min-height:0; overflow:auto; border:1px solid #777; box-shadow:0 1px #fff; background:#fff; position:relative; user-select:text; }
.window-footer {
  height:18px; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding:2px 16px 0 6px; color:#555; font-size:9px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap;
}
.window-footer .right { margin-left:auto; }
.resize-handle {
  position:absolute; bottom:2px; right:2px; width:14px; height:14px; cursor:nwse-resize; touch-action:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 3px,#888 3px 4px,#eee 4px 5px);
  clip-path:polygon(100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
}
.classic-btn {
  border:1px solid #333; border-radius:3px; background:linear-gradient(#fff,#ddd);
  box-shadow:inset 1px 1px white,inset -1px -1px #aaa,0 1px 0 #0002;
  padding:5px 13px; min-height:27px;
}
.classic-btn:active, .classic-btn.pressed { background:#c0c0c0; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #777; transform:translateY(1px); }
.classic-btn.primary { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #555,inset 1px 1px white,inset -1px -1px #aaa; margin:2px; font-weight:bold; }
.classic-input { border:1px solid #555; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #bbb; background:white; padding:5px 7px; }
.toolbar { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; flex-wrap:wrap; background:#dedede; border-bottom:1px solid #888; padding:7px 9px; user-select:none; }
.toolbar .classic-btn { padding:3px 9px; min-height:24px; }
.small-print { font-size:10px; color:#707070; line-height:1.5; }
.inset { border:1px solid #888; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #aaa,1px 1px white; }

/* Welcome */
.welcome { background:#f4f1e9; min-height:100%; }
.welcome-hero { display:flex; gap:25px; align-items:center; padding:27px 30px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid #bcbab2; }
.mac-illustration { flex-shrink:0; width:112px; height:120px; filter:drop-shadow(3px 4px 0 #0002); }
.eyebrow { text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:2.1px; font-size:9px; color:#72736d; margin-bottom:9px; }
.welcome h1 { font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif; font-weight:normal; font-size:34px; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:1.08; margin:0 0 12px; }
.welcome p { line-height:1.65; font-size:11px; color:#55564f; margin:0; max-width:300px; }
.welcome-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; padding:17px 22px; gap:10px; }
.welcome-card { display:flex; text-align:left; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:11px; border:1px solid #c5c2b9; background:#fffcf5; box-shadow:1px 1px white; }
.welcome-card:hover { background:#e5e8f2; border-color:#8d95b6; }
.welcome-card svg { width:30px; height:30px; }
.welcome-card strong { display:block; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:4px; }
.welcome-card span { font-size:9px; color:#74746c; }
.welcome-bottom { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 25px 17px; font-size:9px; color:#777; }
.rainbow-line { height:4px; background:linear-gradient(to right,#6caa5d 0 16.66%,#f4d653 16.66% 33.33%,#e79745 33.33% 50%,#ce626b 50% 66.66%,#8e6b9b 66.66% 83.33%,#689cbd 83.33%); }

/* Finder */
.finder-shell { height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.finder-info { text-align:center; background:#eee; padding:5px; font-size:10px; border-bottom:1px solid #aaa; }
.finder-body { display:flex; flex:1; min-height:0; }
.finder-sidebar { width:113px; background:#eee; border-right:1px solid #aaa; padding:10px 5px; flex-shrink:0; }
.finder-sidebar label { display:block; padding:1px 6px 7px; font-size:9px; color:#888; letter-spacing:1px; }
.finder-sidebar button { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:0; background:none; width:100%; padding:6px; text-align:left; font-size:10px; }
.finder-sidebar button svg { width:19px; height:19px; }
.finder-sidebar button.selected { background:#bdc7e1; }
.files { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(85px,1fr)); align-content:start; gap:12px 3px; flex:1; padding:15px 10px; overflow:auto; }
.file-icon { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; border:1px solid transparent; background:none; padding:7px 2px; font-size:10px; text-align:center; min-height:74px; }
.file-icon:hover { background:#eef0f7; border:1px dotted #a3abc6; }
.files.list { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0; padding:0; }
.files.list .file-icon { flex-direction:row; padding:6px 13px; min-height:35px; gap:12px; text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid #eee; }
.files.list .file-icon svg { width:23px; height:23px; }

/* Notes */
.notes-shell { height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#fff7b8; }
.notes-meta { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:8px 13px; border-bottom:1px solid #d7cd89; font-size:9px; color:#817541; background:#f3e8a2; }
.notes-paper {
  flex:1; min-height:0; border:0; outline:none; resize:none; padding:15px 18px;
  font:13px/25px 'Courier New',monospace; color:#4f4731;

  background-position:0 15px; user-select:text;
}
.notes-actions { padding:6px 10px; border-top:1px solid #dacd86; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.notes-actions .classic-btn { font-size:10px; padding:3px 9px; min-height:23px; background:#fff8cc; }

/* Paint */
.paint-shell { height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#bbb; }
.paint-tools { gap:5px; }
.swatch { width:19px; height:19px; padding:0; border:1px solid #555; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #ffffff60; }
.swatch.chosen { outline:2px solid #222; outline-offset:1px; }
.paint-stage { overflow:auto; flex:1; min-height:0; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:14px; background:repeating-conic-gradient(#c8c8c8 0 25%,#c0c0c0 0 50%) 0/12px 12px; }
#paint-canvas { background:white; max-width:100%; height:auto; border:1px solid #333; box-shadow:2px 2px #0003; touch-action:none; cursor:crosshair; }
.paint-status { padding:5px 10px; font-size:9px; background:#ddd; border-top:1px solid #888; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; }

/* Mines */
.mines-shell { min-height:100%; padding:16px; background:#c6c6c6; text-align:center; user-select:none; }
.mines-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px; border:2px solid; border-color:#888 #fff #fff #888; margin:0 auto 12px; max-width:284px; }
.led { background:#230d0d; color:#ed3838; font:bold 27px 'Courier New',monospace; padding:0 5px; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #000; min-width:60px; text-align:center; }
#mine-reset { font-size:21px; padding:0; width:34px; height:32px; border-radius:0; }
.mine-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(9,30px); width:max-content; margin:auto; border:3px solid; border-color:#888 #fff #fff #888; }
.mine-cell { padding:0; width:30px; height:30px; background:#c6c6c6; border:2px solid; border-color:#fff #858585 #858585 #fff; font:bold 16px 'Courier New',monospace; }
.mine-cell.revealed { border:1px solid #999; background:#c4c4c4; }
.mine-cell.boom { background:#f46a5f; }
.mine-help { margin:13px 0 4px; font-size:10px; color:#555; }
#mine-status { margin-top:8px; min-height:16px; font-weight:bold; font-size:11px; }

/* Synth */
.synth-shell { min-height:100%; background:#e6e3db; }
.synth-top { padding:15px 17px 13px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:15px; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid #b4b1a8; }
.synth-top h2 { margin:0 0 3px; font-size:20px; font-family:Georgia,serif; font-weight:normal; }
.synth-badge { padding:5px 7px; background:#2c3530; color:#a9d39b; font:9px monospace; border:2px inset #999; letter-spacing:1px; }
.synth-controls { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:12px 16px; font-size:10px; }
.synth-controls input { width:85px; accent-color:#4c6254; vertical-align:middle; }
.sequencer { display:grid; grid-template-columns:25px repeat(16,1fr); gap:3px; padding:10px 15px 14px 9px; min-width:400px; }
.seq-label { font:10px monospace; display:grid; place-items:center; color:#73766e; }
.seq-cell { height:22px; padding:0; border:1px solid #a8aaa0; background:#d3d5cd; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #ecefe6; border-radius:1px; }
.seq-cell.beat { background:#c6cac0; }
.seq-cell.on { background:#7f9a71; border-color:#536b48; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px #aac298; }
.seq-cell.playhead { outline:2px solid #d8983e; outline-offset:-2px; }
.synth-scroll { overflow:auto; }
.synth-keyboard { display:flex; gap:5px; padding:0 16px 14px; }
.piano-key { flex:1; height:49px; background:linear-gradient(#fff,#ece9dc); border:1px solid #888; border-bottom:4px solid #a8a597; border-radius:0 0 3px 3px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:4px; padding-bottom:4px; font-size:10px; }
.piano-key:active,.piano-key.lit { background:#b9cfa8; border-bottom-width:1px; }
.piano-key small { color:#999; font-size:8px; }
.synth-bottom { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:9px 16px; border-top:1px solid #bbb9ad; font-size:9px; color:#77786b; }

.terminal-shell { display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100%; background:#171d22; color:#b5d4b4; font:12px/1.55 'Courier New',monospace; padding:12px; }
.terminal-output { flex:1; overflow:auto; white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; user-select:text; }
.terminal-line { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-top:1px solid #b7d2b41f; padding-top:7px; margin-top:5px; }
.terminal-line span { color:#f0c786; white-space:nowrap; }
.terminal-input { width:100%; border:0; outline:0; background:none; color:#d8e9d4; font:inherit; padding:0; }

.settings h3 { margin:0 0 13px; font-size:12px; }
.settings-section { border:1px solid #aaa; box-shadow:1px 1px white; padding:14px; margin-bottom:17px; position:relative; }
.settings-section legend { font-weight:bold; font-size:11px; padding:0 7px; }
.wallpaper-options { display:flex; gap:12px; }

.wallpaper-preview.teal { background:repeating-conic-gradient(#78978f 0 25%,#6c8882 0 50%) 0/4px 4px; }

.setting-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; line-height:1.5; margin:7px 0; font-size:11px; }
.settings .small-print { margin:9px 0 0; }
.calculator { padding:13px; background:#d2d1cb; min-height:100%; }
.calc-display { background:#d3ddbd; border:2px inset #aaa; padding:12px 9px 8px; text-align:right; font:27px 'Courier New',monospace; color:#374534; margin-bottom:12px; overflow:hidden; user-select:text; }
.calc-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:7px; }

.calc-grid .equals { background:linear-gradient(#edc38f,#d7a66c); }
.calc-mark { text-align:center; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#777; padding-top:12px; }

.dialog { width:390px; max-width:100%; border:1px solid black; padding:5px; background:#ddd; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px white,inset -1px -1px #888,4px 5px #0005; }
.dialog-inner { border:2px solid; border-color:white #888 #888 white; padding:23px; }
.dialog-body { display:flex; gap:17px; }
.dialog-body svg { width:43px; height:43px; }
.dialog h3 { font-size:13px; margin:2px 0 11px; }
.dialog p { font-size:11px; line-height:1.7; margin:0; white-space:pre-line; user-select:text; }
.dialog input { width:100%; margin-top:13px; }
.dialog-buttons { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:12px; margin-top:23px; }
#toast { position:absolute; bottom:76px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:25000; max-width:90%; background:#ffffdf; border:1px solid #555; padding:9px 16px; font-size:11px; box-shadow:2px 2px #0004; text-align:center; pointer-events:none; }
#boot { position:fixed; inset:0; background:#d2d5cf; z-index:50000; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-direction:column; transition:opacity .35s; }
.boot-box { width:310px; max-width:85vw; padding:28px 35px; background:#eee; border:1px solid #444; box-shadow:inset 1px 1px white,3px 3px #0003; text-align:center; }
.boot-box .mac-illustration { width:75px; height:80px; }
.boot-box h2 { font-size:17px; font-weight:normal; margin:19px 0; }
.boot-progress { height:13px; border:1px solid #555; background:#ddd; padding:2px; }

@keyframes bootload { from {width:0} to {width:100%} }
@media (max-width:700px) {
  .menu-button { padding:0 8px; font-size:11px; }
  #menu-app { display:none; }
  #clock { min-width:65px; font-size:10px; }
  #sound-toggle { padding:0 3px; }
  #control-strip { bottom:8px; max-width:calc(100% - 16px); gap:0; padding:4px; }
  .launcher { width:35px; }
  .launcher svg { width:26px; height:26px; }
  .strip-grip { display:none; }
  #tasks .task { max-width:65px; font-size:9px; padding:4px; }
  .welcome-hero { padding:23px 20px; gap:16px; }
  .welcome-hero .mac-illustration { width:80px; height:92px; }
  .welcome h1 { font-size:28px; }
  .welcome-grid { padding:14px; gap:7px; }
  .welcome-card { padding:9px 7px; gap:7px; }
  .welcome-card span { font-size:8px; }
  #desktop-caption { display:none; }
  .finder-sidebar { width:96px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
  * { animation-duration:.01ms!important; transition-duration:.01ms!important; }
}

<script>

function audio() {

function tone(freq=440,duration=.1,type='sine',volume=.045) {
  const ctx=audio(); if (!ctx) return;
  const osc=ctx.createOscillator(), gain=ctx.createGain(), now=ctx.currentTime;
  osc.type=type; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume,now+.008);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);
  osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  osc.start(now); osc.stop(now+duration+.015);
}

  const close=()=>{layer.classList.add('hidden');layer.innerHTML='';};
  $('[data-confirm]',layer).onclick=()=>{const value=$('#dialog-input')?.value;close();onConfirm?.(value);clickSound();};
  if(cancel) $('[data-cancel]',layer).onclick=close;

}

Inspired by 1999.\n\nMemory: 128 MB of possibility\nStorage: a lifetime of little ideas\nConnection: happily offline\n\nNo downloads. No accounts. Just a desktop.\nYour notes and preferences stay in this browser.'});

/* ─── Window manager ─── */
function focusWindow(id) {
  const w=state.windows.get(id); if(!w)return;
  if(w.minimized) {w.minimized=false;w.el.classList.remove('hidden');updateTasks();}
  state.active=id; w.el.style.zIndex=++state.z;
  state.windows.forEach((v,k)=>v.el.classList.toggle('active',k===id));
  $('#menu-app').innerHTML=icon(apps[id].icon)+`<span>${escapeHTML(id==='finder'?'Finder':apps[id].title.split(' —')[0])}</span>`;
  $$('[data-menu="finder"]').forEach(b=>b.textContent=id==='finder'?'Finder':id==='welcome'?'Finder':apps[id].title.split(' —')[0]);
}
function closeWindow(id) {
  const w=state.windows.get(id); if(!w)return;
  w.cleanup?.(); w.el.remove(); state.windows.delete(id); clickSound();updateTasks();
  if(state.active===id) {
    const remaining=[...state.windows.values()].filter(v=>!v.minimized).sort((a,b)=>+b.el.style.zIndex-+a.el.style.zIndex);
    if(remaining.length)focusWindow(remaining[0].id);
    else {state.active=null;$('#menu-app').innerHTML=icon('finder')+'<span>Finder</span>';$('[data-menu="finder"]').textContent='Finder';}
  }
}
function minimizeWindow(id) {
  const w=state.windows.get(id); if(!w)return;
  w.minimized=true;w.el.classList.add('hidden');updateTasks();clickSound();
  const next=[...state.windows.values()].filter(v=>!v.minimized).sort((a,b)=>+b.el.style.zIndex-+a.el.style.zIndex)[0];
  if(next)focusWindow(next.id);
  else {state.active=null;$('[data-menu="finder"]').textContent='Finder';$('#menu-app').innerHTML=icon('finder')+'<span>Finder</span>';}
}
function zoomWindow(id) {
  const w=state.windows.get(id);if(!w)return;
  if(w.zoomed) {Object.assign(w.el.style,w.previous);w.zoomed=false;clampWindow(w);}
  else {
    w.previous={left:w.el.style.left,top:w.el.style.top,width:w.el.style.width,height:w.el.style.height};
    Object.assign(w.el.style,{left:'4px',top:'33px',width:(innerWidth-8)+'px',height:(innerHeight-99)+'px'});

function updateTasks() {

function clampWindow(w) {

  if(e.offsetHeight>innerHeight-95)e.style.height=Math.max(170,innerHeight-95)+'px';
  e.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(parseFloat(e.style.left),innerWidth-e.offsetWidth))+'px';
  e.style.top=Math.max(32,Math.min(parseFloat(e.style.top),innerHeight-70-e.offsetHeight))+'px';

function makeDraggable(w) {
  const bar=$('.titlebar',w.el);
  bar.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(e.target.closest('button')||e.button!==0)return;

    if(w.zoomed)return;
    const startX=e.clientX,startY=e.clientY,x=w.el.offsetLeft,y=w.el.offsetTop;
    bar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const move=ev=>{
      w.el.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-w.el.offsetWidth,x+ev.clientX-startX))+'px';
      w.el.style.top=Math.max(31,Math.min(innerHeight-92,y+ev.clientY-startY))+'px';
    };
    const stop=()=>{bar.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);bar.removeEventListener('pointerup',stop);bar.removeEventListener('pointercancel',stop);};
    bar.addEventListener('pointermove',move);bar.addEventListener('pointerup',stop);bar.addEventListener('pointercancel',stop);
  });

  handle.onpointerdown=e=>{
    e.preventDefault();focusWindow(w.id);w.zoomed=false;
    const x=e.clientX,y=e.clientY,width=w.el.offsetWidth,height=w.el.offsetHeight;
    handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    handle.onpointermove=ev=>{
      w.el.style.width=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-w.el.offsetLeft-3,width+ev.clientX-x))+'px';
      w.el.style.height=Math.max(170,Math.min(innerHeight-w.el.offsetTop-62,height+ev.clientY-y))+'px';

  };

/* ─── Desktop icons & drag to trash ─── */

function renderDesktop() {
  const host=$('#desktop-icons');host.innerHTML='';

  items.forEach((item,index)=>{
    const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='desktop-icon';el.tabIndex=0;el.dataset.key=item.key;

    let left,top;
    if(item.key==='trash') {left=innerWidth-108;top=innerHeight-158;}
    else if(item.custom) {left=22+Math.floor((index-baseItems.length)/5)*100;top=55+((index-baseItems.length)%5)*91;}
    else {
      const perCol=Math.max(2,Math.floor((innerHeight-210)/89));
      left=innerWidth-108-Math.floor(index/perCol)*98;top=49+(index%perCol)*89;
    }
    el.style.left=Math.max(5,left)+'px';el.style.top=Math.max(34,top)+'px';
    el.ondblclick=()=>launchItem(item);
    el.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){launchItem(item);e.preventDefault();}};
    el.oncontextmenu=e=>{
      e.preventDefault();selectIcon(item,el);
      showMenu(e.clientX,e.clientY,[
        {label:'Open',action:()=>launchItem(item)},
        {label:'Get Info',action:()=>dialog({title:item.name,message:item.custom?'Kind: Folder\nLocation: Desktop\nContents: a fresh start.':`Kind: ${item.icon==='folder'?'Folder':item.app==='finder'?'Startup disk':'Application'}\nLocation: Macintosh HD\nCreated: Somewhere in 1999`})},
        ...(item.custom?[{separator:true},{label:'Move to Trash',action:()=>trashFolder(item.name)}]:[])
      ]);
    };
    el.onpointerdown=e=>{
      if(e.button!==0)return;
      selectIcon(item,el);
      const x=e.clientX,y=e.clientY,l=el.offsetLeft,t=el.offsetTop;
      let moved=false;
      el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      el.onpointermove=ev=>{
        if(Math.abs(ev.clientX-x)+Math.abs(ev.clientY-y)>5)moved=true;
        if(!moved)return;
        el.classList.add('dragging');
        el.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-90,l+ev.clientX-x))+'px';
        el.style.top=Math.max(32,Math.min(innerHeight-110,t+ev.clientY-y))+'px';
      };
      el.onpointerup=ev=>{
        el.onpointermove=null;el.classList.remove('dragging');
        const trash=$('[data-key="trash"]');
        if(moved&&item.key!=='trash'&&trash){
          const r=trash.getBoundingClientRect();
          if(ev.clientX>=r.left&&ev.clientX<=r.right&&ev.clientY>=r.top&&ev.clientY<=r.bottom){
            if(item.custom)trashFolder(item.name);
            else {el.style.left=l+'px';el.style.top=t+'px';toast('Let’s keep the classics. Only your folders can be trashed.');}
          }
        }
      };
      el.onpointercancel=()=>{el.onpointermove=null;el.classList.remove('dragging');};
    };
    host.append(el);
  });
}

renderers.paint=w=>{

  const canvas=$('canvas',w.content),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  if(paintingSnapshot)ctx.putImageData(paintingSnapshot,0,0);
  let color=colors[0],tool='brush',drawing=false,last=null,undo=[];
  const checkpoint=()=>{
    undo.push(ctx.getImageData(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height));
    if(undo.length>20)undo.shift();
  };
  const snapshot=()=>{paintingSnapshot=ctx.getImageData(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);};
  const pos=e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:(e.clientX-r.left)*canvas.width/r.width,y:(e.clientY-r.top)*canvas.height/r.height};};
  function stroke(p,initial=false){

    ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';
    if(initial){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,ctx.lineWidth/2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
    else {ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(last.x,last.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();}
    last=p;
  }
  canvas.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.button!==0)return;e.preventDefault();checkpoint();drawing=true;canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);stroke(pos(e),true);};
  canvas.onpointermove=e=>{
    const p=pos(e);$('#paint-hint',w.content).textContent=`${Math.round(p.x)}, ${Math.round(p.y)} · ${tool==='brush'?'Brush':'Eraser'}`;

  }

  $('#paint-color',w.content).oninput=e=>pickColor(e.target.value);
  $('#paint-undo',w.content).onclick=()=>{if(undo.length){ctx.putImageData(undo.pop(),0,0);snapshot();}else toast('You’re right back at the beginning.');};
  $('#paint-clear',w.content).onclick=()=>{checkpoint();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,560,290);snapshot();};

  };
  w.cleanup=snapshot;
};

/* Minesweeper: safe first click, flood reveal, flags, and timer. */
renderers.mines=w=>{
  w.content.innerHTML=`<div class="mines-shell"><div class="mines-header"><span class="led" id="mine-count">010</span><button class="classic-btn" id="mine-reset" aria-label="New game">🙂</button><span class="led" id="mine-time">000</span></div>
    <div class="mine-grid" role="group" aria-label="Minesweeper board"></div>
    <div id="mine-status">A little luck. A little logic.</div>
    <div class="mine-help">Click to reveal · Right-click to flag</div>
    <label style="font-size:10px"><input type="checkbox" id="flag-mode"> Flag mode <span style="color:#777">(touch-friendly)</span></label></div>`;
  let cells,started,over,seconds,timer,flags;
  const grid=$('.mine-grid',w.content);
  const neighbors=i=>{
    const list=[],x=i%9,y=Math.floor(i/9);
    for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)if(dx||dy){
      const xx=x+dx,yy=y+dy;if(xx>=0&&xx<9&&yy>=0&&yy<9)list.push(yy*9+xx);
    }
    return list;
  };
  function reset(){
    clearInterval(timer);cells=Array.from({length:81},()=>({mine:false,revealed:false,flag:false,n:0}));
    started=false;over=false;seconds=0;flags=0;
    $('#mine-reset',w.content).textContent='🙂';$('#mine-status',w.content).textContent='A little luck. A little logic.';
    $('#mine-time',w.content).textContent='000';
    render();
  }
  function seed(first){
    const safe=new Set([first,...neighbors(first)]),candidates=cells.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>!safe.has(i));
    for(let n=0;n<10;n++){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length);cells[candidates.splice(j,1)[0]].mine=true;}
    cells.forEach((c,i)=>c.n=neighbors(i).filter(j=>cells[j].mine).length);
    started=true;timer=setInterval(()=>{$('#mine-time',w.content).textContent=String(Math.min(++seconds,999)).padStart(3,'0');},1000);
  }
  function reveal(i){
    const c=cells[i];if(c.revealed||c.flag||over)return;
    c.revealed=true;
    if(c.mine){finish(false,i);return;}
    if(!c.n)neighbors(i).forEach(reveal);
  }
  function finish(win,hit){
    over=true;clearInterval(timer);
    cells.forEach(c=>{if(c.mine){if(win)c.flag=true;else c.revealed=true;}});
    if(hit!==undefined)cells[hit].hit=true;
    if(win)flags=10;
    $('#mine-reset',w.content).textContent=win?'😎':'😵';
    $('#mine-status',w.content).textContent=win?`Beautifully done! ${seconds} seconds.`:'Boom. A fresh start is just one smile away.';
    if(state.sound)tone(win?880:120,win?.25:.35,win?'sine':'sawtooth',.04);
  }
  function render(){
    const colors=['','#294bac','#358443','#c4443d','#382c82','#813932','#318b91','#222','#777'];
    grid.innerHTML=cells.map((c,i)=>`<button data-cell="${i}" class="mine-cell ${c.revealed?'revealed':''} ${c.hit?'boom':''}" style="color:${colors[c.n]||'#222'}" aria-label="Row ${Math.floor(i/9)+1}, column ${i%9+1}: ${c.flag?'flagged':c.revealed?(c.mine?'mine':c.n+' neighboring mines'):'unopened'}">${c.flag?'⚑':c.revealed?(c.mine?'✹':c.n||''):''}</button>`).join('');
    $('#mine-count',w.content).textContent=String(10-flags).padStart(3,'0');
  }
  function act(i,flag){
    if(over)return;
    const c=cells[i];
    if(flag){if(!c.revealed){c.flag=!c.flag;flags+=c.flag?1:-1;}render();return;}
    if(c.flag)return;
    if(!started)seed(i);
    if(c.revealed&&c.n){
      const ns=neighbors(i);
      if(ns.filter(j=>cells[j].flag).length===c.n)ns.filter(j=>!cells[j].flag).forEach(reveal);
    }else reveal(i);
    if(!over&&cells.filter(c=>!c.mine&&c.revealed).length===71)finish(true);
    render();
  }
  grid.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-cell]');if(b)act(+b.dataset.cell,$('#flag-mode',w.content).checked);};
  grid.oncontextmenu=e=>{e.preventDefault();const b=e.target.closest('[data-cell]');if(b)act(+b.dataset.cell,true);};
  $('#mine-reset',w.content).onclick=reset;
  w.cleanup=()=>clearInterval(timer);
  reset();
};

/* Sound Machine: fully synthesized, editable 16-step sequencer. */
let savedPattern=storage.get('pattern',null);
renderers.music=w=>{
  const notes=[{name:'C5',f:523.25},{name:'B4',f:493.88},{name:'A4',f:440},{name:'G4',f:392},{name:'F4',f:349.23},{name:'E4',f:329.63},{name:'D4',f:293.66},{name:'C4',f:261.63}];
  const defaultPattern=()=>{const p=Array.from({length:8},()=>Array(16).fill(false));[7,5,3,5,6,4,2,4,5,3,0,3,4,2,1,3].forEach((r,c)=>p[r][c]=true);return p;};
  let pattern=Array.isArray(savedPattern)&&savedPattern.length===8&&savedPattern.every(r=>Array.isArray(r)&&r.length===16)?savedPattern.map(r=>r.map(Boolean)):defaultPattern();
  let playing=false,step=0,timer,tempo=112,wave='triangle';
  w.content.innerHTML=`<div class="synth-shell"><div class="synth-top"><div><div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:5px">Personal sound laboratory</div><h2>Sound Machine</h2><span class="small-print">Small notes. Happy accidents.</span></div><span class="synth-badge" id="synth-lcd">READY ♫</span></div>
    <div class="synth-controls"><button class="classic-btn primary" id="synth-play">▶ Play</button>

    <select id="synth-wave" class="classic-input" aria-label="Instrument"><option value="triangle">Soft keys</option><option value="square">8-bit chip</option><option value="sine">Little bells</option><option value="sawtooth">Space brass</option></select></div>
    <div class="synth-scroll"><div class="sequencer"></div></div>
    <div class="synth-keyboard">${[...notes].reverse().map((n,i)=>`<button class="piano-key" data-note="${7-i}" aria-label="Play ${n.name}">${n.name}<small>${'ASDFGHJK'[i]}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="synth-bottom"><span>Click the grid to compose. Stack notes for chords.</span><span><button id="synth-preset" style="font:inherit;border:0;background:none;text-decoration:underline">Demo</button> · <button id="synth-clear" style="font:inherit;border:0;background:none;text-decoration:underline">Clear</button></span></div></div>`;
  const seq=$('.sequencer',w.content);
  function draw(){
    seq.innerHTML=notes.map((n,r)=>`<span class="seq-label">${n.name}</span>`+pattern[r].map((on,c)=>`<button class="seq-cell ${c%4===0?'beat':''} ${on?'on':''}" data-row="${r}" data-col="${c}" aria-label="${n.name}, step ${c+1}" aria-pressed="${on}"></button>`).join('')).join('');
  }

  seq.onclick=e=>{

    const r=+b.dataset.row,c=+b.dataset.col;pattern[r][c]=!pattern[r][c];

  };
  $('#synth-tempo',w.content).oninput=e=>{tempo=+e.target.value;$('#tempo-label',w.content).textContent=tempo;};
  $('#synth-wave',w.content).onchange=e=>wave=e.target.value;
  $$('[data-note]',w.content).forEach(b=>b.onpointerdown=()=>playNote(+b.dataset.note));
  $('#synth-clear',w.content).onclick=()=>{pattern=Array.from({length:8},()=>Array(16).fill(false));draw();save();};
  $('#synth-preset',w.content).onclick=()=>{pattern=defaultPattern();draw();save();};
  const keyHandler=e=>{
    if(state.active!=='music'||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey||e.repeat||!$('#dialog-layer').classList.contains('hidden')||/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(e.target.tagName))return;
    const index='asdfghjk'.indexOf(e.key.toLowerCase());
    if(index>=0){e.preventDefault();playNote(7-index);}
    if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();$('#synth-play',w.content).click();}
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown',keyHandler);
  w.cleanup=()=>{stop();save();document.removeEventListener('keydown',keyHandler);};
  draw();
};

/* Terminal: intentionally local, safe command interpreter. */
renderers.terminal=w=>{
  w.content.innerHTML=`<div class="terminal-shell"><div class="terminal-output" role="log" aria-label="Terminal output"></div><form class="terminal-line"><span>guest@mac ~ %</span><input class="terminal-input" aria-label="Terminal command" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"></form></div>`;
  const output=$('.terminal-output',w.content),input=$('input',w.content);
  let history=[],h=0;
  const print=text=>{output.textContent+=text+'\n';output.scrollTop=output.scrollHeight;};
  print('  R E T R O S H E L L   /   version 1.0\n  ─────────────────────────────────────\n  Welcome home, guest. The internet can wait.\n  Type “help” for a few things you can do.\n');
  const aliases={stickies:'notes',sound:'music',synth:'music','kidpix':'paint',control:'settings',calc:'calculator',minesweeper:'mines'};
  const fortunes=[
    'The best things in life don’t require a software update.',
    'You have 128 MB of RAM and unlimited potential.',
    'Your next great idea is hiding in an untitled document.',
    'There is no cloud. There is only someone else’s Macintosh.',
    'Make something imperfect. Then make something else.',
    'It is now safe to step away from your computer.'
  ];
  function command(raw){
    const parts=raw.trim().split(/\s+/),cmd=parts.shift()?.toLowerCase(),arg=parts.join(' ');
    switch(cmd){
      case 'help':print(`Available commands:
  help                 You are here
  ls                   List applications
  open <app>           Launch an application
  cat notes            Read your sticky note
  echo <words>         Hear yourself think
  date                 The present, unfortunately
  whoami               A little perspective
  theme dusk|teal|space Change your scenery
  fortune              Advice, free of charge
  cowsay <words>        Consult the office cow
  clear                A clean slate
  about                About this Macintosh
  reboot               One more hello

Try: open music
Tip: ↑ and ↓ browse your command history.`);break;
      case 'ls':print('Applications/\n  notes       paint       music       mines\n  calculator  settings    finder      welcome\n\nDocuments/\n  notes.txt');break;
      case 'open':{
        const app=aliases[arg.toLowerCase()]||arg.toLowerCase();
        if(apps[app]){openApp(app);print('Opening '+apps[app].title+'…');}
        else print('Application not found. Type “ls” to see your options.');
        break;
      }
      case 'cat':
        if(['notes','notes.txt'].includes(arg))print(storage.get('notes',defaultNote));
        else print('File not found. Try “cat notes”.');
        break;
      case 'echo':print(arg);break;
      case 'date':print(new Date().toString());break;
      case 'whoami':print('guest\nA curious human on a very small planet.\nAdministrator of your own little universe.');break;
      case 'theme':
        if(['dusk','teal','space'].includes(arg)){setTheme(arg);print('Scenery updated. Take a deep breath.');}
        else print('Usage: theme dusk | teal | space');
        break;
      case 'fortune':print('“'+fortunes[Math.floor(Math.random()*fortunes.length)]+'”');break;
      case 'cowsay':{
        const msg=(arg||'Think different. Moo.').slice(0,55);
        print(' '+'_'.repeat(msg.length+2)+'\n< '+msg+' >\n '+'-'.repeat(msg.length+2)+'\n        \\   ^__^\n         \\  (oo)\\_______\n            (__)\\       )\\/\\\n                ||----w |\n                ||     ||');
        break;
      }
      case 'clear':output.textContent='';break;
      case 'about':print('Macintosh Nostalgia Edition.\nA self-contained universe built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\nNo network access. No real system commands. Just good vibes.');break;
      case 'reboot':reboot();break;
      case 'sudo':print('With great power comes great responsibility.\nYou already have everything you need here.');break;
      case 'hello':print('Hello again, old friend.');break;
      case '':break;
      default:print(`Command not found: ${cmd}\nTry “help”. Curiosity is always a valid command.`);
    }
  }
  $('form',w.content).onsubmit=e=>{
    e.preventDefault();const raw=input.value;input.value='';
    print('guest@mac ~ % '+raw);
    if(raw.trim()){history.push(raw);h=history.length;}
    command(raw);print('');
  };
  input.onkeydown=e=>{
    if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();h=Math.max(0,h-1);input.value=history[h]||'';}
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();h=Math.min(history.length,h+1);input.value=history[h]||'';}
    if(e.key==='l'&&(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)){e.preventDefault();output.textContent='';}
  };
  w.content.onclick=e=>{if(!window.getSelection()?.toString())input.focus();};
  setTimeout(()=>input.focus(),50);
};
renderers.settings=w=>{
  w.content.innerHTML=`<div class="settings"><h3>Your Macintosh, your way.</h3>
    <fieldset class="settings-section"><legend>Desktop picture</legend><div class="wallpaper-options">
    ${[['dusk','Mountain dusk'],['teal','Classic teal'],['space','Deep space']].map(([theme,name])=>`<button class="wallpaper-option ${state.theme===theme?'selected':''}" data-theme="${theme}"><span class="wallpaper-preview ${theme}"></span>${name}</button>`).join('')}
    </div></fieldset>
    <fieldset class="settings-section"><legend>Little details</legend>
    <label class="setting-row"><input id="setting-sound" type="checkbox" ${state.sound?'checked':''}> Play interface sounds</label>
    <div class="setting-row"><span>Desktop icons looking a little scattered?</span><button class="classic-btn" id="tidy-icons" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap">Tidy Up</button></div>
    <p class="small-print">Your wallpaper, notes, folders, and melodies are saved in this browser. Audio only plays when you ask it to.</p>
    </fieldset><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between"><span class="small-print">128 MB RAM · PowerPC spirit</span><button class="classic-btn" id="settings-about">About This Mac…</button></div></div>`;
  $$('[data-theme]',w.content).forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setTheme(b.dataset.theme));
  $('#setting-sound',w.content).onchange=e=>setSound(e.target.checked);
  $('#tidy-icons',w.content).onclick=()=>{renderDesktop();toast('A place for everything.');};
  $('#settings-about',w.content).onclick=about;
};
renderers.calculator=w=>{
  w.content.innerHTML=`<div class="calculator"><div class="calc-display" aria-live="polite">0</div><div class="calc-grid">
    ${['C','±','%','÷','7','8','9','×','4','5','6','−','1','2','3','+','0','.','⌫','='].map(k=>`<button class="classic-btn ${'÷×−+'.includes(k)?'operator':''} ${k==='='?'equals':''}" data-key="${k}">${k}</button>`).join('')}
    </div><div class="calc-mark">MACINTOSH • PRECISION</div></div>`;
  let value='0',stored=null,operator=null,fresh=true;
  const show=()=>$('.calc-display',w.content).textContent=value;
  const calculate=(a,b,op)=>op==='+'?a+b:op==='−'?a-b:op==='×'?a*b:b===0?NaN:a/b;
  const format=n=>Number.isFinite(n)?String(+n.toPrecision(11)):'Error';
  function key(k){
    if(/^\d$/.test(k)){
      if(fresh||value==='0'||value==='Error'){value=k;fresh=false;}
      else if(value.length<13)value+=k;
    }else if(k==='.'){
      if(fresh||value==='Error'){value='0.';fresh=false;}
      else if(!value.includes('.'))value+='.';
    }else if(k==='C'){value='0';stored=null;operator=null;fresh=true;}
    else if(k==='⌫'){if(!fresh)value=value.length>1?value.slice(0,-1):'0';}
    else if(k==='±'){if(value!=='0'&&value!=='Error')value=value.startsWith('-')?value.slice(1):'-'+value;}
    else if(k==='%'){value=format(Number(value)/100);}
    else if(k==='='){
      if(operator&&stored!==null){value=format(calculate(stored,Number(value),operator));operator=null;stored=null;fresh=true;}
    }else{
      if(operator&&!fresh)value=format(calculate(stored,Number(value),operator));
      stored=Number(value);operator=k;fresh=true;
    }
    show();
  }
  $$('[data-key]',w.content).forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>key(b.dataset.key));
  const listener=e=>{
    if(state.active!=='calculator'||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey||!$('#dialog-layer').classList.contains('hidden'))return;
    const map={'*':'×','/':'÷','-':'−','Enter':'=','Backspace':'⌫','Escape':'C'};
    const k=map[e.key]||e.key;
    if(/^[0-9.+%=]$/.test(k)||['×','÷','−','⌫','C'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();key(k);}
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown',listener);
  w.cleanup=()=>document.removeEventListener('keydown',listener);
};

/* ─── Menus ─── */
function closeMenu() {
  menuElement?.remove();menuElement=null;activeMenu=null;
  $$('.menu-button').forEach(b=>{b.classList.remove('open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');});
}
function showMenu(x,y,items,button) {
  closeMenu();
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='dropdown';el.setAttribute('role','menu');
  items.forEach(item=>{
    if(item.separator){el.append(document.createElement('hr'));return;}
    const b=document.createElement('button');b.setAttribute('role','menuitem');
    b.innerHTML=`<span>${escapeHTML(item.label)}</span>${item.shortcut?`<span class="shortcut">${escapeHTML(item.shortcut)}</span>`:''}`;
    b.disabled=!!item.disabled;
    b.onclick=()=>{closeMenu();item.action?.();};
    el.append(b);
  });
  document.body.append(el);el.style.left=Math.min(x,innerWidth-el.offsetWidth-3)+'px';el.style.top=Math.min(y,innerHeight-el.offsetHeight-3)+'px';
  menuElement=el;
  if(button){button.classList.add('open');button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');activeMenu=button.dataset.menu;}
  el.onkeydown=e=>{
    const buttons=$$('button:not(:disabled)',el),i=buttons.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();buttons[(i+1)%buttons.length]?.focus();}
    if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();buttons[(i-1+buttons.length)%buttons.length]?.focus();}
    if(e.key==='Escape'){closeMenu();button?.focus();}
  };
}
function editCommand(cmd) {
  const w=state.windows.get(state.active);
  const field=w&&$('textarea,.terminal-input',w.content);
  if(cmd==='selectAll'){
    if(field){field.focus();field.select();}
    else toast('Open a note or the Terminal to select text.');
    return;
  }
  if(cmd==='copy'){
    const selection=field?field.value.slice(field.selectionStart,field.selectionEnd):window.getSelection()?.toString();
    if(selection&&navigator.clipboard)navigator.clipboard.writeText(selection).then(()=>toast('Copied to the clipboard.')).catch(()=>toast('Use ⌘C or Ctrl+C to copy selected text.'));
    else toast('Select some text, then use ⌘C or Ctrl+C.');
  }
  if(cmd==='paste'){
    if(!field){toast('Open Stickies or the Terminal to paste.');return;}
    field.focus();
    if(navigator.clipboard?.readText)navigator.clipboard.readText().then(text=>{
      field.setRangeText(text,field.selectionStart,field.selectionEnd,'end');field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }).catch(()=>toast('Press ⌘V or Ctrl+V to paste into the text field.'));
    else toast('Press ⌘V or Ctrl+V to paste.');
  }
}
function arrangeWindows(){
  let i=0;state.windows.forEach(w=>{if(w.minimized)return;w.zoomed=false;w.el.style.left=(45+i*28)+'px';w.el.style.top=(53+i*28)+'px';clampWindow(w);i++;});

const menuItems={
  apple:()=>[
    {label:'About This Macintosh…',action:about},{separator:true},
    {label:'♧  Read Me',action:()=>openApp('welcome')},
    {label:'Control Panels…',action:()=>openApp('settings')},
    {label:'Stickies',action:()=>openApp('notes')},
    {label:'Calculator',action:()=>openApp('calculator')},{separator:true},
    {label:'Sound Machine',action:()=>openApp('music')},
    {label:'Minesweeper',action:()=>openApp('mines')},
    {label:'Terminal',action:()=>openApp('terminal')}
  ],

    {separator:true},
    {label:'Hide Window',shortcut:'⌘H',disabled:!state.active,action:()=>minimizeWindow(state.active)},

    {separator:true},{label:'Tidy Up Desktop',action:()=>{renderDesktop();toast('Neat as a pin.');}},

  ]
};
$$('[data-menu]').forEach(button=>{

$('#sound-toggle').style.opacity=state.sound?'1':'.45';

setTimeout(()=>{$('#boot').style.opacity='0';setTimeout(()=>$('#boot').style.display='none',350);},1250);
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Retro macOS Desktop</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --dock-h:80px;--menu-h:28px;
  --blue:#0071e3;--blue-hover:#0077ed;
  --bg-top:#5856d6;--bg-mid:#4a48a8;--bg-bot:#2d2b7a;
  --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  --glass-border:rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
@font-face{font-family:'SFPro';src:local('Helvetica Neue'),local('Arial');}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:'SFPro','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;user-select:none}

/* DESKTOP BACKGROUND */
#desktop{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5856d6 0%,#4a48a8 30%,#3b38a0 50%,#2d2b7a 70%,#1e1c6e 100%);
  background-size:100% 400%;
  animation:bgShift 20s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes bgShift{0%,100%{background-position:0% 0%}50%{background-position:0% 100%}}
#desktop::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;
}
#desktop::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 0%,transparent 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* DESKTOP ICONS */
#desktop-icons{
  position:absolute;top:60px;left:0;right:0;bottom:var(--dock-h);
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
  padding:20px 20px 100px 20px;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.desktop-icon{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:72px;
  pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;
  padding:6px 4px;border-radius:8px;
  transition:all .15s ease;
}
.desktop-icon:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.desktop-icon:active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.desktop-icon .icon-wrap{
  width:48px;height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:36px;margin-bottom:4px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3));
}
.desktop-icon .label{
  color:#fff;font-size:11px;text-align:center;
  text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  word-wrap:break-word;max-width:64px;line-height:1.3;
}

/* MENU BAR */
#menubar{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:var(--menu-h);
  background:rgba(30,30,30,.85);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;
  z-index:1000;
}
#menubar .apple-menu{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
  color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
}
#menubar .apple-menu:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
#menubar .menus{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-left:8px}
#menubar .menus span{
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);
}
#menubar .menus span:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff}
#menubar .spacer{flex:1}
#menubar .menubar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:#fff}
#menubar .menubar-right i{margin-right:3px;font-size:11px}
#menubar .menubar-right .time{font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* DOCK */
#dock{
  position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;
  padding:6px 12px;
  background:rgba(40,40,40,.65);
  backdrop-filter:blur(25px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(25px);
  border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  box-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  z-index:1000;
}
.dock-icon{
  width:52px;height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:32px;color:#fff;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4));
  transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.1,0,.2,1);
  cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;
  position:relative;
}
.dock-icon:hover{transform:scale(1.4) translateY(-16px);margin:0 6px}
.dock-icon .dot{
  position:absolute;bottom:-2px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;
}
.dock-icon.active .dot{opacity:1}
.dock-icon:hover .dot{opacity:1}
.dock-separator{width:1px;height:44px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);margin:0 4px;align-self:center}
.dock-icon.trash-icon{font-size:30px}

/* WINDOWS */
.window{
  position:absolute;min-width:400px;min-height:250px;
  background:#e8e8e8;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  z-index:100;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  animation:windowOpen .25s cubic-bezier(.1,0,.2,1);
  resize:both;
}
@keyframes windowOpen{
  from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92) translateY(10px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}
}
.window.focused{z-index:200}
.window .titlebar{
  height:32px;background:#5856d6;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding:0 12px;cursor:move;flex-shrink:0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);
}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-right:12px}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light .btn{
  width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .15s;
}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light .btn.close{background:#ff5f56}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light .btn.minimize{background:#ffbd2e}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light .btn.maximize{background:#27c93f}
.window .titlebar .traffic-light .btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.2);transform:scale(1.1)}
.window .titlebar .title{
  flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:500;
  text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.window .titlebar .titlebar-btns{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:auto}
.window .titlebar .titlebar-btns button{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:none;color:#fff;
  width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.window .titlebar .titlebar-btns button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.window .content{flex:1;overflow:auto;background:#e8e8e8}
.window .content:focus{outline:none}

/* FOLDER ICON */
.folder-icon .icon-wrap{font-size:40px}
.folder-icon .icon-wrap i{color:#f5a623}

/* FINDER */
.finder-sidebar{
  width:180px;background:#f0f0f0;border-right:1px solid #ccc;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex-shrink:0;
}
.finder-sidebar .sidebar-section{padding:8px 0}
.finder-sidebar .sidebar-section h4{
  padding:4px 16px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#666;font-weight:600;
}
.finder-sidebar .sidebar-item{
  padding:4px 16px;font-size:12px;color:#333;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
}
.finder-sidebar .sidebar-item:hover{background:#d9edff;color:#0071e3}
.finder-sidebar .sidebar-item i{width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}
.finder-content{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.finder-toolbar{
  height:36px;background:#e8e8e8;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;
  display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;
}
.finder-toolbar button{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#333;
}
.finder-toolbar button:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.finder-toolbar .view-options{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:4px}
.finder-toolbar .view-options button{
  background:none;border:none;padding:4px 6px;
}
.finder-file-list{flex:1;padding:8px;overflow:auto}
.finder-file{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;
  cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#333;
}
.finder-file:hover{background:#d9edff}
.finder-file i{font-size:16px;width:20px;text-align:center}
.finder-file .file-icon{flex-shrink:0}
.finder-file .file-name{flex:1}
.finder-file .file-size{color:#888;font-size:11px}
.finder-path{
  height:28px;background:#e0e0e0;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;
  display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;gap:4px;
  font-size:11px;color:#666;flex-shrink:0;
}
.finder-path span{cursor:pointer}
.finder-path span:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* NOTES */
.notes-textarea{
  width:100%;height:100%;border:none;resize:none;padding:16px;
  font-family:'SFPro','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif;font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.6;color:#222;background:#fefefe;
  outline:none;
}
.notes-textarea::placeholder{color:#aaa}

/* CALCULATOR */
.calc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:#333;padding:1px;width:100%;height:100%}
.calc-display{
  grid-column:1/-1;background:#1a1a1a;color:#fff;text-align:right;
  padding:16px 20px;font-size:32px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  border:none;outline:none;
}
.calc-btn{
  background:#555;color:#fff;border:none;font-size:18px;
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background .1s;
}
.calc-btn:hover{background:#666}
.calc-btn:active{background:#777;transform:scale(.95)}
.calc-btn.op{background:#f5a623;color:#fff}
.calc-btn.op:hover{background:#f7b731}
.calc-btn.func{background:#6e6e7a;color:#fff}
.calc-btn.func:hover{background:#7e7e8a}
.calc-btn.zero{grid-column:span 2}

/* TERMINAL */
.terminal{background:#1e1e1e;color:#00cc00;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:13px;padding:8px;overflow:auto;height:100%}
.terminal .prompt{color:#00cc00}
.terminal input{
  background:none;border:none;color:#00cc00;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
  font-size:13px;width:80px;outline:none;
}
.terminal .output{color:#ccc;margin:2px 0}
.terminal .error{color:#ff5555}
.terminal .success{color:#55ff55}
.terminal .cmd-line{display:flex;align-items:center;margin:2px 0}
.terminal .cmd-line .user{color:#55ffff}

/* SAFARI */
.safari-toolbar{
  height:36px;background:#3b3b3b;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding:0 12px;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2a2a;
}
.safari-toolbar .nav-btn{
  width:24px;height:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:none;
  border-radius:4px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;
}
.safari-toolbar .nav-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.safari-toolbar .url-bar{
  flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:none;border-radius:6px;
  padding:4px 12px;color:#fff;font-size:12px;outline:none;
}
.safari-toolbar .url-bar::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.safari-toolbar .url-bar:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.safari-toolbar .bookmarks{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:8px}
.safari-toolbar .bookmarks button{
  background:none;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);cursor:pointer;
  font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;
}
.safari-toolbar .bookmarks button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff}
.safari-content{flex:1;background:#fff;overflow:auto}
.safari-content .page{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  height:100%;padding:40px;text-align:center;color:#333;
}
.safari-content .page h1{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
.safari-content .page p{color:#666;font-size:14px;max-width:500px}
.safari-content .page .url-display{
  margin-top:20px;padding:8px 16px;background:#f5f5f5;border-radius:6px;
  font-size:13px;color:#0071e3;
}
.safari-content .page img{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:16px}

/* ABOUT */
.about-content{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:40px;height:100%;background:#f0f0f0;text-align:center;
}
.about-content .logo{font-size:72px;margin-bottom:16px}
.about-content h1{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:4px}
.about-content .version{font-size:14px;color:#666;margin-bottom:20px}
.about-content .info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px 30px;text-align:left;font-size:13px;color:#333;margin-top:16px}
.about-content .info div{padding:4px 0}
.about-content .info .label{color:#666}

/* SYSTEM PREFS */
.prefs-sidebar{
  width:200px;background:#f0f0f0;border-right:1px solid #ccc;
  overflow-y:auto;flex-shrink:0;
}
.prefs-sidebar .pref-item{
  padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;color:#333;
  border-left:3px solid transparent;
}
.prefs-sidebar .pref-item:hover{background:#d9edff}
.prefs-sidebar .pref-item.active{border-left-color:#0071e3;background:#d9edff;color:#0071e3;font-weight:600}
.prefs-sidebar .pref-item i{margin-right:6px;width:16px;text-align:center}
.prefs-content{flex:1;padding:24px;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff}
.prefs-content h2{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#333}
.prefs-content p{font-size:13px;color:#666;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:16px}
.prefs-content .pref-group{
  background:#f9f9f9;border-radius:8px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px;
  border:1px solid #e0e0e0;
}
.prefs-content .pref-group label{display:block;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#333}
.prefs-content .pref-group input[type="range"]{width:100%}
.prefs-content .pref-group .slider-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.prefs-content .pref-group .slider-val{font-size:13px;color:#0071e3;min-width:40px}
.prefs-content .pref-group .toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.prefs-content .pref-group .switch{
  width:40px;height:22px;background:#ccc;border-radius:11px;cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;transition:background .2s;
}
.prefs-content .pref-group .switch.on{background:#34c759}
.prefs-content .pref-group .switch::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;
  background:#fff;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .2s;
  box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.prefs-content .pref-group .switch.on::after{transform:translateX(18px)}

/* CALENDAR */
.calendar-widget{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;background:#fff}
.calendar-header{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;
}
.calendar-header h3{font-size:16px}
.calendar-header button{
  background:none;border:none;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;color:#666;
  padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;
}
.calendar-header button:hover{background:#eee}
.calendar-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px;padding:12px 20px}
.calendar-day-name{text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#999;padding:4px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase}
.calendar-day{
  text-align:center;padding:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50%;
  color:#333;transition:background .15s;
}
.calendar-day:hover{background:#d9edff}
.calendar-day.today{background:#0071e3;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.calendar-day.other{color:#ccc}
.calendar-day.selected{background:#0071e3;color:#fff}

/* APP STORE */
.app-store-content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px;background:#f5f5f7}
.app-store-content h2{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:20px;color:#333}
.app-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:16px}
.app-card{
  background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;
  border:1px solid #e0e0e0;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
}
.app-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.app-card .app-icon{
  width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:12px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;
}
.app-card .app-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-bottom:2px}
.app-card .app-desc{font-size:11px;color:#888}
.app-card .app-get{
  margin-top:8px;padding:4px 16px;background:#0071e3;color:#fff;border:none;
  border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;
}
.app-card .app-get:hover{background:#0077ed}

/* MAIL */
.mail-container{display:flex;height:100%;background:#fff}
.mail-sidebar{width:200px;background:#f5f5f7;border-right:1px solid #e0e0e0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.mail-sidebar .mail-btn{
  margin:8px 12px;padding:8px 12px;background:#0071e3;color:#fff;
  border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
}
.mail-sidebar .mail-btn:hover{background:#0077ed}
.mail-sidebar .mail-folder{padding:6px 16px;font-size:12px;color:#333;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.mail-sidebar .mail-folder:hover{background:#e8e8e8}
.mail-sidebar .mail-folder i{width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#888}
.mail-sidebar .mail-folder .count{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:#999;background:#e0e0e0;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:8px}
.mail-list{flex:1;border-right:1px solid #e0e0e0;overflow-y:auto}
.mail-list-header{display:flex;padding:8px 16px;background:#f9f9f9;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;font-size:11px;color:#888;font-weight:600}
.mail-list-header span{padding:0 8px}
.mail-item{display:flex;padding:8px 16px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.mail-item:hover{background:#f5f9ff}
.mail-item.unread{font-weight:600}
.mail-item .mail-from{flex:1;padding:0 8px;color:#333}
.mail-item .mail-subject{flex:1;padding:0 8px;color:#333}
.mail-item .mail-date{padding:0 8px;color:#999;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
.mail-item .mail-read{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #0071e3;flex-shrink:0}
.mail-item .mail-unread{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ccc;flex-shrink:0}
.mail-view{flex:1;padding:20px;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff}
.mail-view .mail-header-info{margin-bottom:16px}
.mail-view .mail-from-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:#333}
.mail-view .mail-subject-text{font-size:16px;color:#555;margin:4px 0}
.mail-view .mail-date-text{font-size:12px;color:#999}
.mail-view .mail-body{padding:20px 0;color:#333;line-height:1.8;font-size:14px}
.mail-empty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#999}
.mail-empty i{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:16px}
.mail-empty p{font-size:14px}

/* PHOTOS */
.photos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px;padding:20px;background:#f5f5f7}
.photo-card{
  aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
}
.photo-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.photo-card .photo-overlay{
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:8px;
  background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.6));color:#fff;font-size:11px;
}

/* CONTEXT MENU */
.context-menu{
  position:fixed;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2),0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  padding:4px 0;min-width:180px;z-index:5000;
  animation:menuIn .15s ease;
}
@keyframes menuIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95) translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}}
.context-menu .menu-item{
  padding:6px 16px;font-size:12px;color:#333;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.context-menu .menu-item:hover{background:#0071e3;color:#fff}
.context-menu .menu-item.disabled{color:#999;pointer-events:none}
.context-menu .separator{height:1px;background:#e0e0e0;margin:4px 8px}
.context-menu .menu-item i{width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}

/* SPOTLIGHT */
#spotlight-overlay{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;
  padding-top:15vh;z-index:3000;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
}
#spotlight-overlay.active{display:flex}
#spotlight-box{
  width:520px;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3);overflow:hidden;
  animation:spotlightIn .2s ease;
}
@keyframes spotlightIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95) translateY(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}}
#spotlight-box input{
  width:100%;padding:14px 20px;font-size:16px;border:none;outline:none;

<script>
// === CLOCK ===
function updateClock(){
  const now=new Date();
  const h=now.getHours(),m=String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  const ampm=h>=12?'PM':'AM';
  const h12=h%12||12;
  document.getElementById('clock').textContent=`${h12}:${m} ${ampm}`;
}
setInterval(updateClock,1000);updateClock();

// === WALLPAPER OPTIONS ===
const wallpapers=[
