  {name:'Pacific',gradient:'linear-gradient(180deg,#1a3a5c 0%,#2d6b9e 40%,#f5a623 100%)'},
  {name:'Sunset',gradient:'linear-gradient(180deg,#ff6b35 0%,#f7c948 50%,#e84393 100%)'},
  {name:'Midnight',gradient:'linear-gradient(180deg,#0c0c1d 0%,#1a1a3e 50%,#2d1b69 100%)'},
];
const wpContainer=document.getElementById('wallpaper-options');
wallpapers.forEach((wp,i)=>{
  const thumb=document.createElement('div');
  thumb.className='wp-thumb'+(i===0?' active':'');
  thumb.style.background=wp.gradient;
  thumb.title=wp.name;
  thumb.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--bg-top',wp.gradient.split(' ')[1]||'#5856d6');
    document.getElementById('desktop').style.background=wp.gradient;
    document.querySelectorAll('.wp-thumb').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
    thumb.classList.add('active');
  });
  wpContainer.appendChild(thumb);
});

// === DESKTOP ICONS ===
const desktopIconsData=[
  {name:'Applications',type:'folder',icon:'fa-th',color:'#f5a623'},
  {name:'Documents',type:'folder',icon:'fa-folder',color:'#f5a623'},
  {name:'Downloads',type:'folder',icon:'fa-download',color:'#f5a623'},
  {name:'Macintosh HD',type:'drive',icon:'fa-hdd',color:'#aaa'},
  {name:'Preferences',type:'app',icon:'fa-cog',color:'#0071e3'},
  {name:'Trash',type:'trash',icon:'fa-trash',color:'#888'},
];
const iconsContainer=document.getElementById('desktop-icons');
let dragItem=null;

desktopIconsData.forEach((item,idx)=>{
  const icon=document.createElement('div');
  icon.className='desktop-icon '+(item.type==='folder'?'folder-icon':'');
  icon.innerHTML=`<div class="icon-wrap"><i class="fas ${item.icon}" style="color:${item.color}"></i></div><div class="label">${item.name}</div>`;
  
  icon.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
    if(e.button===2)return;
    if(e.button===1){openApp(item.name);return}
    dragItem={type:item.type,name:item.name,icon:item.icon,color:item.color,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  icon.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    if(!dragItem)openApp(item.name);
  });
  
  icon.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    showContextMenu(e.clientX,e.clientY,item.name);
  });
  
  iconsContainer.appendChild(icon);
});

// === DOCK ===
const dockItems=[
  {name:'Finder',icon:'fa-face-smile',color:'#0071e3',app:'Finder'},
  {name:'Safari',icon:'fa-globe',color:'#0071e3',app:'Safari'},
  {name:'Mail',icon:'fa-envelope',color:'#0071e3',app:'Mail'},
  {separator:true},
  {name:'Notes',icon:'fa-sticky-note',color:'#ff9500',app:'Notes'},
  {name:'Photos',icon:'fa-image',color:'#ff2d55',app:'Photos'},
  {name:'Calendar',icon:'fa-calendar',color:'#34c759',app:'Calendar'},
  {name:'Terminal',icon:'fa-terminal',color:'#0071e3',app:'Terminal'},
  {name:'App Store',icon:'fa-store',color:'#34c759',app:'App Store'},

];
const dockContainer=document.getElementById('dock');
dockItems.forEach(item=>{

    const sep=document.createElement('div');
    sep.className='dock-separator';
    dockContainer.appendChild(sep);
    return;
  }
  const icon=document.createElement('div');
  icon.className='dock-icon'+(item.isTrash?' trash-icon':'');
  icon.innerHTML=`<i class="fas ${item.icon}" style="color:${item.color}"></i><div class="dot"></div>`;
  icon.title=item.name;
  icon.addEventListener('click',()=>{

    else openApp(item.app);

// === WINDOW MANAGER ===
const windowsContainer=document.getElementById('windows-container');
let windowCount=0;
let focusedWindow=null;
let zIndex=100;

function openApp(name){
  windowCount++;
  const id='win-'+windowCount;
  let title,width,height,content;
  
  switch(name){
    case 'Finder':
      title='Finder';width=800;height=500;
      content=finderContent();
      break;
    case 'Safari':
      title='Safari';width=900;height=600;
      content=safariContent();
      break;
    case 'Notes':
      title='Notes';width=600;height=450;
      content=`<textarea class="notes-textarea" placeholder="Start typing your notes here...">Welcome to Retro macOS! ✨

This is a nostalgic recreation of the classic macOS desktop.

Try these features:
• Click desktop icons or dock items
• Right-click for context menus
• Press Cmd+Space for Spotlight
• Drag windows by their title bar
• Click the traffic light buttons
• Try the Calculator, Terminal, and more!</textarea>`;
      break;
    case 'Calculator':
      title='Calculator';width=230;height=330;
      content=calculatorContent();
      break;
    case 'Terminal':
      title='Terminal';width=650;height=400;
      content=terminalContent();
      break;
    case 'Photos':
      title='Photos';width=750;height=500;
      content=photosContent();
      break;
    case 'Calendar':
      title='Calendar';width=380;height=420;
      content=calendarContent();
      break;
    case 'Mail':
      title='Mail';width=850;height=550;
      content=mailContent();
      break;
    case 'App Store':
      title='App Store';width=750;height=500;
      content=appStoreContent();
      break;
    case 'System Preferences':
      title='System Preferences';width=700;height=480;
      content=prefsContent();
      break;
    case 'About This Mac':
      title='About This Mac';width=420;height=300;
      content=aboutContent();
      break;
    case 'Trash':
      title='Trash';width=600;height=400;
      content=trashContent();
      break;
    default:
      title=name;width=600;height=400;
      content=`<div style="padding:40px;text-align:center;color:#666"><i class="fas fa-${Math.random()>0.5?'star':'heart'}" style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#0071e3"></i><h2>${name}</h2><p style="margin-top:8px;font-size:14px">This is ${name} on Retro macOS</p></div>`;
  }
  
  const win=document.createElement('div');
  win.className='window focused';id=id;
  win.style.left=Math.min(200,(windowCount-1)*40%+50)+'px';
  win.style.top=Math.min(100,(windowCount-1)*30%+30)+'px';
  win.style.width=width+'px';
  win.style.height=height+'px';
  win.style.zIndex=++zIndex;
  
  win.innerHTML=`
    <div class="titlebar">
      <div class="traffic-light">
        <button class="btn close" title="Close"></button>
        <button class="btn minimize" title="Minimize"></button>
        <button class="btn maximize" title="Zoom"></button>
      </div>
      <div class="title">${title}</div>
      <div class="titlebar-btns">
        <button title="Hide"><i class="fas fa-minus" style="font-size:8px"></i></button>
        <button title="Resize"><i class="fas fa-up-right-and-down-left-from-center" style="font-size:8px"></i></button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="content">${content}</div>
  `;
  
  windowsContainer.appendChild(win);
  makeDraggable(win);
  setupWindowControls(win,title,name);
  
  // Make content focusable for terminal etc
  const contentEl=win.querySelector('.content');
  if(contentEl&&!contentEl.querySelector('input,textarea')){
    contentEl.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
  }
  
  focusWindow(win);
  return win;
}

function focusWindow(win){
  if(focusedWindow)focusedWindow.classList.remove('focused');
  focusedWindow=win;
  win.classList.add('focused');
  win.style.zIndex=++zIndex;
  // Focus terminal input if present
  const input=win.querySelector('.content input,.content textarea');
  if(input)input.focus();
  // Focus content for keyboard nav
  const content=win.querySelector('.content');
  if(content&&!content.querySelector('input,textarea'))content.focus();
}

function setupWindowControls(win,title,name){
  const closeBtn=win.querySelector('.traffic-light .close');
  const minBtn=win.querySelector('.traffic-light .minimize');
  const maxBtn=win.querySelector('.traffic-light .maximize');
  const hideBtn=win.querySelector('.titlebar-btns button:first-child');
  const resizeBtn=win.querySelector('.titlebar-btns button:last-child');
  
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    win.style.animation='windowClose .2s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(()=>win.remove(),200);
  });
  
  minBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    win.style.display='none';
    const dockIcon=[...dockContainer.children].find(d=>d.title===title);
    if(dockIcon)dockIcon.classList.add('active');
    setTimeout(()=>{dockIcon&&dockIcon.classList.remove('active')},1000);
  });
  
  maxBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(win.style.maxWidth==='100%'){
      win.style.left=Math.min(200,windowCount*40+50)+'px';
      win.style.top=Math.min(100,windowCount*30+30)+'px';
      win.style.width=win.dataset.origWidth;
      win.style.height=win.dataset.origHeight;
      win.style.maxWidth='';
      win.style.maxHeight='';
    }else{
      win.dataset.origWidth=win.style.width;
      win.dataset.origHeight=win.style.height;
      win.style.maxWidth='100%';win.style.maxHeight='calc(100% - 30px)';
      win.style.width='100%';win.style.height='calc(100% - 30px)';
      win.style.left='0';win.style.top='0';
    }
  });
  
  hideBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    win.style.display='none';
    const dockIcon=[...dockContainer.children].find(d=>d.title===title);
    if(dockIcon)dockIcon.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  resizeBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    win.style.width=(parseInt(win.style.width)*0.8)+'px';
    win.style.height=(parseInt(win.style.height)*0.8)+'px';
  });
  
  // Double click title to maximize
  const titlebar=win.querySelector('.titlebar');
  let titleDbl=0;
  titlebar.addEventListener('dblclick',e=>{
    if(e.target.closest('.traffic-light')||e.target.closest('.titlebar-btns'))return;
    maxBtn.click();
  });
}

function makeDraggable(win){
  const titlebar=win.querySelector('.titlebar');
  let isDragging=false,startX,startY,origX,origY;
  
  titlebar.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{
    if(e.target.closest('.traffic-light')||e.target.closest('.titlebar-btns'))return;
    focusWindow(win);
    isDragging=true;
    startX=e.clientX;startY=e.clientY;
    origX=win.offsetLeft;origY=win.offsetTop;
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    if(!isDragging)return;
    win.style.left=(origX+e.clientX-startX)+'px';
    win.style.top=(origY+e.clientY-startY)+'px';
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{isDragging=false});
}

// === CALCULATOR ===
let calcVal='0',calcOp=null,calcPrev='';
function calcContent(){
  return `
    <div class="calc">
      <input class="calc-display" id="calc-display" value="0" readonly>
      <button class="calc-btn func" data-action="clear">AC</button>
      <button class="calc-btn func" data-action="negate">±</button>
      <button class="calc-btn func" data-action="percent">%</button>
      <button class="calc-btn op" data-action="op" data-value="/">÷</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="7">7</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="8">8</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="9">9</button>
      <button class="calc-btn op" data-action="op" data-value="×">×</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="4">4</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="5">5</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="6">6</button>
      <button class="calc-btn op" data-action="op" data-value="−">−</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="1">1</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="2">2</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="num" data-value="3">3</button>
      <button class="calc-btn op" data-action="op" data-value="+">+</button>
      <button class="calc-btn zero" data-action="num" data-value="0">0</button>
      <button class="calc-btn" data-action="decimal">.</button>
      <button class="calc-btn op" data-action="equals">=</button>
    </div>
  `;
}
function initCalc(){
  const display=document.getElementById('calc-display');
  document.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const action=btn.dataset.action;
      const val=btn.dataset.value;
      if(action==='num'){
        if(calcVal==='0'||calcVal==='Error')calcVal=val;
        else calcVal+=val;
      }else if(action==='op'){
        calcPrev=calcVal;calcOp=val;calcVal='0';
      }else if(action==='equals'){
        const prev=parseFloat(calcPrev);const curr=parseFloat(calcVal);
        if(calcOp==='+')calcVal=prev+curr;
        else if(calcOp==='−')calcVal=prev-curr;
        else if(calcOp==='×')calcVal=prev*curr;
        else if(calcOp==='÷')calcVal=curr!=0?prev/curr:'Error';
        else calcVal=curr;
        calcVal=String(parseFloat(calcVal.toFixed(10)));
        calcOp=null;calcPrev='';
      }else if(action==='clear'){
        calcVal='0';calcOp=null;calcPrev='';
      }else if(action==='negate'){
        calcVal=String(-parseFloat(calcVal));
      }else if(action==='percent'){
        calcVal=String(parseFloat(calcVal)/100);
      }else if(action==='decimal'){
        if(!calcVal.includes('.'))calcVal+='.';
      }
      if(display)display.value=calcVal;
    });
  });
}

function terminalContent(){

function initTerminal(){
  const term=document.getElementById('terminal');
  const input=document.getElementById('term-input');
  if(!input)return;
  input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    if(e.key==='Enter'){
      const cmd=input.value.trim();
      input.value='';
      const cmdLine=document.createElement('div');
      cmdLine.className='cmd-line';
      cmdLine.innerHTML=`<span class="user">arin@retromac ~</span><span class="prompt"> % </span><span>${cmd}</span>`;
      term.appendChild(cmdLine);
      
      if(cmd==='help'){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent='Available: help, ls, pwd, clear, echo, date, whoami, neofetch, cal, mkdir, cat, fortune';
        term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='ls'||cmd==='dir'){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';
        out.innerHTML=`Applications/  Documents/  Downloads/  Desktop/  Macintosh HD/  Library/  System/  Users/  var/`;
        term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='pwd'){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent='/Users/arin';term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='clear'){
        term.innerHTML='';
        const init=document.createElement('div');init.className='output';init.textContent='Terminal cleared.';term.appendChild(init);
        const cl=document.createElement('div');cl.className='cmd-line';
        cl.innerHTML=`<span class="user">arin@retromac ~</span><span class="prompt"> % </span><input type="text" id="term-input" autofocus>`;
        term.appendChild(cl);
        initTerminal();return;
      }else if(cmd==='date'){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent=new Date().toString();term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='whoami'){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent='arin';term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='neofetch'){
        term.innerHTML='<div class="output" style="color:#55ff55;font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4"><pre>            .---.      arin@retromac\n           /     \\     --------------\n          | o o |     OS: Retro macOS 10.15\n          |  _  |     Host: VirtualBox\n          \\ \`-\`/     Kernel: Darwin 19.0.0\n           \'---\'     Terminal: bash 3.2\n                        Resolution: 1920x1080\n                        Theme: Dark Mode\n                        Package: Homebrew 3.0\n                        Shell: zsh 5.8\n</pre></div>';
      }else if(cmd==='cal'){
        const now=new Date();const days=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
        const daysInMonth=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();
        const startDay=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),1).getDay();
        let html='<div class="output" style="font-family:monospace">';
        html+='     '+now.toLocaleString('default',{month:'long'})+' '+now.getFullYear()+'\n';
        html+=days.map(d=>d.padStart(3)).join(' ')+'\n';
        let line=''.padStart(startDay*4)+' ';
        for(let d=1;d<=daysInMonth;d++){
          line+=String(d).padStart(3);
          if((startDay+d)%7===0){html+=line+'\n';line=''}
        }
        html+=line+'\n</div>';
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.innerHTML=html;term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd.startsWith('echo ')){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent=cmd.substring(5);term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd.startsWith('mkdir ')){
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='success';out.textContent=`Directory '${cmd.substring(6)}' created.`;term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd==='fortune'){
        const fortunes=['The future is bright! 🌟','Keep coding! 💻','You are awesome! ✨','Today is a good day! ☀️','Stay curious! 🔍','Great work today! 🎉','Believe in yourself! 💪','The best is yet to come! 🚀'];
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='output';out.textContent=fortunes[Math.floor(Math.random()*fortunes.length)];term.appendChild(out);
      }else if(cmd===''){
        // do nothing
      }else{
        const out=document.createElement('div');out.className='error';out.textContent=`-bash: ${cmd}: command not found`;term.appendChild(out);
      }
      
      const newLine=document.createElement('div');newLine.className='cmd-line';
      newLine.innerHTML=`<span class="user">arin@retromac ~</span><span class="prompt"> % </span><input type="text" id="term-input" autofocus>`;
      term.appendChild(newLine);
      initTerminal();
      term.scrollTop=term.scrollHeight;
    }else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(termIdx<termHistory.length-1){termIdx++;input.value=termHistory[termIdx]}
    }else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(termIdx>0){termIdx--;input.value=termHistory[termIdx]||''}
      else{input.value=''}
    }
  });
  input.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
    if(e.key==='Enter'&&input.value.trim()){
      termHistory.push(input.value.trim());
      termIdx=termHistory.length;
    }
  });
  input.focus();
}

  {name:'System Preferences',icon:'fa-sliders',type:'app'},
  {name:'About This Mac',icon:'fa-info-circle',type:'app'},
  {name:'Documents',icon:'fa-folder',type:'file'},
  {name:'Downloads',icon:'fa-download',type:'file'},
  {name:'Applications',icon:'fa-th',type:'folder'},
];
const spotlightOverlay=document.getElementById('spotlight-overlay');
const spotlightInput=document.getElementById('spotlight-input');
const spotlightResults=document.getElementById('spotlight-results');

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key===' ') {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleSpotlight();
  }
  if(e.key==='Escape'){
    spotlightOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

function toggleSpotlight(){
  if(spotlightOverlay.classList.contains('active')){
    spotlightOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  }else{
    spotlightOverlay.classList.add('active');
    spotlightInput.value='';
    spotlightResults.innerHTML='';
    spotlightInput.focus();
  }
}

spotlightInput.addEventListener('input',()=>{
  const q=spotlightInput.value.toLowerCase();
  const filtered=q?spotlightItems.filter(i=>i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)):spotlightItems.slice(0,5);
  spotlightResults.innerHTML=filtered.map(item=>`<div class="result-item" onclick="openApp('${item.name}');spotlightOverlay.classList.remove('active')"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i><span>${item.name}</span><span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:#999">${item.type}</span></div>`).join('');
});

spotlightInput.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Enter'){
    const first=spotlightResults.querySelector('.result-item');
    if(first)first.click();
  }
});

spotlightOverlay.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(e.target===spotlightOverlay)spotlightOverlay.classList.remove('active');
});

// === CONTEXT MENU ===
function showContextMenu(x,y,name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.context-menu').forEach(m=>m.remove());
  const menu=document.createElement('div');
  menu.className='context-menu';
  menu.style.left=x+'px';menu.style.top=y+'px';
  
  const items=[
    {label:'Rename',icon:'fa-pen'},
    {label:'Get Info',icon:'fa-info-circle'},
    {label:'Move to Trash',icon:'fa-trash'},
  ];
  
  items.forEach((item,i)=>{
    const div=document.createElement('div');
    div.className='menu-item';
    div.innerHTML=`<i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i> ${item.label}`;
    div.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(item.label==='Move to Trash'){
        const iconEl=[...iconsContainer.children].find(c=>c.querySelector('.label')?.textContent===name);
        if(iconEl)iconEl.style.opacity='0.4';
      }
      menu.remove();
    });
    menu.appendChild(div);
    if(i<items.length-1){
      const sep=document.createElement('div');sep.className='separator';menu.appendChild(sep);
    }
  });
  
  document.body.appendChild(menu);
  
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const rect=menu.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(rect.right>window.innerWidth)menu.style.left=(x-rect.width)+'px';
    if(rect.bottom>window.innerHeight)menu.style.top=(y-rect.height)+'px';
  },0);
  
  document.addEventListener('click',function handler(){
    menu.remove();document.removeEventListener('click',handler);
  },{once:true});
}

// === DRAG TO DESKTOP ===
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  if(!dragItem)return;
  const ghost=document.querySelector('.drag-ghost');
  if(!ghost){
    const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='drag-ghost';
    g.innerHTML=`<div class="icon-wrap"><i class="fas ${dragItem.icon}" style="color:${dragItem.color}"></i></div><div class="label">${dragItem.name}</div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(g);
  }
  const ghostEl=document.querySelector('.drag-ghost');
  if(ghostEl){ghostEl.style.left=(e.clientX-32)+'px';ghostEl.style.top=(e.clientY-32)+'px'}
});

document.addEventListener('mouseup',e=>{
  if(!dragItem)return;
  const ghost=document.querySelector('.drag-ghost');
  if(ghost)ghost.remove();
  
  // Check if dropped on desktop
  if(e.target.id==='desktop'||e.target.id==='desktop-icons'){
    // Could add to desktop
  }
  // Check if dropped on dock
  if(e.target.closest('.dock-icon')){
    const dockTarget=e.target.closest('.dock-icon');
    if(dockTarget&&dockTarget.title){
      openApp(dockTarget.title);
    }
  }
  dragItem=null;
});

// === APPLE MENU ===
document.getElementById('apple-btn').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  showContextMenu(e.clientX,30,'Apple Menu');
  const menu=document.querySelector('.context-menu');
  if(menu){
    menu.innerHTML=`
      <div class="menu-item" onclick="openApp('About This Mac');this.parentElement.remove()"><i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i> About This Mac</div>
      <div class="separator"></div>
      <div class="menu-item"><i class="fas fa-cog"></i> System Preferences...</div>
      <div class="separator"></div>
      <div class="menu-item"><i class="fas fa-store"></i> App Store...</div>
      <div class="separator"></div>
      <div class="menu-item"><i class="fas fa-user"></i> Recent Items</div>
      <div class="separator"></div>
      <div class="menu-item"><i class="fas fa-power-off"></i> Shut Down...</div>
    `;
  }
});

// === INIT ===
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(!e.target.closest('#dock')&&!e.target.closest('.window')&&!e.target.closest('#menubar')&&!e.target.closest('#spotlight-overlay')&&!e.target.closest('.context-menu')&&!e.target.closest('.desktop-icon')&&!e.target.closest('.wallpaper-options')&&e.target.id==='desktop'){
    document.querySelectorAll('.context-menu').forEach(m=>m.remove());
  }
});

// Initial dock active states
setTimeout(()=>{
  const dockIcons=dockContainer.querySelectorAll('.dock-icon');
  if(dockIcons[0])dockIcons[0].classList.add('active');
},500);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mac OS 9</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chicago&family=Geneva&family=Monaco&display=swap');

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  :root {
    --silver: #c0c0c0;
    --dark-silver: #a0a0a0;
    --light-silver: #e0e0e0;
    --blue-title: #000080;
    --highlight: #ffffff;
    --shadow: #808080;
    --dark-shadow: #404040;
    --menu-font: 'Geneva', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
    --sys-font: 'Geneva', sans-serif;
  }

  body {
    font-family: var(--sys-font);
    font-size: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: default;
  }

  /* BOOT SCREEN */
  #boot-screen {
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: #000;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 99999;
    transition: opacity 1s;
  }
  #boot-screen.fade-out { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .boot-mac-icon {
    width: 120px; height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
  .boot-mac-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .boot-progress-bar {
    width: 200px; height: 16px;
    border: 2px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }
  .boot-progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff;
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 0.3s;
    border-radius: 1px;
  }
  .boot-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Geneva', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-top: 12px;
  }

  /* DESKTOP */
  #desktop {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3a5c 0%, #2d5f8a 30%, #4a8bc2 60%, #2d5f8a 100%);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* MENU BAR */
  #menubar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e8e8e8, #c8c8c8);
    border-bottom: 1px solid #888;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 8px;
    z-index: 10000;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff;
  }
  .menu-apple {
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-right: 16px;
    cursor: default;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .menu-item {
    padding: 2px 10px;
    cursor: default;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    position: relative;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .menu-item:hover, .menu-item.active {
    background: #000080;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .menu-separator {
    width: 1px;
    height: 16px;
    background: #aaa;
    margin: 0 4px;
  }
  .menu-right {
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-weight: normal;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .menu-clock {
    font-size: 11px;
    min-width: 120px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* DROPDOWN MENUS */
  .dropdown-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: 24px;
    background: #e8e8e8;
    border: 1px solid #888;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    min-width: 200px;
    z-index: 10001;
    display: none;
    padding: 2px 0;
  }
  .dropdown-menu.show { display: block; }
  .dropdown-item {
    padding: 4px 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    cursor: default;
    white-space: nowrap;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .dropdown-item:hover {
    background: #000080;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .dropdown-item.disabled {
    color: #888;
  }
  .dropdown-item.disabled:hover {
    background: transparent;
    color: #888;

<script>
// ==================== STATE ====================
let windowZIndex = 100;
let activeWindow = null;
let openWindows = {};
let dragState = null;
let resizeState = null;
let selectionRectStart = null;
let selectedDesktopIcons = new Set();

// Calculator state
let calcDisplay = '0';
let calcPrev = null;
let calcOp = null;
let calcNewNumber = true;

// Terminal state
let termHistory = [];
let termPromptPath = '~';
let termLineCount = 0;

// Music player state
let musicPlaying = false;
let musicProgress = 35;
let musicInterval = null;

// Paint state
let paintTool = 'brush';
let paintColor = '#000000';
let paintSize = 3;
let paintDrawing = false;

// Chess state
let chessSelected = null;
let chessBoardState = null;

// ==================== BOOT ====================
(function boot() {
  const progress = document.getElementById('boot-progress');
  let p = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    p += Math.random() * 15 + 5;
    if (p >= 100) {
      p = 100;
      progress.style.width = '100%';
      clearInterval(interval);
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('boot-screen').classList.add('fade-out');
        setTimeout(() => {
          document.getElementById('boot-screen').style.display = 'none';
          showNotification('Welcome!', 'Mac OS 9 is ready. Double-click icons or use the dock to launch apps.');
        }, 1000);
      }, 500);
    }
    progress.style.width = p + '%';
  }, 200);
})();

// ==================== CLOCK ====================
function updateClock() {
  const now = new Date();
  const days = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
  const months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const h = now.getHours();
  const m = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
  const ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h % 12 || 12;
  document.getElementById('menu-clock').textContent = `${days[now.getDay()]} ${months[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}  ${h12}:${m} ${ampm}`;
}
setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
updateClock();

// ==================== MENUS ====================
let activeMenu = null;

function toggleMenu(name) {
  const dd = document.getElementById('dropdown-' + name);
  if (activeMenu === name) {
    closeAllMenus();
  } else {
    closeAllMenus();
    dd.classList.add('show');
    activeMenu = name;
  }
}

function closeAllMenus() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-menu').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('show'));
  activeMenu = null;
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.menu-item') && !e.target.closest('.menu-apple') && !e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu')) {
    closeAllMenus();
  }
  if (!e.target.closest('#context-menu') && !e.target.closest('#menubar')) {
    document.getElementById('context-menu').classList.remove('show');
  }
});

// ==================== CONTEXT MENU ====================
document.getElementById('desktop').addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (e.target.closest('.window') || e.target.closest('#dock') || e.target.closest('.desktop-icon')) return;
  const ctx = document.getElementById('context-menu');
  ctx.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
  ctx.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  ctx.classList.add('show');
});

// ==================== DESKTOP SELECTION ====================
const desktop = document.getElementById('desktop');

desktop.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  if (e.target === desktop || e.target.id === 'selection-rect') {
    clearDesktopSelection();
    selectionRectStart = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    const rect = document.getElementById('selection-rect');
    rect.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    rect.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
    rect.style.width = '0px';
    rect.style.height = '0px';
    rect.style.display = 'block';
  }
});

desktop.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (selectionRectStart) {
    const rect = document.getElementById('selection-rect');
    const x = Math.min(e.clientX, selectionRectStart.x);
    const y = Math.min(e.clientY, selectionRectStart.y);
    const w = Math.abs(e.clientX - selectionRectStart.x);
    const h = Math.abs(e.clientY - selectionRectStart.y);
    rect.style.left = x + 'px';
    rect.style.top = y + 'px';
    rect.style.width = w + 'px';
    rect.style.height = h + 'px';
  }
});

desktop.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => {
  if (selectionRectStart) {
    document.getElementById('selection-rect').style.display = 'none';
    selectionRectStart = null;
  }
});

function clearDesktopSelection() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('selected'));
  selectedDesktopIcons.clear();
}

// ==================== WINDOW MANAGEMENT ====================
function createWindow(id, title, width, height, contentHTML, options = {}) {
  if (openWindows[id]) {
    focusWindow(openWindows[id]);
    return openWindows[id];
  }

  const win = document.createElement('div');
  win.className = 'window opening focused';
  win.id = 'win-' + id;
  win.dataset.appId = id;
  win.style.width = width + 'px';
  win.style.height = height + 'px';
  win.style.zIndex = ++windowZIndex;
  win.style.left = (100 + Object.keys(openWindows).length * 30) + 'px';
  win.style.top = (60 + Object.keys(openWindows).length * 30) + 'px';

  const toolbarHTML = options.toolbar ? `
    <div class="toolbar">
      ${options.toolbar}
    </div>` : '';

  win.innerHTML = `
    <div class="titlebar" onmousedown="startDrag(event, '${id}')">
      <span class="close-btn" onclick="closeWindow('${id}')" title="Close">✕</span>
      <span class="minimize-btn" onclick="minimizeWindow('${id}')" title="Minimize">−</span>
      <span class="zoom-btn" onclick="zoomWindow('${id}')" title="Zoom">+</span>
      <span class="title-text">${title}</span>
      <div class="resize-handle" onmousedown="startResize(event, '${id}')"></div>
    </div>
    ${toolbarHTML}
    <div class="window-body" id="body-${id}">
      ${contentHTML}
    </div>
    ${options.statusbar ? `<div class="statusbar">${options.statusbar}</div>` : ''}
  `;

  win.addEventListener('mousedown', () => focusWindow(win));

  document.getElementById('windows-container').appendChild(win);
  openWindows[id] = win;
  focusWindow(win);

  // Remove opening animation class after it plays
  setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove('opening'), 200);

  // Add indicator to dock
  const ind = document.getElementById('ind-' + id);
  if (ind) ind.style.display = 'block';

  // Call init callback
  if (options.onInit) options.onInit(win);

  return win;
}

function focusWindow(win) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.window').forEach(w => w.classList.remove('focused'));
  win.classList.add('focused');
  win.style.zIndex = ++windowZIndex;
  activeWindow = win;
}

function closeWindow(id) {
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win) return;
  win.classList.add('closing');
  setTimeout(() => {
    win.remove();
    delete openWindows[id];
    const ind = document.getElementById('ind-' + id);
    if (ind) ind.style.display = 'none';
    if (musicInterval && id !== 'music') { /* keep music playing */ }
  }, 150);
}

function minimizeWindow(id) {
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win) return;
  win.classList.add('minimized');
  if (activeWindow === win) activeWindow = null;
}

function zoomWindow(id) {
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win) return;
  if (win.classList.contains('maximized')) {
    win.classList.remove('maximized');
    win.style.left = win.dataset.prevLeft;
    win.style.top = win.dataset.prevTop;
    win.style.width = win.dataset.prevWidth;
    win.style.height = win.dataset.prevHeight;
  } else {
    win.dataset.prevLeft = win.style.left;
    win.dataset.prevTop = win.style.top;
    win.dataset.prevWidth = win.style.width;
    win.dataset.prevHeight = win.style.height;
    win.classList.add('maximized');
  }
}

function restoreWindow(id) {
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win) return;
  win.classList.remove('minimized');
  focusWindow(win);
}

// ==================== DRAG ====================
function startDrag(e, id) {
  if (e.target.closest('.close-btn') || e.target.closest('.minimize-btn') || e.target.closest('.zoom-btn')) return;
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win || win.classList.contains('maximized')) return;
  dragState = {
    win: win,
    startX: e.clientX - win.offsetLeft,
    startY: e.clientY - win.offsetTop
  };
  focusWindow(win);
  e.preventDefault();
}

document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  if (dragState) {
    dragState.win.style.left = (e.clientX - dragState.startX) + 'px';
    dragState.win.style.top = (e.clientY - dragState.startY) + 'px';
  }
  if (resizeState) {
    const newW = Math.max(200, e.clientX - resizeState.win.offsetLeft);
    const newH = Math.max(100, e.clientY - resizeState.win.offsetTop);
    resizeState.win.style.width = newW + 'px';
    resizeState.win.style.height = newH + 'px';
  }
});

document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  dragState = null;
  resizeState = null;
});

// ==================== RESIZE ====================
function startResize(e, id) {
  const win = openWindows[id];
  if (!win) return;
  resizeState = { win: win };
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
}

// ==================== APP DEFINITIONS ====================
function openApp(appId) {
  closeAllMenus();
  document.getElementById('context-menu').classList.remove('show');

  if (openWindows[appId]) {
    const win = openWindows[appId];
    if (win.classList.contains('minimized')) {
      restoreWindow(appId);
    } else {
      focusWindow(win);
    }
    return;
  }

  switch(appId) {
    case 'finder': openFinder(); break;
    case 'terminal': openTerminal(); break;
    case 'calculator': openCalculator(); break;
    case 'textedit': openTextEdit(); break;
    case 'safari': openSafari(); break;
    case 'music': openMusicPlayer(); break;
    case 'chess': openChess(); break;
    case 'paint': openPaint(); break;
    case 'preferences': openPreferences(); break;
    case 'about': openAbout(); break;
    case 'help': openHelp(); break;
    case 'hdd': openHDD(); break;
    case 'folder': openFolder(); break;
    case 'readme': openReadme(); break;
    case 'image': openImageViewer(); break;
    case 'trash': openTrash(); break;
    case 'desktop': openDesktop(); break;
    case 'home': openHome(); break;
    default: openFinder(); break;
  }
}

// ==================== FINDER ====================
function openFinder() {
  const files = [

    { icon: '📁', name: 'Documents' },

  const sidebarItems = [

  ];

  let sidebarHTML = sidebarItems.map(s =>
    `<div class="finder-sidebar-item${s.active ? ' active' : ''}">${s.icon} ${s.label}</div>`
  ).join('');

  let filesHTML = files.map(f =>
    `<div class="finder-file" ondblclick="openApp('folder')"><div class="finder-file-icon">${f.icon}</div><div class="finder-file-name">${f.name}</div></div>`
  ).join('');

  const content = `
    <div style="display:flex;height:100%;">
      <div class="finder-sidebar">
        <div class="finder-sidebar-title">Favorites</div>
        ${sidebarHTML}
        <div class="finder-sidebar-title" style="margin-top:12px;">Devices</div>
        <div class="finder-sidebar-item">💾 Macintosh HD</div>
        <div class="finder-sidebar-item">💿 CD/DVD</div>
      </div>
      <div class="splitter-v"></div>
      <div style="flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">
        <div class="toolbar">
          <div class="toolbar-btn" onclick="openFinder()">◀</div>
          <div class="toolbar-btn" onclick="openFinder()">▶</div>
          <input class="toolbar-address" value="Macintosh HD" readonly>
          <div class="toolbar-btn" title="Icon View">▦</div>

        </div>

  createWindow('finder', 'Macintosh HD', 600, 400, content);

function openHDD() { openFinder(); }
function openFolder() { openFinder(); }
function openReadme() { openTextEdit('Welcome to Mac OS 9!\n\nThis is a recreation of the classic Macintosh operating system.\n\nFeel free to explore:\n• Open applications from the dock\n• Drag windows around\n• Resize windows by dragging corners\n• Right-click on desktop for context menu\n• Try the built-in apps!'); }

function openHome() { openFinder(); }

// ==================== TERMINAL ====================
function openTerminal() {
  const content = `
    <div class="terminal-body" id="term-output">
      <div>Last login: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}</div>
      <div>Type 'help' for available commands.</div>
      <br>
    </div>
  `;

  createWindow('terminal', 'Terminal — bash', 550, 350, content, {
    onInit: (win) => {
      const output = document.getElementById('term-output');
      function addPrompt() {
        const line = document.createElement('div');
        line.className = 'terminal-input-line';
        line.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-prompt">user@macos9:~$ </span><input class="terminal-input" autofocus>`;
        output.appendChild(line);
        const input = line.querySelector('input');
        input.focus();
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            const cmd = input.value.trim();
            if (cmd) {
              termHistory.unshift(cmd);
              executeCommand(cmd, output);
            } else {
              processOutput(output);
            }
            addPrompt();
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
          }
        });
      }
      addPrompt();
      output.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const inputs = output.querySelectorAll('.terminal-input');
        if (inputs.length) inputs[inputs.length - 1].focus();
      });
    }
  });
}

function generateCalendar() {
  const now = new Date();
  const year = now.getFullYear();
  const month = now.getMonth();
  const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const today = now.getDate();
  const months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];

  let cal = `    ${months[month]} ${year}\nSu Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa\n`;
  let line = '   '.repeat(firstDay);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    const dayStr = d.toString().padStart(2, ' ');
    line += dayStr + ' ';
    if ((firstDay + d) % 7 === 0 || d === daysInMonth) {
      cal += line + '\n';
      line = '';
    }
  }
  return cal;
}

function calcPress(key) {
  const display = document.getElementById('calc-display');
  if (!display) return;

    calcDisplay = '0'; calcPrev = null; calcOp = null; calcNewNumber = true;

    if (calcDisplay.length > 1) calcDisplay = calcDisplay.slice(0, -1);
    else calcDisplay = '0';
  } else if (key === '±') {
    calcDisplay = calcDisplay.startsWith('-') ? calcDisplay.slice(1) : '-' + calcDisplay;
  } else if (key === '%') {
    calcDisplay = String(parseFloat(calcDisplay) / 100);
  } else if (['+', '−', '×', '÷'].includes(key)) {
    if (calcPrev !== null && !calcNewNumber) {
      calcDisplay = String(calculate(calcPrev, parseFloat(calcDisplay), calcOp));
    }
    calcPrev = parseFloat(calcDisplay);
    calcOp = key;
    calcNewNumber = true;
  } else if (key === '#') {
    if (calcPrev !== null && calcOp) {
      calcDisplay = String(calculate(calcPrev, parseFloat(calcDisplay), calcOp));
    }
    calcPrev = null; calcOp = null; calcNewNumber = true;
  } else if (key === '.') {
    if (calcNewNumber) { calcDisplay = '0.'; calcNewNumber = false; }
    else if (!calcDisplay.includes('.')) calcDisplay += '.';
  } else {
    if (calcNewNumber) { calcDisplay = key; calcNewNumber = false; }
    else calcDisplay += key;
  }

  // Format display
  let displayText = calcDisplay;
  if (!isNaN(parseFloat(displayText)) && displayText !== '' && !displayText.endsWith('.')) {
    const num = parseFloat(displayText);
    if (Number.isInteger(num) && displayText.indexOf('.') === -1) {
      // Keep as is
    }
  }
  if (displayText.length > 12) displayText = parseFloat(displayText).toExponential(6);
  display.textContent = displayText;
}

function calculate(a, b, op) {
  switch(op) {
    case '+': return a + b;
    case '−': return a - b;
    case '×': return a * b;
    case '÷': return b !== 0 ? a / b : 'Error';
  }
  return b;
}

function togglePlay() {
  musicPlaying = !musicPlaying;
  const btn = document.getElementById('music-play-btn');
  const fill = document.getElementById('music-progress-fill');
  if (btn) btn.textContent = musicPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶';
  if (musicPlaying) {
    musicInterval = setInterval(() => {
      musicProgress += 0.5;
      if (musicProgress >= 100) { musicProgress = 0; nextTrack(); }
      if (fill) fill.style.width = musicProgress + '%';
      const secs = Math.floor(musicProgress * 3.55);
      const mins = Math.floor(secs / 60);
      const s = secs % 60;
      const timeEl = document.getElementById('music-current-time');
      if (timeEl) timeEl.textContent = `${mins}:${s.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
    }, 500);
  } else {
    clearInterval(musicInterval);
  }
}

function selectTrack(el, title, artist) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.playlist-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('music-title');
  const artistEl = document.getElementById('music-artist');
  if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = title;
  if (artistEl) artistEl.textContent = artist;
  musicProgress = 0;
  const fill = document.getElementById('music-progress-fill');
  if (fill) fill.style.width = '0%';
  if (!musicPlaying) togglePlay();
}

function prevTrack() {
  musicProgress = 0;
  const active = document.querySelector('.playlist-item.active');
  if (active && active.previousElementSibling) {
    selectTrack(active.previousElementSibling, active.previousElementSibling.querySelector('span:first-child').textContent.split(' — ')[0], active.previousElementSibling.querySelector('span:first-child').textContent.split(' — ')[1]);
  }
}

function nextTrack() {
  musicProgress = 0;
  const active = document.querySelector('.playlist-item.active');
  if (active && active.nextElementSibling) {
    selectTrack(active.nextElementSibling, active.nextElementSibling.querySelector('span:first-child').textContent.split(' — ')[0], active.nextElementSibling.querySelector('span:first-child').textContent.split(' — ')[1]);
  }
}

function seekMusic(e) {
  const bar = e.currentTarget;
  const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
  musicProgress = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
  const fill = document.getElementById('music-progress-fill');
  if (fill) fill.style.width = musicProgress + '%';
}

    ['','','','','','','',''],
    ['P','P','P','P','P','P','P','P'],
    ['R','N','B','Q','K','B','N','R']
  ];

  chessBoardState = initialBoard.map(r => [...r]);

  function renderBoard() {
    let html = '<div class="chess-board">';
    for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
        const isLight = (r + c) % 2 === 0;

        const piece = chessBoardState[r][c];
        const pieceChar = pieces[piece] || '';
        html += `<div class="chess-cell ${isLight ? 'light' : 'dark'} ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}" 
                     onclick="chessClick(${r},${c})">${pieceChar}</div>`;
      }
    }
    html += '</div>';
    return html;
  }

  const content = `
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:10px;">
      <div style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#666;" id="chess-status">White's turn</div>

}

function chessClick(r, c) {
  const piece = chessBoardState[r][c];
  if (chessSelected) {
    // Move piece
    if (chessSelected.r !== r || chessSelected.c !== c) {
      chessBoardState[r][c] = chessBoardState[chessSelected.r][chessSelected.c];
      chessBoardState[chessSelected.r][chessSelected.c] = '';
    }
    chessSelected = null;
    // Update status
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('chess-status');
    if (statusEl) {
      const turn = piece === piece.toUpperCase() ? 'Black' : 'White';
      statusEl.textContent = `${turn}'s turn`;
    }
  } else if (piece) {
    chessSelected = { r, c };
  }

  // Re-render
  const win = openWindows['chess'];
  if (win) {
    const container = win.querySelector('.window-body');
    const statusText = statusEl ? statusEl.textContent : "White's turn";
    let html = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:10px;">';
    html += `<div style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#666;" id="chess-status">${statusText}</div>`;
    html += '<div class="chess-board">';
    for (let row = 0; row < 8; row++) {
      for (let col = 0; col < 8; col++) {
        const isLight = (row + col) % 2 === 0;
        const isSelected = chessSelected && chessSelected.r === row && chessSelected.c === col;
        const p = chessBoardState[row][col];
        const pieces = {'K':'♔','Q':'♕','R':'♖','B':'♗','N':'♘','P':'♙','k':'♚','q':'♛','r':'♜','b':'♝','n':'♞','p':'♟'};
        html += `<div class="chess-cell ${isLight?'light':'dark'} ${isSelected?'selected':''}" onclick="chessClick(${row},${col})">${pieces[p]||''}</div>`;
      }
    }
    html += '</div></div>';
    container.innerHTML = html;
  }
}

        <div class="paint-tool${paintTool==='brush'?' active':''}" onclick="selectPaintTool('brush',this)" title="Brush">🖌️</div>
        <div class="paint-tool${paintTool==='eraser'?' active':''}" onclick="selectPaintTool('eraser',this)" title="Eraser">🧹</div>
        <div class="paint-tool${paintTool==='line'?' active':''}" onclick="selectPaintTool('line',this)" title="Line">╱</div>
        <div class="paint-tool${paintTool==='rect'?' active':''}" onclick="selectPaintTool('rect',this)" title="Rectangle">□</div>
        <div class="paint-tool${paintTool==='fill'?' active':''}" onclick="selectPaintTool('fill',this)" title="Fill">🪣</div>
        <input type="range" min="1" max="20" value="${paintSize}" style="width:60px;" onchange="paintSize=parseInt(this.value)" title="Brush size">
        <div class="paint-colors">${colorBtns}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="paint-canvas-container">
        <canvas class="paint-canvas" id="paint-canvas" width="500" height="350"
                onmousedown="paintMouseDown(event)" onmousemove="paintMouseMove(event)" onmouseup="paintMouseUp()" onmouseleave="paintMouseUp()"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  createWindow('paint', 'Paint', 560, 440, content, {
    onInit: (win) => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('paint-canvas');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      win._paintCanvas = canvas;
      win._paintCtx = ctx;
    }
  });
}

function selectPaintTool(tool, el) {
  paintTool = tool;
  document.querySelectorAll('.paint-tool').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
}

function selectPaintColor(color, el) {
  paintColor = color;
  document.querySelectorAll('.paint-color').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
}

function paintMouseDown(e) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('paint-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  paintDrawing = true;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
  paintLastX = x;
  paintLastY = y;
  paintStartX = x;
  paintStartY = y;

  if (paintTool === 'fill') {
    ctx.fillStyle = paintColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    paintDrawing = false;
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
  }
}

let paintLastX, paintLastY, paintStartX, paintStartY;

function paintMouseMove(e) {
  if (!paintDrawing) return;
  const canvas = document.getElementById('paint-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (paintTool === 'brush') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = paintColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = paintSize;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (paintTool === 'eraser') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = paintSize * 3;
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  paintLastX = x;
  paintLastY = y;
}

function paintMouseUp() {
  paintDrawing = false;
}

// ==================== PREFERENCES ====================
function openPreferences() {
  const prefs = [
    { icon: '🖥️', label: 'General' },
    { icon: '🎨', label: 'Appearance' },
    { icon: '🖱️', label: 'Mouse' },
    { icon: '⌨️', label: 'Keyboard' },
    { icon: '🔊', label: 'Sound' },
    { icon: '📅', label: 'Date & Time' },
    { icon: '🌐', label: 'Network' },
    { icon: '🔒', label: 'Security' },
    { icon: '👤', label: 'Users' },
    { icon: '💾', label: 'Startup Disk' },
    { icon: '♿', label: 'Accessibility' },
    { icon: '🔋', label: 'Energy' },
  ];

  let gridHTML = prefs.map(p =>
    `<div class="pref-item" onclick="showPrefDialog('${p.label}')">
      <div class="pref-item-icon">${p.icon}</div>
      <div class="pref-item-label">${p.label}</div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  const content = `
    <div style="padding:16px;">
      <h3 style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px;color:#000080;">System Preferences</h3>
      <div class="prefs-grid">${gridHTML}</div>
    </div>
  `;

  createWindow('preferences', 'System Preferences', 400, 350, content);
}

function showPrefDialog(label) {
  showDialog(`${label}`, `${label} preferences would appear here in a full implementation. This is a demo of the Mac OS 9 interface.`);
}

// ==================== IMAGE VIEWER ====================
function openImageViewer() {
  const content = `
    <div class="image-viewer">
      <canvas class="image-canvas" id="image-preview" width="300" height="200"></canvas>
    </div>
  `;

  createWindow('image', 'wallpaper.jpg — Image Viewer', 360, 280, content, {
    onInit: (win) => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('image-preview');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      // Draw a simple landscape
      const grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 200);
      grd.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
      grd.addColorStop(0.5, '#4a8bc2');
      grd.addColorStop(0.7, '#2d5f8a');
      grd.addColorStop(1, '#1a3a5c');
      ctx.fillStyle = grd;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 300, 200);
      // Sun
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(240, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Mountains
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2d5f8a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 140);
      ctx.lineTo(80, 80);
      ctx.lineTo(160, 130);
      ctx.lineTo(220, 70);
      ctx.lineTo(300, 120);
      ctx.lineTo(300, 200);
      ctx.lineTo(0, 200);
      ctx.fill();
      // Ground
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3a5c';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 150, 300, 50);
    }
  });
}

// ==================== TRASH ====================
function openTrash() {
  const content = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;">
      <div class="toolbar">
        <div class="toolbar-btn">◀</div>
        <div class="toolbar-btn">▶</div>
        <input class="toolbar-address" value="Trash" readonly>
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;color:#888;">
        <div style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:12px;">🗑️</div>
        <div>The Trash is empty.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  createWindow('trash', 'Trash', 350, 250, content);
}

// ==================== HELP ====================
function openHelp() {
  const content = `
    <div style="padding:20px;">
      <h2 style="color:#000080;margin-bottom:12px;">📘 Mac OS 9 Help</h2>
      <h3>Getting Started</h3>
      <p style="margin:8px 0;line-height:1.6;">Welcome to Mac OS 9! This is a recreation of the classic Macintosh operating system.</p>
      <h3>Navigating</h3>
      <ul style="margin:8px 0 8px 20px;line-height:1.8;">
        <li>Double-click desktop icons to open them</li>
        <li>Use the dock at the bottom to launch applications</li>
        <li>Click the menu bar at the top for application menus</li>
        <li>Right-click on the desktop for context menu options</li>
        <li>Drag windows by their title bars</li>
        <li>Resize windows by dragging the corner handle</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>Applications</h3>
      <ul style="margin:8px 0 8px 20px;line-height:1.8;">
        <li><b>Finder</b> — Browse files and folders</li>
        <li><b>Safari</b> — Web browser (simulated)</li>
        <li><b>Terminal</b> — Command line with various commands</li>
        <li><b>Calculator</b> — Functional calculator</li>
        <li><b>TextEdit</b> — Text editor</li>
        <li><b>iTunes</b> — Music player (simulated)</li>
        <li><b>Chess</b> — Play chess</li>
        <li><b>Paint</b> — Drawing application</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  `;
  createWindow('help', 'Mac Help', 500, 400, content);
}

// ==================== ABOUT ====================
function openAbout() {
  closeAllMenus();
  showDialog('', '', true);
}

function showDialog(title, message, isAbout = false) {
  // Remove existing dialogs
  document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-overlay').forEach(d => d.remove());

  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'dialog-overlay';

  if (isAbout) {
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dialog-box">
        <div class="dialog-titlebar">
          <span>About This Mac</span>
        </div>
        <div class="about-body">
          <div class="about-logo">🍎</div>
          <div class="about-name">Mac OS 9</div>
          <div class="about-version">Version 9.2.2</div>
          <div class="about-info">
            Mac OS 9 Recreation<br>
            Built with HTML, CSS & JavaScript<br><br>
            © 2001 Apple Computer, Inc.<br>
            This is a fan-made recreation.<br>
            Not affiliated with Apple Inc.<br><br>
            Processor: Virtual PowerPC G4<br>
            Memory: Unlimited<br>
            Display: ${window.innerWidth} × ${window.innerHeight}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="dialog-buttons">
          <button class="dialog-btn primary" onclick="this.closest('.dialog-overlay').remove()">OK</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  } else {
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dialog-box">
        <div class="dialog-titlebar">
          <span>${title || 'Alert'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dialog-body">
          <div class="dialog-icon">ℹ️</div>
          <div class="dialog-message">${message || 'No message'}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="dialog-buttons">
          <button class="dialog-btn primary" onclick="this.closest('.dialog-overlay').remove()">OK</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === overlay) overlay.remove();
  });
}

// ==================== NOTIFICATIONS ====================
function showNotification(title, msg) {
  const n = document.createElement('div');
  n.className = 'notification';
  n.innerHTML = `<div class="notification-title">${title}</div><div class="notification-msg">${msg}</div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(n);
  setTimeout(() => {
    n.style.opacity = '0';
    n.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s';
    setTimeout(() => n.remove(), 500);
  }, 4000);
}

// ==================== UTILITY FUNCTIONS ====================
function shutDown() {
  closeAllMenus();
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'dialog-overlay';
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="dialog-box">
      <div class="dialog-titlebar"><span>Shut Down</span></div>
      <div class="dialog-body">
        <div class="dialog-icon">🛑</div>
        <div class="dialog-message">Are you sure you want to shut down your Mac?</div>
      </div>
      <div class="dialog-buttons">
        <button class="dialog-btn" onclick="this.closest('.dialog-overlay').remove()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="dialog-btn primary" onclick="confirmShutdown()">Shut Down</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}

function confirmShutdown() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-overlay').forEach(d => d.remove());
  closeAllMenus();
  // Close all windows
  Object.keys(openWindows).forEach(id => closeWindow(id));
  // Show shutdown screen
  const screen = document.createElement('div');
  screen.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  screen.innerHTML = `
    <div style="font-size:64px;margin-bottom:20px;">🍎</div>
    <div style="color:#888;font-family:Geneva,sans-serif;font-size:14px;">It is now safe to turn off your computer.</div>
    <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:30px;padding:8px 24px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#e8e8e8,#c0c0c0);border:1px solid #888;cursor:pointer;font-family:Geneva,sans-serif;">Restart</button>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(screen);
}

function newWindow() { closeAllMenus(); openFinder(); }
function newTab() { closeAllMenus(); showNotification('Safari', 'New tab created.'); }

function changeView(type) {
  closeAllMenus();
  showNotification('View', `Changed to ${type} view.`);
}

function toggleFullscreen() {
  closeAllMenus();
  if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
    document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(()=>{});
  } else {
    document.exitFullscreen();
  }
}

function tileWindows() {
  closeAllMenus();
  const wins = Object.values(openWindows);
  const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(wins.length));
  const rows = Math.ceil(wins.length / cols);
  const w = Math.floor(window.innerWidth / cols) - 20;
  const h = Math.floor((window.innerHeight - 24) / rows) - 20;
  wins.forEach((win, i) => {
    const col = i % cols;
    const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
    win.classList.remove('maximized');
    win.style.width = w + 'px';
    win.style.height = h + 'px';
    win.style.left = (col * w + 10) + 'px';
    win.style.top = (24 + row * h + 10) + 'px';
    win.classList.remove('minimized');
  });
}

function bringToFront() {
  closeAllMenus();
  Object.values(openWindows).forEach(win => {
    win.classList.remove('minimized');
    focusWindow(win);
  });
}

function sortIcons() {
  closeAllMenus();
  showNotification('Finder', 'Icons sorted by name.');
}

function refreshDesktop() {
  closeAllMenus();
  showNotification('Finder', 'Desktop refreshed.');
}

// ==================== KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS ====================
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    closeAllMenus();
    document.getElementById('context-menu').classList.remove('show');
  }
  if (e.key === 'F11' || (e.metaKey && e.key === 'f')) {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleFullscreen();
  }
});

// Prevent default context menu
document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('#desktop')) return;
});

// ==================== DOUBLE CLICK TITLEBAR TO ZOOM ====================
document.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
  if (e.target.closest('.titlebar') && !e.target.closest('.close-btn') && !e.target.closest('.minimize-btn') && !e.target.closest('.zoom-btn')) {
    const win = e.target.closest('.window');
    if (win) {
      const id = win.id.replace('win-', '');
      zoomWindow(id);
    }
  }
});

// ==================== INITIAL SETUP ====================
// Make desktop selectable
desktop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (e.target === desktop) {
    clearDesktopSelection();
  }
});

// Desktop icon click
document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(icon => {
  icon.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.querySelectorAll('.desktop-icon').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('selected'));
    icon.classList.add('selected');
    selectedDesktopIcons.add(icon);
  });
});

console.log('%c🍎 Mac OS 9 Loaded Successfully', 'font-size:16px;color:#000080;font-weight:bold;');
console.log('%cDouble-click icons or use the dock to launch apps!', 'font-size:12px;color:#666;');
</script>
</body>
</html>
